article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo: Cholera Epidemic 2026 - DREF Operation (MDRCD049)
article.articleSummary: Cholera epidemic ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of EW7_2026 with 1,094 suspected cases and 26 deaths (case fatality rate ~1%). Of the 26 deaths, 6 occurred in health facilities and 20 in the community, signaling access-to-care delays. By EW7_2026, 13 provinces and 84 health zones have reported at least one suspected case. The most affected provinces are Kinshasa, South Kivu, Tanganyika, Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami, North Kivu, and Lualaba; additional provinces with cases/deaths include Mai-Ndombe, Sankuru, Tshopo, Équateur, Maniema, and Kongo Central. The distribution shows a multi-focal epidemic with major hotspots in the eastern and southeastern regions and in Kinshasa. The outbreak shows an increasing trend in reporting compared with earlier weeks and with 2024–2025, signaling higher disease severity and treatment access challenges. This is linked to the DREF operation MDRCD049.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：2026年コレラ流行 - DREF活動（MDRCD049）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の懸念が確認される。多地域での多発性流行により国際通知水準を満たす。
triage.notes: DRCの13州84保健地域で報告、1,094疑似患者、26死亡（CFR~1%）。東部・南東部および首都キンシャサの多焦点流行。2024-2025年比での増加傾向と治療アクセス遅延を示唆（地域外死亡76%）。DREF活動MDRCD049との連動あり。エクアドルがリスト内にあるが、記事本文では言及なく、発生地域データの異常値の可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Booster Vaksin pada Orang Tua Bisa Lindungi Bayi dari Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine booster for parents can protect infants from measles.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, rising measles cases in Indonesia prompt discussion on adult vaccination. Pediatrician and IDAI chair Dr. Piprim Basarah Yanuarso states the measles vaccine remains effective in adults and can be crucial for protecting infants not yet eligible for immunization. A booster for parents helps shield babies in households with immune adults, especially for infants 2–3 months old. If adult immunization is incomplete, an MR booster is advised. Indonesia’s national program focuses on children aged 9 months to about 15 years due to vaccine stock, with measles vaccination commonly given at 9 months and MR boosters at 2 and 5 years. IDAI also supports MMR at 15 months and again at 5 years. Adults may receive boosters to refresh immune memory; MMR doses can be offered around pregnancy or before marriage, two doses in such scenarios to strengthen protection against measles, mumps, and rubella.

triage.headline_ja: 親のワクチンブースターは麻疹から乳幼児を守ることができる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹、おたふく風邪、風疹の3疾患が同時に報告されており、複数の報告可能疾患が関連している。しかし現在の記事は主に公衆衛生教育・予防啓発の内容であり、流行発生の明確な証拠が不足しているため、今後の症例数・地理的拡大に関する続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は『麻疹症例の増加』を言及しているが、具体的な症例数、致死率、入院数などの重症度情報が記載されていない。公開情報に基づく啓発記事であり、現在の流行規模・深刻度を判定できない。インドネシアは麻疹/おたふく風邪/風疹の報告可能疾患であり、今後のサーベイランスデータの更新を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alta da dengue faz busca por telas disparar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue surge drives demand for screens.
article.articleSummary: Dengue surge in Brazil during the rainy season drives demand for window barriers to curb Aedes aegypti transmission. In the first months of the year, rising dengue case numbers push families to install insect screens to keep mosquitoes out of homes. However, this coverage can create a dangerous false sense of security for fall protection in apartments. Preventing tragedies requires exterior structural nets paired with interior screens, not DIY installations. Two distinct materials: fiberglass-based mosquito nets (PVC or lightweight nylon) designed to block insects; and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) safety nets that form 5x5 cm meshes for fall protection. The HDPE nets are anchored directly to masonry with galvanized or stainless-steel hooks and anchors and can withstand up to 500 kg per square meter. Installation should be layered: exterior structural net installed first by specialists, then interior mosquito net; ensure independent tensioning and provide material guarantees.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の急増がスクリーン（網戸）の需要を急増させている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱の増加傾向は確認されるが、記事の主焦点は感染症対策というより建築資材・落下防止ネットの需要に関する商業的側面であり、疫学的な詳細（症例数、死亡者、国際拡大リスク等）の情報が不足している。
triage.notes: デング熱は周知の風土病で、ブラジルの雨季における季節的な再発は予想内。記事は媒介蚊（Aedes aegypti）の動向と対策需要を言及しており、蚊媒介感染症特有の長期曝露・流行特性は認識されているが、現在の流行規模や死亡・重症事例に関する具体的な疫学データが提示されていない。フルRRA実施のため、症例数・死亡数・地理的拡大状況についての続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta Epidemiológica: Fiebre amarilla en la Región de las Américas - 13 de marzo del 2026 - Brazil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Alert: Yellow Fever in the Region of the Americas - March 13, 2026 - Brazil
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever alert for the Americas issued March 13, 2026, with Brazil highlighted as affected. Since September 2024, yellow fever cases have been reported in areas with no historical transmission, including areas outside the Amazon region. The Pan American Health Organization and World Health Organization (OPS/OMS) urge member states to strengthen surveillance, intensify vaccination campaigns for at‑risk populations, and ensure travelers to areas with reported cases are informed and protected against yellow fever. The alert also emphasizes enhanced clinical management, focusing on early detection and timely treatment of severe disease. Authorities should maintain vaccine stockpiles aligned with national availability to guarantee a rapid response to potential outbreaks. The message underscores international coordination to prevent spread and safeguard travelers and residents in the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学的警告：米州地域における黄熱病 - 2026年3月13日 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、米州地域における黄熱病の地理的拡大（従来の流行地外での新規発生報告）、重篤度の高さ、国際的な渡航制限リスクが確認されたため、フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: 2024年9月以降、アマゾン地域外を含む従来の流行地外での黄熱病報告が増加している点が特に懸念される。OPS/OMSによる公式警告発出、ワクチン備蓄強化、国際調整の強化が呼びかけられており、米州全域での準備態勢が必要な段階。カナリア諸島およびスペインへの関連言及は陸上輸送リスク評価の対象となる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Republic of Congo Humanitarian Flash Update No. 3 (Cholera Outbreak Response), 13 March 2026 - Congo
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Republic of Congo persists with 997 cumulative cases and an 8.3% CFR. July 2025 outbreak progressed to end-2025 with 826 suspected cases and 67 deaths (CFR 8%). District breakdown: Mbamou Island 336/12 (3.6%), Mossaka 432/54 (12.5%), Gamboma 59, Talangaï 10/1. After nine weeks without cases, resurgence occurred in Mbamou Island (Brazzaville) and Congo-Oubangui in February 2026. By March 11, 196 suspected cases since Feb 13, mainly Mossaka and Mbamou Island; laboratory confirmation: Liranga District 4, Mbamou Island 3; eight deaths. A third hotspot emerged in Impfondo (Likouala) with 14 alerts and five deaths in early March. CFR 8.3% exceeds the regional 2.2% average. Affected districts sit along a transboundary river corridor with DRC (Liranga, Mossaka-Lokolela, Impfondo, Mbamou Island, Makotimpoko). Risk factors include unsafe drinking water, open defecation, poor hygiene, and cross-river food exchanges; ongoing Mpox and rising influenza complicate response; UNICEF/WHO support strengthens risk communication and WASH interventions.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF コンゴ共和国人道支援フラッシュ更新第3号（コレラ流行対応）、2026年3月13日 - コンゴ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。複数地域での持続的なコレラ流行（CFR 8.3%で地域平均2.2%を大幅超過）、DRC等との国境越境リスク、Mpox・インフルエンザとの複合流行が認識されている。
triage.notes: 3疾患（Mpox、Cholera、Influenza）の複合流行。コレラはジュライ2025年から持続し、2026年2月に9週間の空白後に再燃。CFR 8.3%は地域平均の3.8倍。DRCとの国境地域での越境リスク（飲料水不安全、衛生状態不良、国境河川での食糧交換）が顕著。UNICEF/WHOによる支援が実施中であり、国際的な関心と支援が確立している。

article.articleHeadline: OPS alerta sobre la transmisión sostenida de la fiebre amarilla en Sudamérica | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of sustained transmission of yellow fever in South America | Noticias RCN
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever continues in South America with sustained transmission reported by PAHO as of March 2026, expanding beyond traditional foci. The viral hemorrhagic disease is endemic in tropical Africa, Central America, and South America. Since September 2024, cases have appeared in areas previously unrecorded, including outside the Amazon. In 2025, PAHO recorded 346 confirmed cases and 143 deaths across seven countries: Bolivia (8/2), Brazil (120/48), Colombia (125/46), Ecuador (11/8), Peru (49/19), Venezuela (32/19), and Guyana (numbers not provided). In the first seven weeks of 2026, 34 cases and 15 deaths were reported in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, and Venezuela. Transmission near urban centers raises risk of spread via Aedes aegypti. PAHO urges enhanced surveillance, expanded vaccination in at-risk populations, traveler advisories, rapid clinical management, and maintained vaccine stocks; 2025 CFR was 41%.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが南米におけるデング熱の持続的な伝播について警告 | ニュースRCN
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病は南米8ヶ国で持続的な伝播が確認され、2025年に346例・143死亡（致命率41%）、2026年初頭に34例・15死亡が報告されている。従来の流行地外への拡大、都市部周辺での伝播リスク、複数国への国際的拡大がIHR基準3項目以上に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ソースはスペイン語であり、原文見出しはスペイン語版。翻訳版の見出しではデング熱（dengue）と記載されているが、記事サマリーでは黄熱病（yellow fever）が主要疾患として報告されている。致命率41%は深刻度を示す重要指標。都市部（Aedes aegypti媒介）での伝播リスク拡大は国際的な懸念要因。PAHO（パンアメリカン保健機構）からの公式警告は政府・国際的関心の証。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemiological Alert: Yellow fever in the Americas Region - 13 March 2026 - Brazil
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in the Americas—PAHO/WHO urges intensified surveillance, vaccination of at-risk populations, traveler information, and strengthened clinical management with reserve vaccine stockpiles for rapid response (as of 16 March 2026). For 2025 EW1–EW53, 346 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported across seven countries, with 143 deaths (CFR 41%). Breakdowns: Bolivia 8/2; Brazil 120/48; Colombia 125/46; Ecuador 11/8; Guyana 1 death; Peru 49/19; Venezuela 32/19. In 2026 EW1–EW7, 34 confirmed cases across four countries were reported, including 15 deaths (CFR 44%): Bolivia 1 death; Colombia 25/13; Peru 2; Venezuela 6/1. The 2025 total is high relative to recent years but mirrors historic peaks (e.g., 1966, 1998, 2003). Public health measures, vaccine availability, and traveler protection are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学的警報：アメリカ地域の黄熱病 - 2026年3月13日 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病は複数国（7～10国）にまたがる多国間流行であり、2025年346例（死亡143例、CFR 41%）、2026年34例（死亡15例、CFR 44%）と高い重症度と死亡率を示している。国際的な拡大リスク（特に欧州への旅行者への懸念）とWHO/PAHOの公式警報により、IHR基準複数該当かつWPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO/PAHO（汎米保健機構）から公式の疫学的警報が発出されている。複数国にまたがる流行（7～10国）で、カナリア諸島（スペイン）への旅行者への懸念も示唆されている。黄熱病はWHO規格ワクチン対応疾患であり、国際的な保健規則（IHR）に基づく通知対象。2025年の346例は数十年来の高水準であり、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: พบเคสในไทย?! ติดไวรัสเพราะ "เห็บกัด" ตัวเดียว สมองอักเสบ-อวัยวะล้มเหลว : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case found in Thailand?! Infected by a virus from a single tick bite—encephalitis and organ failure: Check the news for accuracy.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports a confirmed case of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) caused by the tick-borne virus SFTSV. Transmission occurs via tick bites or exposure to ticks or infected animals/pets. Infected individuals typically present with high fever, thrombocytopenia (low platelets), and elevated liver enzymes; severe complications can include multi-organ failure or meningitis/encephalitis and may be fatal. Not all tick exposures result in severe disease; estimated morbidity and mortality range from 5% to 28%. The article warns about silent risk from tick bites and urges vigilance for potential central nervous system involvement. The confirmed case in Thailand underscores the ongoing risk of tick-borne viral infections in the country as of 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: タイで発見されたケース?! 「蛇紋虫刺咬」による単一の蜱刺咬ウイルス感染—脳炎と臓器障害：ニュースの正確性を確認
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）の確認症例の報告であり、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性に該当する可能性があり、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）は致命率5-28%の重篤な蜱媒介感染症。タイでの確認症例は同国における流行リスク増加を示唆。多臓器不全や髄膜炎・脳炎などの重篤な合併症が報告されている。記事では公衆衛生上の警戒が強調されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただし具体的な症例数や流行状況の詳細は記事サマリーからは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quan với viêm họng, nữ sinh nguy kịch vì siêu vi khuẩn tấn công tim và não
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neglecting a sore throat leaves a female student in critical condition as a superbug attacks her heart and brain.
article.articleSummary: Sixteen-year-old female student from Son La, Vietnam, developed septicemia due to Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) with acute infectious endocarditis, pneumonia, and multiple brain injuries. Initially treated for pharyngitis, she had persistent high fever (39–40°C), fatigue, and a non-dermal rash including Janeway lesions on palms and soles. Blood cultures confirmed MRSA. Echocardiography showed vegetations on the mitral valve with severe regurgitation; two eccentric regurgitant jets measured 4 mm and 5 mm. Brain imaging revealed scattered ischemic strokes in both hemispheres and cerebellar hemorrhage with right-sided weakness; pneumonia also diagnosed. History of mitral valve regurgitation since June 2025 likely predisposed to endocarditis. After urgent multidisciplinary review, she received targeted MRSA antibiotics; within three days, CRP dropped from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L, fever resolved, and neurological function improved, with follow-up imaging showing reduced vegetations and no new brain lesions. No skin lesions observed, suggesting mucosal entry.

triage.headline_ja: 咽頭炎を軽視した女子学生が危機的状態に―スーパーバグが心臓と脳を侵襲
triage.triage_reason: MRSA による急性感染性心内膜炎、敗血症、多発脳梗塞を伴う重症例（16歳女子学生）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」（死亡・入院等）、「流行しやすさ」（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）、「管理可能性」（集中治療を要する複数臓器障害）に該当し、同時に社会的・医療的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 個別症例だが、MRSA による多臓器障害（心内膜炎・敗血症・脳卒中）の医学的稀少性と重篤性により、ベトナム国内の感染症管理当局および公衆衛生専門家の関心を集めやすい。粘膜からの侵入経路が推定されており、呼吸道伝播の可能性は低いが、MRSA 株の毒力および広がり方について続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm họng tưởng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi bị 'siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công não tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mild sore throat, 16-year-old female student struck by a 'superbug' attacking the brain and heart.
article.articleSummary: A 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam, with initial symptoms of sore throat and high fever progressed to septicemic illness, presenting Janeway lesions on palms/soles. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bacteremia. Diagnosed with acute infectious endocarditis on a pre-existing mitral valve regurgitation (detected June 2025). Echocardiography showed mitral valve vegetations with severe regurgitation (murmur 3/6) and two eccentric leaks (4 mm and 5 mm). MRSA also caused pneumonia. Brain imaging revealed scattered bilateral cerebral infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhage, causing ataxia and right upper-limb weakness (3/5). No skin infection was noted; authors suggest entry via minor oropharyngeal mucosal injuries. After multidisciplinary care and MRSA-targeted antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L in 3 days; fever resolved; patient regained consciousness, right-arm weakness and ataxia improved; follow-up imaging showed reduced vegetations and resolved brain lesions. Emphasizes vigilance for persistent fever and subtle signs indicating endocarditis.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い咽頭炎と思われたが、16歳女子学生が『スーパーバグ』に脳と心臓を攻撃される
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による感染性心内膜炎の重症化症例であり、重症度基準を満たすが、単一症例報告であり国家レベルの異常や国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠がない。続報による流行兆候の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例はベトナムSon La省における16歳女性の重症MRSA感染症（敗血症性心内膜炎、脳梗塞、小脳出血）の単一症例報告。適切な抗生物質治療により軽快している。IHR基準では『深刻な公衆衛生影響』に該当するが、患者数、流行性、国際的拡大の証拠がなく、MRSA自体は既知の病原体であり『異常性』は低い。WPROスクリーニング基準では『重症度』に該当するのみ。情報源がローカルメディアであり、公式な感染症監視データの報告不明。単一症例であるため、より多くの症例が報告されるまでは経過観察段階が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến khó đoán, nhiều ca chuyển nặng nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever progresses unpredictably, many cases quickly become severe.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever continues to threaten public health as cases rise and progression is unpredictable. In 2025 Vietnam reported more than 181,000 dengue cases and 43 deaths. Globally, dengue infects about 390 million annually, with roughly 500,000 hospitalizations and over 40,000 deaths. Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Early symptoms: sudden high fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, and rash; without close monitoring, patients can quickly develop shock, severe bleeding, ARDS, liver and kidney failure, or neurologic damage. Even after critical illness, long-term sequelae such as hair loss, cognitive impairment, and insomnia may persist. NS1 testing can be negative early; follow-up laboratory tests and clinical observation are essential. WHO-recommended vaccines, approved in more than 40 countries, should be part of a comprehensive strategy, alongside vector control (mosquito elimination, larval source reduction, bed nets). Vaccination enhances protection but does not replace preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の進展予測困難、多くの症例が急速に重症化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では重症度が高く異常性が認められ（2項目該当）、WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・流行感受性・管理可能性の3項目が該当。ベトナムを含むWPRO地域でのデング熱流行が続いており、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ベトナム・ディエンビエン省でのデング熱流行報告。2025年のベトナムでの報告数は18万1千例以上、死亡43例。世界では年390万人感染、50万人入院、4万人以上死亡。予測困難な進展、急速な重症化、長期的後遺症（脱毛、認知機能障害、不眠症など）が報告されている。NS1検査初期陰性の可能性があり、継続的な検査と臨床観察が必須。WHO推奨ワクチンが40ヶ国以上で承認されているが、蚊対策と併用が重要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito menace, poor sanitation raise dengue fears in Madurai city
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, dengue concerns rise in Madurai city, India, with residents of Sadasiva Nagar, Ward 37, reporting fever cases amid deteriorating sanitation and stagnant water. Maraimalai Adigal Street resident Syed Basha claims at least three dengue cases. Corporation officials say only one dengue case has been laboratory-confirmed to date and that preventive measures are being deployed. The mosquito problem is attributed to poor sanitation, stagnant water, and issues with the newly installed underground drainage (UGD) system, including sewage overflow despite limited household connections. The report underscores dengue risk in Madurai and calls for prompt sanitation improvements and vector-control efforts to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊による被害と不衛生さがマドゥライ市のデング熱の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の確認症例は限定的（1件）であり、IHR基準の該当数が不明確であるが、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性（局所的な複数疑い症例と環境要因）と流行しやすさ（蚊媒介、不衛生な条件）が認識される。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 確認症例は1件のみ（疑い症例は複数報告されている）。原因は局所的な衛生問題（不十分な下水道システム、淀んだ水）と蚊の繁殖である。インドのタミル・ナードゥ州における季節的なデング熱発生であり、予防・駆除対策が進行中。国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、地域的には流行しやすい条件が存在する。続報によって症例数と公衆衛生対応の進展を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Siêu vi khuẩn tấn công não và tim nữ sinh 16 tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superbugs Attack the Brain and Heart of a 16-Year-Old Female Student.
article.articleSummary: MRSA septicemia with acute infectious endocarditis and multifocal cerebral infarction with intracerebral hemorrhage in a 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam. After five days of antibiotics for presumed pharyngitis, persistent high fever (39–40°C), tachycardia, hypotension, and Janeway lesions on hands/feet prompted transfer to the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases. Blood cultures confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Echocardiography revealed severe mitral valve regurgitation with vegetations and two eccentric jets (4 mm and 5 mm). Neuroimaging showed scattered cerebral infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhage, causing ataxia and right-arm weakness (3/5). Pneumonia was a concurrent complication. History includes known mitral valve prolapse with regurgitation diagnosed in June 2025. After aggressive MRSA-directed antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L within 3 days; fever resolved, neurological function improved, and brain MRI showed no residual lesions. Highlights need for early echocardiography in prolonged fever and Janeway lesions as markers of endocarditis.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバクテリアが16歳の女子生徒の脳と心臓を攻撃
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重篤な合併症（感染性心内膜炎、脳梗塞）の個別事例であり、重症度は高い。しかし集団発生またはアウトブレイクの兆候は報告されておらず、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生政策への広範な影響は不明。
triage.notes: 本件はMRSA感染症の個別重篤事例である。患者は既往疾患（僧帽弁逸脱）を持つ免疫易罹患者と考えられる。報告されている情報範囲では、コミュニティでの継続的な曝露、ヒト-ヒト感染の高リスク、または集団発生の兆候は示唆されていない。ベトナム国内の医療システムが適切に対応したことが示唆されている。今後、同地域でのMRSA関連感染症の増加傾向に関する追加情報により判定が変わる可能性がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Nova cepa do vírus da Mpox recombinante preocupa OMS e testes mostram que antiviral mais usado não é eficaz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New recombinant Mpox virus strain concerns WHO, and tests show that the most commonly used antiviral is not effective.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) faces a new recombinant strain, combining elements of clades Ib (Central Africa) and IIb (global 2022 outbreak). WHO notes conventional PCR cannot identify the recombinant; full-genome sequencing is required. Two travel-associated confirmed cases—UK and India—imply broader spread across at least four countries in three WHO regions. Clinically, tecovirimat (the main orthopox antiviral) did not improve outcomes in the STOMP randomized trial (NEJM 2026) for clade II mpox: 83% lesion resolution with treatment vs 84% with placebo; pain reduction and viral clearance were similar. PALM007 in DR Congo found similar results for clade I. Vulnerable groups (immunocompromised, pregnant individuals, children) were underrepresented. Africa: 26 countries reported >139,000 suspected cases and ~1,788 deaths (Jan 2024–May 2025). Brazil: clade Ib confirmed in São Paulo, March 2025, changing risk profile. Recommendations: enhance genomic surveillance, revise clinical protocols, prioritize vaccination now for at-risk groups, and ensure monitoring for imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 新型組み換えMpoxウイルス株がWHOの懸念を招き、試験では最も一般的に使用される抗ウイルス薬が有効でないことが判明
triage.triage_reason: Mpox組み換え株（Clade Ib/IIbハイブリッド）の複数国での確認、従来の主要抗ウイルス薬（テコビリマット）の無効性が判明、7カ国4地域にまたがる国際的拡大リスク、Africa地域での大規模疫学的負荷（139,000以上の疑い例、1,788死亡）がIHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数該当。
triage.notes: 新規組み換え株はゲノムシーケンシングが必須（従来PCRでは検出不可）。主要抗ウイルス薬無効性の確認（NEJM 2026論文引用）は治療戦略の再構築を要求。アフリカでの高い患者数・死亡数と複数地域への国際的拡大（UK、India、Brazil確認）により、国際的懸念の高い事象。ワクチンと監視強化が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: FMD vaccination drive for cattle in AP from today under National Animal Disease Control Programme
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-M mouth Disease vaccination drive underway in Andhra Pradesh from March 16 to April 29, 2026, under the National Animal Disease Control Programme. Free vaccines will be administered to cattle and buffaloes; staff will visit livestock owners’ homes. A total of 83.69 lakh doses have been distributed to districts to cover animals in two phases: main round March 16–April 14, followed by a booster and remaining coverage April 15–29. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle and buffaloes, particularly cross-bred animals with weaker immunity, causing reduced milk production, weakness, diminished working capacity, and calf deaths, with heavy economic losses. Symptoms include high fever, blistering in the mouth and hooves, and drooling; recovery may take up to six months. Vaccination is presented as the only effective preventive measure; farmers urged to participate.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州での全国動物疾病管理計画に基づく口蹄疫ワクチン接種キャンペーン本日開始
triage.triage_reason: 本事象は動物疾病の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、既存の疾病流行や公衆衛生危機ではなく、計画的な制御措置の実施である。人間への直接的な影響や国際的な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症危機（disease outbreak）ではなく、動物疾病の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの通常の実施に関するニュース。口蹄疫（FMD）は家畜疾病であり、IHR(2005)の対象となる人獣共通感染症ではないため、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah Aceh rencanakan pembangunan selter tangani kasus Rabies - ANTARA News Aceh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Aceh government plans to build shelters to handle rabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Rabies control efforts in Aceh involve building shelters for stray dogs to curb rabies after cases detected in Bireuen district. The plan, announced by Safridhal, Head of Aceh Province Department of Animal Husbandry, envisions capturing stray dogs and relocating them to regions where households keep dogs, such as Medan, North Sumatra. Authorities emphasize a humane, systematic approach; elimination of stray dogs is no longer permitted. As an initial step, the animal health team has conducted field vaccination of pets in Bireuen to interrupt animal-to-human transmission. Aceh's key strategies include active vaccination campaigns, public education on rabies risks and proper animal care, ongoing outreach, and prioritization of a dedicated budget for broader rabies vaccination. The government continues to promote vaccination efforts in Bireuen.

triage.headline_ja: アチェ州政府、狂犬病対策のための犬舎建設を計画
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・アチェ州でビルウェン地区に狂犬病症例が検出され、当局が対策（野犬の収容施設建設、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）を実施中。既知の動物由来感染症への対応段階であり、現時点では国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトの明示的証拠は記事に記載されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病症例がビルウェン地区で「検出された」ことを述べているが、症例数、死亡者、重症度の具体的データは記載されていない。野犬の放浪と継続的な人間への曝露可能性があり、狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物由来であるため、対策の有効性によって大きく左右される。アチェ州当局は明らかに対応中であり、外部支援の必要性は記事では示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công não, tim khiến thiếu nữ 16 tuổi nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Superbugs' attack the brain and heart, leaving a 16-year-old girl in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: 16-year-old girl from Son La Province, Vietnam, presented with severe sepsis and high fever (39–40°C), tachycardia, hypotension, and petechiae on palms and soles, indicating infectious endocarditis. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Imaging revealed bilateral scattered cerebral infarctions with concomitant cerebellar hemorrhage causing ataxia and right-sided weakness (3/5). Echocardiography showed mitral valve vegetations with severe mitral regurgitation. The patient had multi-organ involvement, including pneumonia, and was diagnosed with MRSA bacteremia, acute infectious endocarditis, and brain injury. After three days of targeted MRSA antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L; fever resolved; mobility recovered; right motor deficit resolved; cerebellar function improving; repeat MRI brain showed no remaining lesions and echocardiography vegetations reduced. Discharge expected within the week. Notably, no skin lesions; infection possibly entered via minor oral/throat mucosal lesions. Clinicians warn that persistent high fever with no response to standard therapy warrants consideration of severe disseminated infection.

triage.headline_ja: 'スーパーバグ'が脳と心臓を攻撃し、16歳の少女が重篤な状態に
triage.triage_reason: MRSA単一症例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と異常性が認識されるが、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」は不明確。個別症例の医学的重要性は高いが、公衆衛生的な集団発生の証拠がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本報告は単一の重症MRSA症例（感染性心内膜炎、脳梗塞を伴う）であり、個別の医学的関心は高いが、集団発生・アウトブレイクの証拠がない。WPROスクリーニング基準でIHR基準の2項目を満たすが、医療対応可能で国際的拡大の懸念が不明確なため、WATCHに分類。ベトナムにおけるMRSA流行状況の追加情報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: आरोग्यमंत्र्यांच्या माहितीचा बुरखा टराटरा फाटला, घाटीमध्ये रेबीजच्या लसीचा तुटवडा; रुग्णांना मोठा भुर्दंड
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister's information cloak torn apart; rabies vaccine shortage in the valley; patients endure a heavy ordeal.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine shortage hits government hospitals in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, despite state claims of sufficient stock. Health Minister Prakash Abitkar told the Legislative Council that rabies prophylaxis supplies are ample, but residents report shortages in the city, forcing them to buy vaccines from outside and have them administered in public hospitals. The gap between official assurances and on-ground access raises concerns about vaccine provisioning, supply chains, and affordability. Patients endure delays in post-exposure prophylaxis and variable care quality as they navigate external purchases. The report underscores the urgent need for transparent stock data, reliable distribution, and policies to ensure equitable access to rabies vaccination within public facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣の情報発表の信ぴょう性が揺らぐ；マハラシュトラ州でのいくつかの地域でのリーズ狂犬病ワクチンの不足；患者は大きな困難に直面
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はYellowリスト疾患（致死的）だが、今回の報告は供給不足に関する懸念であり、新規発生事例ではない。ワクチン供給チェーンの問題は公衆衛生上の重要な懸念だが、感染症発生そのものではなく、現状では情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本レポートは狂犬病事例ではなく、チャトラパティ・サンバージナガル（マハラシュトラ州）の政府病院でのワクチン供給不足に関する報道。オングラウンド情報と政府発表の乖離が懸念される。狂犬病患者数、実際の発生トレンド、供給量・需要量の具体的データが記事に含まれていない。ワクチンアクセス問題は公衆衛生上重要だが、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては続報により患者発生状況の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng chỉ sốt viêm họng, nữ sinh bất ngờ nguy kịch vì "siêu vi khuẩn" tấn công
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A female student who thought it was just fever and sore throat suddenly falls into critical condition as a superbug attacks.
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, a 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam, was admitted in critical condition to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases with MRSA bacteremia causing acute infectious endocarditis, pneumonia, and multifocal cerebral infarctions with intracerebral hemorrhage. She had a history of mitral valve regurgitation diagnosed in June 2025. She presented with high fever (up to 40°C), rigors, sore throat, and later developed Janeway lesions and nonpainful petechiae on the hands and feet. Blood culture confirmed MRSA. Imaging showed severe mitral regurgitation (two eccentric jets), pneumonia, brain infarcts with hemorrhage, and right arm weakness (3/5). Following urgent multidisciplinary discussion, a MRSA-directed antibiotic regimen was started. After 3 days, fever resolved, infection markers fell, consciousness returned, right arm strength recovered, and echocardiography showed reduced vegetations; MRI brain showed no prior lesions. Clinicians note MRSA can enter via mucosal surfaces and urge early evaluation for persistent fever and endocarditis signs.

triage.headline_ja: 喉の痛みと発熱だと思っていた女子学生が、耐性菌の襲撃により突然重篤な状態に陥る
triage.triage_reason: MRSA菌血症による感染性心内膜炎と脳梗塞を伴う16歳女性の重篤事例であり、重症度が高く、予防可能なリスク警告として公衆衛生の教育的価値がある。WPROスクリーニング基準において重症度と管理可能性で該当する。
triage.notes: 単一事例だが重症度が極めて高く、MRSA感染症の臨床的な啓発事例として重要。流行の兆候ではなく、粘膜からの侵入経路と早期診断の重要性を強調する医学的教訓を含む。ベトナム国内での管理下にあり国際的な伝播リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Toxocarose chez un homme de 62 ans atteint d'éosinophilie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toxocariasis in a 62-year-old man with eosinophilia.
article.articleSummary: North America under-recognizes toxocariasis as a cause of acute eosinophilia. Diagnosis relies on exposure history, clinical symptoms, eosinophilia, elevated IgE, and toxocara serology. A 62-year-old man with hypertension and chronic kidney disease presented with abdominal pain, then recurrent visits with facial edema, myalgias, and a nonproductive cough; later developed dyspnea. He developed acute kidney injury and marked eosinophilia (6.7 × 10^9/L) with leukocytosis; RSV was detected. Despite IV fluids, albumin, and corticosteroids (for suspected IgA nephropathy associated with RSV), eosinophilia persisted and raised concern for eosinophilic myocarditis due to rising troponin and BNP. He was transferred to a tertiary care center 12 days after the first emergency visit. Born in the Philippines, with prior residence in Saudi Arabia and Iran before immigrating to Canada; no recent animal exposure; works in waste management with PPE; IgE elevated; mastocytosis/lymphoma excluded; toxocara serology results not reported here.

triage.headline_ja: 好酸球増加症を伴う62歳男性のトキソカラ症
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生的に深刻な影響や国際的な流行の兆候がない。RSV検出は記載されているが、主要な臨床問題はトキソカラ症の診断遅延に関する学習教訓である。
triage.notes: 複数国にまたがる発症地域の記載（フィリピン、サウジアラビア、イラン、カナダ）は患者の移動履歴を示すものであり、疾患の国際的流行を示す証拠ではない。医学誌への単一症例報告であり、トキソカラ症の診断困難性に関する医療教育的価値が主眼と考えられる。RSVの検出は記載されているが、本事例の中心課題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng viêm họng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi bị "siêu vi khuẩn" tấn công não, tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mistaking it for a mild sore throat, a 16-year-old female student was attacked by a 'superbug' that invaded her brain and heart.
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, a 16-year-old female student from Son La, Vietnam, was treated at the National Institute of Tropical Diseases after a misdiagnosed sore throat progressed to severe MRSA infection. She presented with 39–40°C fever, tachycardia (130 bpm), hypotension, and nonpainful petechiae on palms and soles. Blood cultures grew methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Imaging and tests showed acute septicemia, infective endocarditis with vegetations on the mitral valve and heavy regurgitation, pneumonia due to Staphylococcus aureus, and multiple scattered cerebral infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhage causing ataxia and right arm weakness. The diagnosis: MRSA septicemia, acute bacterial endocarditis, septic emboli to brain with intracerebral hemorrhage, and secondary pneumonia. After 3 days of aggressive MRSA-targeted antibiotics, she improved; fever subsided, inflammatory markers fell, mitral vegetations shrank, and follow-up brain MRI showed no new lesions. Notably, no skin lesions; presumed entry via oral mucosa.

triage.headline_ja: 喉の軽い炎症だと思い込んでいた16歳の女子学生が「スーパーバクテリア」に脳と心臓を襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: メチシリン耐性黄色ブドウ球菌（MRSA）による重篤な敗血症・感染性心内膜炎の個別症例報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」（死亡リスク・多臓器障害）と「異常/予想外」（軽度の症状から急速に進行）に該当。また、抗菌薬耐性菌による侵襲性感染症は管理可能性と国際的関心の観点からもシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告であり、集団発生やアウトブレークの兆候は記事から認識されない。しかし、抗菌薬耐性菌（MRSA）による侵襲性感染症であり、診断遅延による急速な進行が報告されている点が懸念される。口腔粘膜からの感染経路の推定は、一般的な経路ではなく注視が必要。フルRRAでは臨床転帰、ベトナム国内の類似症例の有無、地域の抗菌薬耐性サーベイランスデータを確認することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng viêm họng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi bị 'siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công não, tim suýt mất mạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thought it was a mild sore throat, a 16-year-old female student was attacked by a 'superbug' that invaded her brain, and her heart nearly stopped.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, a 16-year-old girl from Son La Province, Vietnam, developed MRSA septicemia with multi-organ involvement after high fever and sore throat were misdiagnosed as acute tonsillitis. She later exhibited persistent fever, fatigue, delirium, and Janeway lesions on the hands and feet, prompting transfer to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi. Blood cultures confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Echocardiography revealed infectious endocarditis with vegetations on the mitral valve and severe mitral regurgitation; CT/MRI showed scattered brain infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhages, causing ataxia and right arm paralysis. Diagnoses: MRSA septicemia, acute infectious endocarditis, cerebral infarcts with intracerebral hemorrhage, and secondary pneumonia. After 3 days of intensive MRSA-directed therapy and multidisciplinary care, her condition improved markedly. Likely entry via minor oral/mucosal injury rather than skin lesions; persistent fever with new signs warrants early invasive evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い喉の炎症だと思われていた16歳の女子学生が「スーパーバグ」に脳と心臓を侵襲され、死ぬ寸前だった
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重症感染症単一症例報告であり、個別の重篤化事例として注目されるが、IHR基準を満たす国際的な流行の懸念や広がりのリスク、対策不可能性の示唆が記事から明確ではない。医療機関での対応と治療成功が記述されており、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本事例はIHR基準2つ以上を満たすが、MRSA自体は周知の病原体であり、単一症例の重症化報告である。ベトナムの医療機関での診断・治療が適切に実施され、患者の状態が改善しているため、ただちにフルRRAが必要とは判断されない。ただし、診断遅延による重症化メカニズム、地域内での類似患者発生の有無など追加情報の収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng viêm họng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi nguy kịch do siêu vi khuẩn kháng thuốc tấn công
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mistaken for a mild sore throat, 16-year-old female student in critical condition from antibiotic-resistant superbug attack.
article.articleSummary: A 16-year-old girl, Đ.T.N., from Sơn La, Vietnam, presented with sore throat and high fever but deteriorated into a critical MRSA infection. Laboratory confirmation identified methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). The infection caused pneumonia, infective endocarditis with severe mitral regurgitation, and neurological involvement including multiple cerebral infarcts and cerebellar hemorrhages, with Janeway lesions observed on the extremities. Despite no skin wounds, the bacterium likely entered via mucosal surfaces. After urgent, targeted antibiotic therapy, inflammatory marker CRP dropped from above 200 mg/L to 10 mg/L within 3 days; fever resolved; she became alert, regained motor function in the right arm, and MRI demonstrated resolution of brain lesions and reduced valvular vegetation. Clinicians highlight early recognition of persistent high fever, small-vessel hemorrhagic signs, and echocardiographic assessment to prevent severe cardiac and neurologic sequelae from MRSA.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い喉の炎症と勘違い、16歳の女子学生が抗生物質耐性菌の攻撃で危機的状態に
triage.triage_reason: MRSAによる個別の重症症例（脳梗塞、心内膜炎を伴う）であり、診断と治療が確立している。IHR基準では該当なし（公衆衛生への重大な影響なし、国際的拡大リスク低い）。ただしWPRO基準では重症度基準に該当し、臨床教育的価値があるため経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: 本事例は個別の重症化症例であり、MRSA集団感染や流行を示すシグナルではない。患者は治療に反応して回復中である。抗生物質耐性菌の臨床管理に関する教育的価値は認められるが、疫学的な異常事態ではない。ベトナムのメディア報道（健康・医療系ポータル）からのピックアップのため、公的な疫学情報ではなく症例報告的性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Kolhapur Adamapur Yatra : बाळूमामांच्या यात्रेत विषबाधा; रथोत्सवावेळी वाटप केलेल्या लस्सीमुळे शंभरांवर भाविकांना विषबाधा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kolhapur Adamapur Yatra: Poisoning during Balumama's pilgrimage; over a hundred devotees poisoned due to the lassi distributed during the Rathotsav.
article.articleSummary: Over 100 devotees experienced vomiting and diarrhea after consuming free lassi distributed during the Rathotsav at Adamapur Yatra in Bhudargad taluka, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra (as of March 16, 2026). The incident occurred during Balumama's pilgrimage, with attendees from Karnataka state and Maharashtra's Solapur, Sangli, Miraj, Baramati, Jalna, and Kolhapur districts affected. The report attributes the illness to the open-lassi served at the event; laboratory confirmation and investigations are not described. This marks a mass beverage-related food poisoning linked to a religious gathering, highlighting cross-district participation in the Adamapur yatra. No further clinical details, patient triage, or public health advisories are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コルハプル アダマプル ヤートラ: バルママの巡礼中の食中毒; ラトホツサフ期間に配布されたラッシーにより百人以上の信者が食中毒
triage.triage_reason: 100人以上の食中毒患者が発生した集団発生事象であり、複数州にまたがる参加者が影響を受けており、宗教集会という社会的関心の高い文脈において発生している。IHR基準の異常性および重症度、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 食中毒の原因は記事で「屋外で配布されたラッシー」と特定されているが、微生物学的確認の有無が不明。複数の州（マハーラシュトラ州、カルナータカ州）からの参加者が影響を受けているため、疫学調査の必要性が高い。宗教集会という集団感染リスク環境での発生であり、公衆衛生的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dry Cough Epidemic: मौसम बदलते ही बढ़ी सूखी खांसी की समस्या, डॉक्टर बोले- ये वायरस हो सकते हैं जिम्मेदार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dry Cough Epidemic: As the weather changes, the problem of dry cough has increased; doctors say these viruses may be responsible.
article.articleSummary: Uptick in dry cough presentations in Kolkata, India, over the past weeks as seasonal weather shifts, with daytime heat and cooler evenings and possible rainfall forecast. Doctors report patients visiting OPDs with dry cough, sore throat, fatigue, and mild fever; many cases persist beyond a couple of days. Experts attribute the symptoms to several common upper-respiratory viruses, including Adenovirus, Rhinovirus, Metapneumovirus, and Enterovirus, which typically affect the nose, throat, and airways and can trigger persistent dry coughing. The changing climate appears to increase susceptibility as bodies adjust. No lab-confirmed outbreak data or case counts are provided. The article emphasizes symptomatology and a likely viral etiology rather than a single pathogen, noting that management is supportive and that the pattern is being observed in Kolkata’s outpatient departments during this transitional weather period (as of 16 March 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 乾いた咳の流行：季節の変化に伴い乾いた咳の問題が増加。医師は複数のウイルスが原因の可能性があると述べている
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の上気道ウイルス感染によるとみられる乾咳の増加がKolkataで報告されているが、検査確認症例数、正式な発症者数、重症度の具体的データが全く提供されておらず、公式な集団発生宣言もない。IHR基準の該当性判定には情報が不足しているため、引き続き確認情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の一般的な上気道ウイルス感染症（アデノウイルス、ライノウイルス、メタニューモウイルス、エンテロウイルス）の増加傾向に関する医学的見解の報道であり、公式な集団発生警報ではない。発症者数、重症度、入院数、死亡例などの具体的なデータが全く提供されていない。季節変動による一時的な増加の可能性が高く、支持療法が主治療とされている点から、直ちにIHR基準を満たす公衆衛生上の重大な懸念とは判定されない。ただし、複数のウイルスに関する記事であり、今後の確認報告に注視することが適切である。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Depok beri penjelasan pencegahan penyakit campak - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Depok City Health Office explains measles prevention - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleSummary: Measles in Depok, West Java, is being addressed by the Depok City Health Office. The disease spreads via respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or talks, with high fever and a red rash caused by the Morbillivirus. Prevention emphasizes Hygiene and Clean Living Behaviors (PHBS): handwashing with soap and running water, proper cough etiquette, and wearing masks when early symptoms appear. Residents should verify measles immunization status per schedule: first dose at 9 months, second at 18 months, and a dose in 1st grade; those with incomplete schedules can catch up at Posyandu. Suspected cases should seek the nearest health facility and isolate if diagnosed. In 2025, Depok reported 1,365 suspected measles cases, of which 144 were laboratory-confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: デポック市保健局が麻疹予防について説明 - ANTARA News メガポリタン
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州での麻疹集団発生（2025年確認患者144名を含む1,365疑い患者）であり、IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」に該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹は予防接種で防止可能な感染症だが、ワクチン接種率が不十分な地域での流行が顕著。2025年に1,365疑い患者、144確定患者が報告されており、継続的な発生が懸念される。記事配信日は2026年3月であり、outbreak ongoing状態と推定される。デポック市保健局による公式な予防啓発活動が実施されていることから、当局も認識・対応している。

article.articleHeadline: Vijetnam otkrio kako protiv denga-groznice
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has discovered how to combat dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports a breakthrough against dengue fever using Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. Globally, about 390 million people are infected with dengue annually. Researchers infected local mosquitoes with the Wolbachia bacterium from Drosophila (vinegar fly), creating mosquitoes in which the dengue virus is outcompeted; this resistance appears heritable. After crossing local mosquito populations, seventh-generation offspring are expected to carry Wolbachia and local genes, enabling adaptation to the environment. Field release began on Tri Nujen Island off central Vietnam, where Wolbachia mosquitoes rapidly outnumbered dengue-carrying ones. Local clinicians note changes: over a year with no dengue patients on the island. The program may expand across Vietnam, with Indonesia planning similar trials and Singapore cited as a potential site (over 10,000 dengue cases this year). If successful, dengue infections are expected to decline as Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes spread, potentially aiding millions in at-risk regions.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムがデング熱対策の方法を発見
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の革新的な制御手段（ウォルバキア菌を利用した生物学的防除）に関する報道であり、技術的・学術的関心は高いが、現時点では新規の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、既知疾患の管理戦略の進展に関する記事。情報不足により慎重に判定。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の新規発生ではなく、既知疾患に対する革新的な生物学的防除方法（ウォルバキア菌利用）の開発・導入に関する報道である。ベトナム、インドネシア、シンガポールで展開予定と記載されており、地域的関心と学術的関心は高い。ただし、アウトブレイク検出（シグナル検出）という視点ではなく、疾患管理戦略の進展であるため、WATCHレベルとした。フルRRAは不要だが、同技術の展開状況と効果の続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat leads Foot and Mouth Disease vaccination drive
article.articleSummary: Gujarat's intensive Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination drive runs March 1–April 15 under the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP), targeting cloven-hoofed livestock across Gujarat, including Gandhinagar and Lodra. The digital INAPH portal tracks vaccination coverage and animal health. FMD symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, excessive salivation and reduced milk production, causing significant losses for dairy farmers. Veterinary Officer Bhavin Kumar notes vaccinations occur twice yearly (March and September) to prevent outbreaks. In Lodra, a farmer owns 33 cows and two buffaloes; the village has about 750 cattle and other livestock, with around 40% vaccinated so far. Officials stress sustained large-scale vaccination as essential for disease control, potential eradication, and safeguarding farmer livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州が口蹄疫ワクチン接種キャンペーンを主導
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は重要な動物疾患であるが、本記事は定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規発生やアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は国家動物疾病制御プログラム（NADCP）下での定期的なワクチン接種駆動キャンペーンの報道である。現在のアウトブレイクや急拡大は報告されていない。口蹄疫は人間には感染しない動物疾患（Annex2適用外）であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat leads Foot and Mouth Disease vaccination drive
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, Gujarat (India) has launched an intensive statewide vaccination drive against Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) under the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP). The campaign began on March 1 and will run through April 15, targeting cloven-hoofed livestock to curb disease spread and safeguard dairy farmers from production losses. FMD is a highly contagious viral infection causing fever, mouth ulcers and excessive salivation, with milk yield and overall productivity often sharply reduced. To ensure coverage and traceability, vaccinated animals are identified via ear-tagging and their records uploaded to the INAPH Information Network for Animal Productivity and Health portal, enabling authorities to monitor vaccination progress and animal health across Gujarat. The effort emphasizes vaccination, surveillance, and digital tracking to protect livestock health and farmer livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州が口蹄疫ワクチン接種キャンペーンを主導
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは動物に限定された口蹄疫のワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、人間への公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威がない。ヒト-ヒト感染なく、既知の疾患に対する予防的措置である。
triage.notes: 影響カテゴリが「animals」に限定され、人間への感染・疾病報告がない。報告内容は家畜のワクチン接種キャンペーン（既知疾患への公衆衛生対応）であり、新興感染症の警告信号ではない。IHR通知基準およびWPROシグナル基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Soroti Marak Anak Idap Penyakit TBC: Ini Malapetaka!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim Highlights the Rampant Rise of Children Suffering from Tuberculosis: This Is a Calamity!
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks as the second-worst country globally for health, especially tuberculosis (TB), behind India, according to Hashim Pencanangan Pembangunan Hunian Dalam Rangka Mendukung Program 3 Juta Rumah at Manggarai Station, Jakarta, on 16 March 2026. He links the TB surge to housing near slums and crowded living conditions, noting that the combined pressures in India and Indonesia contribute to many children contracting TB. A free health-check program reportedly confirmed a high TB burden among children and the general population. Health Minister and Deputy Health Minister corroborated the TB prevalence and its association with stunting, calling it a calamity for Indonesia. The remarks underscore urgent housing and public-health interventions to curb pediatric TB and overall transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム氏、結核患者の急増する子どもたちの問題を指摘：これは大惨事だ！
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける小児結核の増加が報告されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性がありますが、公開情報は政治的発言に基づいており、具体的な患者数、発生規模、国際的拡大の詳細情報が不足しています。続報の監視が必要です。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、「異常」というより「既存問題の悪化」と考えられます。記事はインドネシア政府高官の公式発言であり、社会的・政治的関心は高まっていますが、具体的な疫学データ（患者数、発生率の変化、死亡数）が不足しています。スラム近隣や過密住居との関連が指摘されており、人口密集地での感染拡大リスクあり。続報でより詳細な流行統計が提供されることを注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat launches massive FMD vaccination drive to protect livestock
article.articleSummary: Gujarat launched a statewide Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination drive under the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP) to run from March 1 to April 15, 2026. The effort targets cloven-hooved livestock—cattle, buffaloes, sheep and goats—and aims to curb FMD-linked fever, mouth ulcers, excessive salivation and declines in milk production, which threaten farmers’ livelihoods. A modern approach uses ear-tagging and uploads details to the INAPH portal to monitor vaccination coverage and animal health. Veterinary officer Bhavin Kumar notes vaccines are administered twice yearly, in March and September, to prevent outbreaks. In Lodra, approximately 750 cattle and other livestock exist, with about 40% already vaccinated during the ongoing drive, and local farmers voicing strong support. Officials emphasize sustained, large-scale vaccination to move toward eradication and protect dairy livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州が家畜保護のため大規模なFMD予防接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本件は動物疾患の予防接種キャンペーン報道であり、アウトブレイク或いは危機的状況の発生ではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症危機ではなく、政策的な動物衛生管理活動（予防接種キャンペーン）の報道である。FMDは動物疾患であり人獣共通感染症ではない。ブルードットが検出した理由は地名とFMDキーワードの組み合わせと考えられるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Botswana counts the FMD crisis cost | Sunday Standard
article.articleSummary: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) outbreaks in Botswana are counting the crisis cost on its beef industry, with Namibia joining the restrictions. The FMD crisis risks eroding Botswana's beef market diversification gains as export agreements with the UAE, DRC, and China appear vulnerable. Namibia's Directorate of Veterinary Services, under the MAF WLR, issued an immediate restriction on the importation and in-transit movement of cloven-hoofed animals and their products from Botswana, covering personal-use products from zones 1, 1a, 2a-2f, 3a-3c, 6a-6b, 7, and 16. The bans underscore the economic impact of the FMD crisis on Botswana's cattle sector and ongoing outbreak management measures as of 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: ボツワナ、FMD危機コストを集計 | Sunday Standard
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は動物疾患ながら、複数国（ボツワナ、ナミビア、UAE、中国）での同時発生・拡大報告、国際貿易制限の実行、経済的影響の深刻性により、IHR基準2項目以上を満たす。国際的な家畜貿易停止と各国の輸入制限措置が発動中であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 動物疾患であるが、複数国の公式な輸入禁止措置が発動中。ボツワナの牛肉産業に対する経済的打撃、UAE・DRC・中国への輸出合意が危機的状況。ナミビアの獣医局による正式な制限通知が確認され、地域的な拡大を示唆している。FMDの感染性の高さと家畜商品の国際流通リスクを踏まえ、PICKUPに分類。
