article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly avian influenza outbreak threatens California's coasts.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has hit California’s coastline, centering on Año Nuevo State Park in the Bay Area, where at least 47 northern elephant seals have died. The virus has also been detected in a California sea lion and a southern sea otter, prompting cancellation of park tours and advisories to avoid affected beaches. Health authorities say the risk to humans remains low, but contact with sick or dead wildlife should be avoided. The strain identified is HPAI lineage A3, first traced in Eurasia in 2022 before crossing the Pacific Flyway to California; it is the first time this virulent variant has reached the Pacific coast and is now affecting multiple species, including western gulls, common murres, Brandt’s Cormorants, and peregrine falcons. Laboratory-confirmed infections in the sea lion and sea otter underscore cross-species spread and the need for ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な鳥インフルエンザの発生がカリフォルニア州の海岸を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザA H5系統の多地域同時検出（米国カリフォルニア州とタイ）、複数種への越種感染の確認、ユーラシア由来A3系統の太平洋岸への初到達という異常性から、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 複数の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ亜型（H5N2、H5N1、H5N6、H5N8、H7N7、H5N5）が同時に検出されており、米国とタイという地理的に離れた2地域での発生が記録されている。カリフォルニア州ではA3系統（ユーラシア由来）の初の太平洋岸到達であり、海棲哺乳類への越種感染が実験室確認されている。パーク閉鎖と公衆衛生勧告が発令されており、ヒト感染リスク評価は必要。タイでの発生情報の詳細は記事本文に記載されていないため、別途情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah Perketat Karantina Akibat Virus Demam Babi Afrika Terdeteksi dalam Pakan Babi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Tightens Quarantine Due to African Swine Fever Virus Detected in Pig Feed.
article.articleSummary: As of March 16, 2026, Indonesia tightens quarantine across pig farms, slaughterhouses, and pig-feed production facilities after the African Swine Fever (ASF) virus was detected in pig feed. Authorities report the virus found during nationwide epidemiological investigations and farm inspections, with blood from infected pigs likely entering feed production and distribution. In response, officials ordered disposal of potentially contaminated feed and a recall of 490.5 tons from farms, halting sales. A third round of nationwide farm inspections is planned to finish by March 20, 2026, while 64 slaughterhouses are being tested to verify safety of pig blood used in feed. Measures aim to curb ASF spread via contaminated feed and ensure feed and blood components meet safety standards.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、アフリカ豚熱ウイルスが豚飼料で検出されたことを受けて検疫を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのASF発生は異常かつ予想外であり、感染豚の血液が飼料製造・流通を通じて汚染されている。490.5トンの飼料回収、64の屠畜場検査、全国的な農場検査など対応が展開中であり、家畜疾病の国際拡大リスク（飼料・血液成分の国際取引）および同国の管理能力に関わる懸念がある。
triage.notes: ASFはWHO監視対象の重要家畜疾病である。飼料・血液製品を通じた水平伝播が確認されており、東南アジア地域でのまん延リスク、豚肉製品の国際取引への影響が懸念される。インドネシアの対応は迅速だが、飼料汚染の程度および地域への波及状況の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Campak, Dinkes Kutim Minta Pemudik Jaga Kebersihan dan Bawa Hand Sanitizer - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Season, East Kutai Health Office Urges Returning Home Travelers to Maintain Hygiene and Bring Hand Sanitizer - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleSummary: Measles season prompts East Kutai Regency Health Office to urge Lebaran 2026 mudik travelers to boost hygiene and carry hand sanitizer to reduce transmission. In Kutai Timur (Sangatta), health authorities coordinate with police under Operation Ketupat Mahakam to support safe travel, with health posts and standby ambulances along routes. Free health screenings for bus and travel drivers are conducted at Sangatta’s Terminal Kilometer 3, ensuring drivers are healthy and able to operate; medical care and emergency kits are available at posts. Health services will also be deployed at popular tourist sites such as Pantai Kenyamukan during the holiday period. Yuwana Sri Kurniawati, head of the Dinkes Kutim, notes ongoing measles outbreaks in Indonesia, especially Java, and urges strict hygiene, handwashing, and masking if needed. The article does not provide local measles case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しんシーズン、東クタイ県保健局が帰郷者に衛生管理と手指消毒液携帯を促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻しん流行の継続を示唆する報道だが、特定の地域における具体的な患者数、重症度、国際的拡大リスクについて情報が不足している。経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 東クタイ県サンガッタおよびジャワを含むインドネシア全域での麻しん流行が継続中であることが記事から確認できる。ただし、当該地域の具体的な患者数、死亡数、重症例数が記事に記載されていないため、IHR基準の『深刻な公衆衛生への影響』の判定が困難である。WPROスクリーニングでは『長期曝露』（レバラン帰郷時期における継続的な感染リスク）と『流行しやすさ』（ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク）が該当する。ジャワでの流行が報告されているため、将来的な国際的拡大リスクについても注視が必要。追加情報の入手を継続する。

article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल के इस जिले में आई फ्लू ने दी दस्तक, जानें कैसे रखें ध्यान?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu arrives in this district of Himachal; learn how to stay safe.
article.articleSummary: Eye flu (conjunctivitis) has spread to Hamirpur district, Himachal Pradesh, as seasonal changes take hold. As of 2026-03-16, Hamirpur Medical College OPD records a rising number of eye infections, with 3–4 new cases daily. Transmission is by touch, so avoid handshakes with the infected and do not share towels, handkerchiefs, or glasses. Symptoms include red eyes, intense itching, burning, and watering; mornings often feature crusting of lids and gritty sensation. Infections may be viral or bacterial. Do not ignore swelling or increased light sensitivity. Practice frequent handwashing, refrain from touching eyes, and seek ophthalmologist advice promptly. Only use eye drops prescribed by a doctor.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマチャル・プラデシュ州のハミルプル地区にインフルエンザ到来；予防方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 結膜炎（目のインフルエンザ）の地域的な増加が報告されているが、情報が不足している。重症度、国際的拡大リスク、管理可能性について判断するにはさらなるデータが必要。
triage.notes: 報告されているのは結膜炎（目のインフルエンザ）であり、季節性のウイルス性または細菌性感染症と思われる。ハミルプル医科大学OPDで1日3～4件の新規症例が記録されているが、全体的な影響規模や地域での対応状況に関する情報が不足している。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（接触感染）と長期曝露リスクが識別されたため、スクリーニング基準2つに該当し、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор проверяет данные о вспышке кишечной инфекции на Пхукете
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor checks data on an outbreak of a gastrointestinal infection in Phuket.
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, Russian consumer safety agency Rospotrebnadzor reported sending a formal data request to Thailand's Ministry of Public Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) regarding reports of gastrointestinal infection cases among Russian tourists at a Phuket hotel. The ministry noted media reports described a 'mass illness of gastrointestinal infection and conjunctivitis' among Russian visitors; no outlet named. Rospotrebnadzor has asked for official investigation results and a risk assessment of potential worsening of the epidemiological situation. The request was made within the framework of the existing bilateral memorandum on sanitary-epidemiological welfare, and the agency said it has taken the situation under control.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナドゾル、プーケットでの腸管感染症の流行データを確認中
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの分類、複数国への影響（ロシア人観光客が関与）、結膜炎を伴う胃腸感染症という異常な組み合わせが示唆されるが、情報源がメディア報道であり公式な疫学的詳細が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患が'Unknown Illness'と分類されており、正確な病原体が特定されていない。記事では胃腸感染症と結膜炎の組み合わせと記載されているが、これは一般的な病原体パターンとしては異常である。患者数、重症度、具体的な臨床症状の詳細が不明。ロシア当局が正式なデータ要求を行っており、タイ保健省からの公式な調査結果を待つ段階。ホテルでのクラスター発生の可能性があり、観光客を通じた国際拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Magetan Temukan 10 Suspek Campak di 8 Kecamatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Magetan Health Office Finds 10 Suspected Measles Cases in Eight Sub-districts.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak concerns: In Magetan Regency, East Java, the Health Office reports 10 suspected measles cases across eight sub-districts; blood samples sent to the Surabaya-based Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat (BBLK) for further testing. Health official Suwantyo notes cases detected through week 9 of 2026; as of now, no positive measles confirmed in Magetan; suspects span various age groups and are under close surveillance by local health centers. He reminds measles can cause serious complications like pneumonia and encephalitis, especially in children or immunocompromised individuals. In 2025, there were 43 suspects in Magetan, with 3 confirmed positive; authorities plan intensified public education via flyers and PHBS promotion. Public vaccination hesitancy persists among a minority, fueled by fear and certain beliefs.

triage.headline_ja: マゲタン保健所が8つの郡部で10人の麻疹疑い患者を発見
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹と不明な脳炎の報告であり、IHR基準で異常性と重症合併症の可能性が認められるが、現在のところ確認症例がなく、情報が限定的なため。スクリーニング基準複数該当だが確実性に欠けるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準全5項目該当、しかし現地で確認症例がなく（10名は疑い患者）検査結果待機中。ワクチン忌避と脳炎の潜在的リスク言及あり。インドネシア東ジャワ州の地域的発生。続報（検査確定結果）で判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm họng tưởng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi nguy kịch vì 'siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công tim và não
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mild sore throat, 16-year-old female student in critical condition due to a 'superbug' attacking the heart and brain.
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, a 16-year-old female student in Son La Province, Vietnam, initially presenting with mild sore throat and high fever, developed a life-threatening MRSA infection. Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) invaded, causing infective endocarditis, cerebral infarction (stroke), and pneumonia. The patient remains in critical condition. This case illustrates how antibiotic-resistant pathogens can rapidly progress from common respiratory symptoms to severe, multi-organ disease in adolescents. No laboratory confirmation details or infection source are provided, and there is no information on ongoing outbreaks, or imported/exported cases. Published 16 March 2026, 13:48; report attributed to Thu Thuy.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い咽頭炎と思われたが、16歳女子学生が『スーパーバグ』による心臓と脳への攻撃で危機的状態に
triage.triage_reason: MRSA感染による重症化例（心内膜炎・脳梗塞・肺炎）の単発報告だが、院内感染の蔓延やアウトブレイク情報は不明。抗菌薬耐性菌の重症化リスクを示す事例として注視が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準では2項目該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも2項目該当している。ただし、本件は単一の重症化例報告であり、継続的な曝露リスク、流行可能性、管理可能性について情報が全く記載されていない。感染源不明、アウトブレイク情報なし、他の関連症例の報告もない。したがってPICKUP基準は満たさないが、社会的関心が高く、抗菌薬耐性菌による重症急性感染症の警告信号として経過観察の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tips Cegah Penularan Campak saat Libur Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tips to Prevent Measles Transmission During the Lebaran Holiday.
article.articleSummary: Measles vigilance in Indonesia ahead of Lebaran travel and Idul Fitri holidays. The Ministry of Health warns of potential surges of measles as people migrate (mudik) to hometowns, urging parents to complete their children's measles vaccination to prevent transmission. Measles is highly contagious; early prevention is key to keeping family gatherings safe. With Lebaran and mudik approaching, avoid spreading the disease and returning to cities and workplaces infected. In addition to vaccination, travelers should be prudent in visiting crowded attractions and avoid overly crowded venues to reduce exposure. Preventive measures include full immunization and adherence to healthy lifestyle and hygiene practices (PHBS): handwashing, access to clean water, sanitary toilets, regular exercise, and consumption of fruits and vegetables. School-based education is encouraged to emphasize measles vaccination before mudik; teachers are seen as vital in reminding students and parents. Goal: healthy celebrations and no transmission of dangerous diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ラマダン明けの休暇中の麻疹感染予防のヒント
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹の流行リスク警告であり、ラマダン明け（ムディク）の移動による感染拡大の可能性が指摘されているが、具体的な患者数や既存の流行規模が記事に記載されていない情報不足状態。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発が主体であり、進行中の流行や患者数、死亡報告などの具体的な発生状況が記載されていない。麻疹は高い感染性を持ち、ラマダン明けの大規模移動（ムディク）という流行しやすい条件が存在する。インドネシア保健省が警告を発しており政府関心は確認できるが、実際の流行規模や深刻度が不明なため、WATCH判定とした。続報での具体的患者数・地域別発生状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор проверяет информацию о вспышке инфекции на Пхукете // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor checks information about an infection outbreak in Phuket // NTV News
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor (Russian Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing) is reviewing media reports of a mass outbreak of intestinal infection and conjunctivitis on Phuket, Thailand. The agency has sent formal information requests to Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health and to the Association of Tour Operators Russia to verify the claims. The press release does not name the media outlet that published the information. The report describes a mass illness at a Phuket hotel but provides no laboratory confirmation, no patient counts, or timeline. The actions indicate an information-gathering step rather than an established outbreak, with officials seeking details on the situation, potential infection sources, and any public health responses in place.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、プーケットでの感染症流行情報を調査 // NTVニュース
triage.triage_reason: タイ・プーケットでの集団感染報告（腸炎およぴ結膜炎）が報告されており、ロシア当局が確認中。ただし検査室確認、患者数、詳細情報が欠落しており、情報不足のため直ちにはPICKUPせず経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 未確認情報（unconfirmed report）：患者数、臨床検査結果、感染源が記載されていない。ロシア当局が正式照会を送付した段階であり、タイ当局からの確認待ち。プーケットは国際観光地であるため、確認後は国際拡大リスク評価が必要。続報の入手を優先。

article.articleHeadline: 'Siêu vi khuẩn' tụ cầu vàng tấn công não và tim thiếu nữ 16 tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Superbug' Staphylococcus aureus attacks the brain and heart of a 16-year-old girl.
article.articleSummary: MRSA bacteremia in a 16-year-old girl from Sơn La, Vietnam, led to pneumonia, acute mitral valve endocarditis on a background of preexisting heart disease, and multiple cerebral embolic events with cerebellar hemorrhage. She initially presented with fever up to 40°C, chills, and sore throat; five days of antibiotics for pharyngitis failed to help, followed by septic shock with hypotension and a fingertip rash. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus. She was admitted to the National Institute of Infectious Diseases in Hanoi on 2026-03-13 and treated with a strong, targeted antibiotic regimen. After 3 days, inflammatory markers decreased, fever resolved, and she regained mobility; the right arm weakness resolved. Brain imaging showed no lasting damage, and echocardiography revealed a marked reduction of the mitral valve vegetation. Continuous care notes a favorable recovery as of 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: 「スーパーバグ」黄色ブドウ球菌が16歳少女の脳と心臓を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: MRSA菌血症による重症多臓器合併症（脳炎・心内膜炎）の個別症例報告。重症度は高いが単一症例であり、現在の患者状態は改善している。国際的な公衆衛生危機の兆候は現時点では不明だが、ベトナム国内での感染症動向把握のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ該当し、WPRO基準2つ該当するため、厳密にはPICKUP相当の条件を満たしている。ただし、以下の理由によりWATCHに判定した：(1)報告されているのは単一の重症症例であり、感染症流行や集団発生の証拠がない；(2)患者は現在改善中であり、新規感染の継続的なリスクが明確でない；(3)記事がメディア報道（ベトナムのニュースサイト）であり、公式な疫学情報ではない；(4)MRSA自体は既知の耐性菌であり、完全に新規な病原体ではない。ただし、脳・心臓への侵襲的合併症およびベトナムでの耐性菌の動向把握の観点から、続報情報が得られた場合は迅速にフルRRAに進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Ungkap Fakta Mengkhawatirkan Indonesia Peringkat Kedua Terburuk Kasus TBC di Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim Reveals Alarming Facts: Indonesia Ranks Second-Worst in the World for TB Cases
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a critical public health threat in Indonesia, which Hashim Djojohadikusumo states ranks second-worst globally in TB burden, just behind India. Speaking at the launch of housing construction under Indonesia’s 3 million homes program in the Manggarai Station area of South Jakarta, he ties the high TB burden to overcrowded, substandard housing conditions that facilitate transmission, especially among children. The government’s free health screening program reportedly confirms many TB cases, with officials from the Ministry of Health—the Health Minister and Deputy Health Minister—endorsing the finding that large numbers of children and citizens are afflicted. Hashim warns that TB compounds other health challenges, including stunting, and argues that improving housing quality is essential to disease control. The 3 million homes initiative is framed as both housing policy and a public health intervention to reduce crowded living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム氏が衝撃的な事実を公開：インドネシアは世界でTB（結核）患者数が2番目に悪い国
triage.triage_reason: 結核は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、インドネシアは世界第2位の患者負担国として位置付けられている。深刻な重症度と多くの人口への影響が認識されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり国際的な新規発生ではないが、インドネシアの深刻な病負担（世界第2位）、子どもを含む多くの罹患者、不十分な住宅条件による長期曝露、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、および政府高官による公式な認識と公衆衛生対応により、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。政策レベルでの関心と対応が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Sukabumi Waspadai Momen Mudik Lebaran Bisa Picu Penyebaran Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sukabumi City Health Office Warns That the Lebaran Homecoming Period Could Trigger Measles Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Sukabumi City, West Java, Indonesia: 23 laboratory-confirmed cases were detected from January to mid-March among 32 suspected cases, with no deaths. Ahead of the Lebaran (Idul Fitri) homecoming period, authorities warn that increased mobility and crowds could raise transmission risk. Preventive measures include hygiene practices, masking in crowds, and physical distancing where possible. In 2025, Sukabumi’s full basic immunization coverage reached 98.9%, leaving about 1.1% of under-five children unvaccinated. The city has not declared a Local Public Health Emergency (KLB), but intensified prevention to curb spread. Context: Indonesia ranks second globally in measles cases after Yemen; in West Java, nine districts have declared KLB.

triage.headline_ja: スカブミ市保健局、レバラン帰郷期間が麻疹の伝播を引き起こす可能性があることを警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・西ジャワ州での麻疹発生（23確認症例）に加え、レバラン期間の人口移動による国際的拡大リスク、および地域的流行可能性があり、IHR基準2つ以上かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: インドネシアは世界で2番目に麻疹症例が多い国（イエメンに次ぐ）。西ジャワ州内で9地区がKLB（地域保健緊急事態）を宣言。レバラン期間中の高い人口移動による地域内および国際的伝播リスクが懸念される。ワクチン接種率は高い（98.9%）が、1.1%の未接種幼児が存在し、ギャップ領域での流行可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Từ viêm họng, nữ sinh 16 tuổi bị siêu vi khuẩn 'ăn' vào não và tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From a throat infection, a 16-year-old female student was infected by a superbug that invaded her brain and heart.
article.articleSummary: 16-year-old female student from Son La, Vietnam, presented with persistent high fever (up to 40°C), sore throat, and chills after five days of antibiotics for presumed acute tonsillitis. She developed sepsis signs, confusion, and non-painful petechial plaques on hands and feet. Transferred to National Hospital of Tropical Diseases, Hanoi. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bacteremia. Diagnoses: MRSA septicemia with acute infectious endocarditis, cerebral infarcts in both hemispheres with cerebellar hemorrhage, and secondary pneumonia. CT/MRI imaging documented scattered brain infarcts and intracerebellar hemorrhage; right upper-extremity weakness (3/5) and balance impairment. Treated with aggressive anti-MRSA therapy; condition gradually improved. Advice: prolonged fever not responding to standard therapy warrants evaluation for severe infections; warning signs include petechiae on palms/soles, limb weakness, and loss of balance. No imported/exported case data.

triage.headline_ja: 咽頭炎から始まった16歳女子学生がスーパーバグ(MRSA)に脳と心臓を侵された
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重症感染症（感染性心内膜炎、脳梗塞、脳出血を伴う）の個別症例報告。深刻な公衆衛生影響（多臓器障害、高い致命率リスク）と予想外性を認め、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度と管理可能性（国立熱帯病院への転院要した）で複数該当。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であるが、標準的抗菌薬に反応しないMRSA敗血症による急速な多臓器障害（心内膜炎、脳梗塞、脳出血）の重症化が記載されている。咽頭炎からの進展として臨床的に注目すべき症例。ベトナムでのMRSA流行状況の背景情報は記事に含まれていないため、詳細なRRAでの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 万泰生物：重组呼吸道合胞病毒疫苗获临床试验批准通知书-证券之星
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wantai Biopharm: Recombinant Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccine Has Obtained a Clinical Trial Approval Notice - Securities Star
article.articleSummary: Wantai Biopharm announced that by December 2025 its wholly owned subsidiary Wantai Canghai had the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) documents accepted for a recombinant Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) vaccine (CHO cells) clinical trial. The NMPA subsequently issued an approval notice for conducting the clinical trial of this CHO cell-derived RSV vaccine. This constitutes a regulatory milestone for an RSV vaccine candidate in China. The report centers on development and approval status and does not cite RSV infection cases, outbreaks, efficacy data, or other global locations; no imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 万泰生物：重组呼吸道合胞病毒疫苗获临床试验批准通知书（万泰生物：組換え呼吸道合胞病毒ワクチンが臨床試験承認通知書を取得）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はRSVワクチン候補の臨床試験承認という規制上のマイルストーンを報じるもので、実際のRSV感染症アウトブレイク、症例、または感染症危機を示唆する内容ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当せず。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（disease outbreak/epidemic）ではなく、医薬品開発・規制当局の承認プロセスに関するニュースである。Bluedot APIが「RSV」キーワードに基づいて抽出した可能性があるが、EBS活動における感染症危機管理シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 万泰生物：子公司重组呼吸道合胞病毒疫苗临床试验获批
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wantai Biologics: Subsidiary's recombinant respiratory syncytial virus vaccine clinical trial approved.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-16, Wantai Biologics announced that its wholly owned subsidiary Wantai Canghai has received the National Medical Products Administration's approval notice for a recombinant respiratory syncytial virus vaccine (CHO cells) clinical trial. The application to test a CHO-cell RSV vaccine aimed at preventing RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease has been accepted, enabling clinical testing. Co-developed with Xiamen University, the vaccine uses genetic engineering with the RSV fusion (F) protein in its prefusion conformation as the main active component. In preclinical studies, the product showed favorable safety and induced RSV-specific protective immune responses in mice, rats, hamsters, and crab-eating macaques. Regulatory acceptance advances the program toward human testing and potential RSV prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 万泰生物：子会社の組み換え呼吸道合胞病毒ワクチン臨床試験が承認
triage.triage_reason: 本件は新規ワクチン開発の臨床試験承認というイベント医学ニュースであり、進行中の感染症の流行、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の危機を示す兆候ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本件はRSVに関するワクチン開発の進展を報じるニュースであるが、RSVの流行や公衆衛生上の危機に関する具体的なシグナルは含まれていない。監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim: Rumah Kumuh Penyebab Stunting dan TBC Anak-anak di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim: Slum housing causes stunting and tuberculosis in children in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's housing conditions, especially in slums, are linked to high rates of stunting and tuberculosis (TB) in children, according to Hashim Djojohadikusumo, head of the Housing Task Force, at the Manggarai, Jakarta launch of housing development in support of the 3 Juta Rumah program (March 16, 2026). He argued that unhealthy living environments undermine children's health and academic performance. He noted that Indonesia ranks second globally in TB prevalence, after India, a consequence of densely packed, substandard housing. The claim is supported by data from the Health Ministry's free health-check program, which has reached about 72 million people, with findings that many children in Indonesia harbor TB. Hashim emphasizes that providing adequate housing can create healthier environments for children and improve learning outcomes, making housing construction a key public health measure.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム氏：インドネシアのスラム住宅は子どもの発育阻害と結核の原因
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、スラム住宅との関連性を指摘する政策的発言の報道だが、新規アウトブレイクや異常な発生状況の報告ではない。情報が限定的で、国際的拡大リスクが明確でない。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおける結核は既知の重要公衆衛生課題（世界第2位の負担国）。本記事は政策レベルの言及であり、新規感染数や流行状況の急変を示す具体的データがない。住環境改善に関する構造的課題の報道と評価される。スクリーニング基準で3項目該当し社会的関心も高いが、新規シグナル性としては限定的なため、今後の実施状況や新規患者報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito e 'água com sal' vacinam morcegos contra raiva - 16/03/2026 - Ciência - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito and 'salt water' vaccinate bats against rabies
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers, including participants from the Wuhan Institute of Virology, show non-invasive vaccination of bats against rabies and Nipah using two oral/vector approaches. To immunize without capturing bats, they fed bats via two routes: infecting mosquitoes with attenuated viruses that bats ingest or are stung by, and delivering a virus-laden saline solution that bats lick. They used Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) as a harmless surrogate carrying tiny genetic elements of the lethal rabies and Nipah viruses, with irradiation to sterilize mosquitoes. Lab tests in mice, hamsters, and bats in aviaries showed immunity development; direct brain infection with rabies did not cause disease in some controls. In a field test in a cave with resident bats, saline vaccine with an antibiotic marker was consumed by many bats, and antibodies against rabies were detected; Nipah response not validated in saliva trial. Further field trials proposed with safeguards in rural settings.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊と塩水でコウモリに狂犬病とニパーウイルスのワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 実験的なコウモリワクチン接種プログラムの報道であり、ニパー、狂犬病、水疱性口炎ウイルスが関連しているが、記事は予防的研究開発の段階を説明しており、現在の患者発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆していない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: この報道は武漢ウイルス研究所の研究チームによるコウモリへのワクチン接種技術開発に関するもので、患者発生報告ではなく科学研究の進展を報じている。Nipah、Rabies、VSVはすべてワクチン接種対象として言及されており、新規感染症発生や流行を示唆する情報は含まれていない。ただし、動物実験から野外試験への段階進行に関する安全性情報が限定的であるため、続報の監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Sebut Banyak Kawasan Kumuh di RI, Penyakit TBC Makin Merajalela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim says there are many slum areas in Indonesia, tuberculosis is becoming increasingly rampant.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, Indonesia’s slum housing conditions are linked to a rising pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) burden, highlighted during Jakarta’s Manggarai Station vertical housing inauguration by Hashim Djojohadikusumo. He asserts crowded, unhealthy slums contribute to TB transmission, with children particularly affected, worsening stunting and academic outcomes. Indonesia is reportedly second globally in TB prevalence after India. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin notes the nationwide free health-check program has reached about 72 million people, with officials indicating many children have TB, described as a national malady. The report emphasizes environmental health problems impacting growth and schooling, but provides no specific TB case counts. The situation underscores the need for housing improvements and expanded TB screening to address an ongoing, urban-slum–driven TB crisis.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム氏が指摘：インドネシアにはスラム地域が多く、結核が急速に蔓延している
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の蔓延状況が報告されており、スクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク情報が記事に記載されておらず、情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり新興感染症ではないが、WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露（スラム環境での持続的な伝播）および流行しやすさ（人口密集地での感染リスク）が認識できる。ただし、記事には具体的な症例数、死亡数、新規感染者数の増減データが記載されていないため、真のシグナル強度は不明。インド次点での世界2位という疫学的重要性は認識されるが、現在のアウトブレイク段階や新規の悪化を示す直接的な証拠を欠く。続報待機が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kesaksian Warga Manumutin Saat Diserang Kucing Rabies: Tiba-tiba Lompat dan Gigit Kaki
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Testimony of Manumutin Residents During a Rabid Cat Attack: The Cat Suddenly Leaped and Bit the Leg.
article.articleSummary: On 14–15 March 2026, a cat later declared rabid attacked residents of Manumutin, Kota Atambua, Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara. The animal bit or scratched at least 11 people over two days. One victim, Yulita Mau, 45, was bitten on the left leg around 06:00 WITA on 15 March while fetching water; she described the sudden jump and a bleeding wound treated with hot water and salt. Later that night she learned others, including her husband, Alexander Da Silva Mau, 52, had also been bitten; he was bitten around 13:00 while resting at home. After confirmation that the cat tested positive for rabies by Dinas Peternakan Belu, victims sought medical care at a puskesmas for treatment and vaccination. Doctors said multiple vaccine doses would be needed; Camat and Lurah attended vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: マヌムティン住民がイヌ科の狂犬病感染猫に襲われた時の証言：猫が突然飛び掛かり足を噛んだ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%の重篤感染症であり、2日間で11人以上が咬傷を受けた異常事象。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と予想外の集団発生に該当し、IHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の致死率の高さ、短期間での複数咬傷事案、複数の被害者（特に高齢者を含む）が医療提供と予防接種を必要としている点が懸念される。地域保健当局による対応は確認されているが、追加の防疫措置や疫学調査の進展を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 预防狂犬病，避开这三个常见误区 | 科普时间
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Rabies, Avoid These Three Common Misconceptions | Popular Science Time
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a globally fatal zoonosis with near-100% mortality, but it is preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The article highlights three common misconceptions about rabies prevention and emphasizes prompt post-exposure management per the 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention and Management Guidelines. Exposures include bites or scratches from rabid or suspected rabid animals, or contact of saliva or infected tissue with mucous membranes or broken skin. After a high-risk dog bite or scratch, prevention is a race against time; the typical incubation period is 1–3 months, though shorter or much longer intervals can occur. Because disease onset cannot be reliably predicted, sooner intervention is always better. A seemingly normal dog in early rabies can still transmit the virus, so reliance on appearance alone is unsafe. Prompt, proper PEP is essential to prevent death.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病を予防し、3つの一般的な誤解を避ける | 科学知識の時間
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の予防啓発に関する一般的な科学情報であり、新たな感染症イベント、流行、または危機を報告するものではない。既知の疾患に関する教育コンテンツであり、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の一般的な予防啓発・科学知識に関する教育的コンテンツであり、新規流行、アウトブレイク、または危機イベントの報告ではない。特定の感染症イベントや異常事象の報告がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Madiun catat temuan 16 suspek Campak di awal 2026 - ANTARA News Jawa Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madiun Health Office records 16 suspected measles cases in early 2026 - ANTARA News East Java
article.articleSummary: 16 suspected measles cases among children have been recorded in Madiun Regency, East Java, from January to mid-March 2026, per the Madiun Health Office. No laboratory-confirmed measles cases have been reported yet. Blood samples from the suspected cases have been collected and sent to Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Surabaya (BBLK Surabaya) for confirmatory testing; results are pending. Most cases are in Saradan and Geger districts, with three suspected cases each; the remainder spread across 13 other districts. Common symptoms include high fever, red skin rash, red eyes, runny nose, nausea and vomiting. The Health Office issued an outbreak alert circular to 26 health centers (puskesmas) and three hospitals—RSUD Caruban, RSUD Dolopo, and RS Paru Dungus—to report suspected cases promptly and facilitate tracing. A catch-up measles vaccination program targeting infants aged 9–19 months has been intensified, alongside general PHBS promotion.

triage.headline_ja: マディウン保健局、2026年初頭に麻疹疑い患者16例を記録 - ANTARA News東ジャワ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の疑い患者16例が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性がある。ただし、実験室確認例がなく、情報が不十分であるため、今後の検査結果と動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染性を持つ疾患であり、幼い子どもたちが影響を受けている。複数地区での発生、ワクチン接種強化の実施、および保健局による迅速な対応が確認されている。ただし、検査室確認例がなく、患者数が比較的限定的であるため、WATCH判定とした。検査結果の報告を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 预防狂犬病，避开这三个常见误区 | 科普时间
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Prevention: Avoid These Three Common Misconceptions | Popular Science Time
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a global, nearly 100% fatal zoonosis, but its prevention is highly effective with prompt post-exposure actions. This article counters three common rabies prevention misconceptions. First, exposure isn’t limited to dog bites: bites, scratches, licking of mucous membranes or broken skin, or contact with saliva or tissue from rabid, suspected, or uncertain animals require immediate post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) per the Rabies Exposure Prevention and Post-Exposure Management Protocol (2023 edition). Second, delaying vaccination after high-risk exposure is dangerous; the incubation period is typically 1–3 months, but onset is unpredictable, and rabies is almost always fatal if not treated early. Finally, dogs with rabies may appear normal early on, underscoring the need for cautious assessment and timely PEP. Location emphasis: global rabies prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防：3つの一般的な誤解を避ける | 科学知識の時間
triage.triage_reason: 啓発記事であり、新規の感染症イベント報告ではない。既知疾患の予防情報に関する教育コンテンツであり、IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の一般的な予防誤解に関する啓発記事（Popular Science）であり、新規の確認された患者発生、集団発生、または異常な感染症イベントの報告ではない。感染症イベント検出システムのノイズとして機能している。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس "نيباه".. ما مدى خطورته على البشر وهل من علاج له؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus: How dangerous is it to humans, and is there a treatment?
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus is a zoonotic pathogen with fruit bats as the primary reservoir and pigs as an amplifying source. Transmission to humans occurs via direct contact with infected animals or consumption of contaminated products, notably raw date palm sap; secondary spread happens through close human contact. Symptoms appear 4–14 days after exposure; initial illness is flu-like, with two-thirds progressing rapidly, and coma typically within 5–7 days. Neurological involvement is common, with brain-imaging changes and possible lasting deficits; severe cases may require ventilation. Diagnosis relies on detecting Nipah-specific proteins in blood. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral therapy; care is supportive, and Ribavirin has mixed results. Prevention focuses on reducing animal-to-human transmission and strict infection control. Outbreaks occur annually in parts of Asia—Bangladesh, India, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore—with spillovers in China, Cambodia, Thailand, Madagascar, Ghana; the US has had no cases. Since 2024, about 754 global cases (likely undercounted), with peak transmission Dec–May during bat activity and sap collection.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：人間にとってどの程度危険であり、治療法はあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高い致命率と神経学的症状を持つ新興ズーノーティック病原体）が複数国で報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行性」「管理可能性」が明確で、特に治療法がない状況での定期的な流行が懸念される。
triage.notes: 2024年以降約754例の世界的症例報告あり。ワクチン・特異的抗ウイルス療法が存在せず、支持療法のみ。アジア地域（バングラデシュ、インド、マレーシア、フィリピン、シンガポール）での定期的な流行、中国・カンボジア・タイ・マダガスカル・ガーナでのスピルオーバーが記録されている。致命率が高く神経学的合併症が一般的という重症度が高い疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Soroti Indonesia Negara Kedua Terburuk soal TBC di Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim Highlights Indonesia as the World's Second-Worst Country for TB
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second-worst globally for tuberculosis (TB), a lung disease, with India the only country worse, per Hashim Djojohadikusumo during the launch of the 3 Million Housing Program at Manggarai Station, Jakarta Pusat. He links high TB burden to crowded, substandard housing and cites the Free Health Check Program (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG), which has benefited 72 million Indonesians. The report notes TB and childhood stunting tied to poor health environments. The 3 Million Homes program aims to improve living conditions for children and spur economic growth, projected at 8%, by expanding construction materials and housing access. The speaker draws on economic histories of China, Japan, Korea, and Singapore to illustrate dual aims of social equity and rapid growth, underscoring the intersection of public health and housing policy in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム、インドネシアが世結核について世界で2番目に悪い国であることを強調
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核負担が深刻であることは周知の事実であり、本記事は政策イベントに基づく報道。IHR基準は満たさない可能性が高いが、複数国での関心や長期的な公衆衛生課題として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく、インドネシアの既知の結核問題に対する政策対応（3百万住宅プログラム）の報道。複数国（インドネシア、日本、韓国、シンガポール、中国、インド）が関連地域として抽出されているが、これは比較参照国を含む。結核は慢性疾患であり急性の感染症危機ではないが、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当により継続監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada Laporan Campak di Natuna, Dinkes Minta Warga Tetap Waspada Menjelang Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Measles Reports in Natuna Yet, Health Office Urges Residents to Stay Vigilant Ahead of Eid al-Fitr
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, Natuna Regency in the Riau Islands Province has not reported any measles cases, while several Indonesian regions are seeing increased measles activity and some areas declared a public health emergency (KLB). Natuna Health Office urged vigilance ahead of Eid al-Fitr 1447 H, with Natuna described as still normal and safe. No suspected cases have been reported to require laboratory testing, and no samples have been sent to Batam for confirmation, since lab tests are needed to confirm measles. Early symptoms include high fever followed by a red rash, and respiratory issues such as cough, runny nose, and sore throat. Although measles itself rarely causes direct death, complications due to immune suppression can be fatal. The Ministry of Health is monitoring regional outbreaks nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ナトゥーナ県ではまだ麻しんの報告がない、保健所は断食月明けに向けて住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア複数地域で麻しん活動が増加し公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、対象地域（ナトゥーナ県）では症例報告がない段階。国際的拡大の具体的な兆候は記事から不明だが、ピーク時期（イード前）に向けた継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシア内で麻しん活動が複数地域で増加し、一部地域で公衆衛生上の緊急事態（KLB）が宣言されている状況。対象地域（ナトゥーナ県）は現段階で症例未報告だが、イード（断食月明け）に向けた人口移動による感染拡大リスクが存在。継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Nova cepa do vírus da Mpox recombinante preocupa OMS e testes mostram que antiviral mais usado não é eficaz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New recombinant Mpox virus strain worries WHO, and tests show that the most widely used antiviral is not effective.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of a novel recombinant mpox virus strain, combining elements from clades Ib and IIb, likely circulating across at least four countries in three WHO regions. Two confirmed cases involved international travel; conventional PCR failed to identify the recombinant, with full-genome sequencing required for confirmation. Clade Ib (Central Africa) is linked to higher mortality (roughly 3–5%, up to 11% in children and immunocompromised), while clade IIb (the 2022 outbreak lineage) has lower mortality (<0.1%). In February 2026, NEJM STOMP trial results raise treatment concerns: in 344 immunocompetent adults with clade II mpox, tecovirimat showed no clinical benefit versus placebo—83% vs 84% lesion resolution; pain reduction 0.1/10; viral clearance similar. PALM007 in DR Congo for clade I yielded similar findings. Immunocompromised, pregnant, and pediatric patients remain underrepresented; surveillance should include genomic sequencing, and clinical protocols must be updated, including reassessment of tecovirimat use. Vaccination of priority groups is discussed.

triage.headline_ja: 新型組み換えMpoxウイルス株がWHOを懸念させ、最も広く使用されている抗ウイルス薬が有効でないことがテストで示される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。新規組み換えMpox株、標準的診断法での検出失敗、主要抗ウイルス薬の無効性、複数WHO地域での流行が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 重大な懸念要因：(1) Ib/IIb組み換え株の出現（新規）、(2) 従来PCRでの検出失敗、(3) 主要治療薬テコビリマットの臨床試験での無効性（NEJM STOMP試験）、(4) 少なくとも3つのWHO地域・4ヶ国での流行確認、(5) 高死亡率クレード（Ib: 3-5%、小児・免疫低下者で11%）との組み合わせリスク。免疫低下者・妊婦・小児での臨床データ不足も懸念。国際旅行との関連確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kronologi Kucing Positif Rabies Gigit Belasan 11 Warga Belu NTT, Begini Kondisinya Sekarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Timeline: Rabies-Positive Cat Bites 11 Belu Residents in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT); Here’s Their Condition Now.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure reported in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia, after a rabies-positive cat bit 11 residents. As of 16 March 2026, Kelurahan Manumutin has reported to the Dinas Kesehatan, the Camat, and the BPBD Kabupaten Belu to recheck data and prevent further cases. No human case counts are provided; authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance and rapid notification to curb spread. Residents are urged to recognize rabies signs in cats, including abrupt behavioral changes—either increased aggression or unusual lethargy—along with excessive drooling and difficulty swallowing, and a lack of fear toward humans or other threats. The infection source is a rabies-positive cat, with public health actions focusing on case-tracking, risk communication, and preventing secondary transmissions. Laboratory confirmation details and information on imported/exported cases are not specified.

triage.headline_ja: ラビス陽性猫が東ヌサテンガラ州ベル地区の11人住民を咬傷、現在の状態について（インドネシア）
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病（ラビス）の曝露事例で複数の人的被害（11人咬傷）が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」と「重症度」を満たす。ラビスは致死性が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死性の高い人畜共通感染症であり、複数人の咬傷曝露が報告されている。人間感染例の確認状況が記事に明記されていない点が注意。インドネシア保健当局による感視と対応が開始されている。後発感染リスク評価のため続報確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Imbas Kasus Gigitan Kucing Rabies di Belu, Dinas Peternakan NTT Imbau Masyarakat Jangan Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Case From a Cat Bite in Belu: NTT Department of Animal Husbandry Urges the Public Not to Panic.
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia: 11 residents of Manumutin, Kota Atambua bitten by a cat that tested rabies-positive on 15 March 2026. Public told not to panic. Vaccines remain stocked at Belu’s Puskesmas and are sufficient. Of the 11 bite victims, eight have received anti-rabies vaccine (VAR); three are still awaiting vaccination. An emergency vaccination campaign will cover dogs and cats in surrounding areas, targeting seven to eight dusuns. Pet owners are urged to cooperate and have pets vaccinated when officials arrive; vaccination cost status is not clearly defined in the report. Measures aim to prevent further human rabies deaths and curb spread from this incident.

triage.headline_ja: ベルで狂犬病の猫咬傷事例が発生、東ヌサ・テンガラ州畜産局が住民にパニックを起こさないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は高い致死率を持つ重大疾患だが、本事例は限定的な地域的クラスター（11人の咬傷）であり、既にワクチン対応が開始されている。情報不足のため確実なリスク評価が難しい段階。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命的疾患（未治療時の致死率ほぼ100%）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀だがペットから人への感染が継続的なリスク。本事例は単一の狂犬病陽性猫による限定的なクラスターで、既にワクチン対応が実施されている。ただし、咬傷者11名中3名がまだワクチン未接種であることと、周辺エリアでの緊急予防接種キャンペーンが実施される予定であることから、継続的な監視が必要。情報不足のため確実な「異常性」「長期曝露」の有無が不明であり、現段階ではWATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Belu Pastikan Stok Vaksin Rabies Aman, Semua Puskesmas Jadi Posko Penanganan Rabies - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belu Health Office Ensures Rabies Vaccine Stock Is Safe, All Community Health Centers Become Rabies Handling Posts.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination stock in Belu Regency, Indonesia, remains sufficient following an 11-person cat bite cluster in Manumutin, Atambua City. The Belu Health Office confirmed VAR (rabies vaccine) stock at the department's warehouse stands at 1,080 doses and SAR (rabies immunoglobulin) at about 30 vials, with all 17 puskesmas designated as rabies response posts to ensure rapid treatment. Most bites occurred during the incident at Kelurahan Manumutin; nine victims received immediate care at Puskesmas Kota Atambua and Puskesmas Ailien. Two others were treated for wounds but initially deferred vaccination due to high blood pressure; by 16 March 2026, both had received vaccination at Puskesmas Kota Atambua. Patients are advised to complete wound care, adhere to the vaccination schedule, and return for follow-up. Public is urged to avoid contact with aggressive dogs or cats, and to secure pets.

triage.headline_ja: ベル保健局が狂犬病ワクチン在庫の安全性を確保、すべてのコミュニティヘルスセンターが狂犬病対応拠点に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで11名の猫咬傷クラスターが発生し狂犬病リスクが存在するが、ワクチン在庫が確保され対応体制が整備されている。現時点では死亡例や国際的拡大の証拠がなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事から得られた情報：(1)11名の咬傷クラスターはインドネシア・ベル地域で発生し、うち9名が医療施設で治療を受けている；(2)狂犬病は予防可能だが治療後の致命率が極めて高い疾患である；(3)ワクチン在庫（1,080用量）が確保され、17のコミュニティヘルスセンターが対応可能体制となっている；(4)記事に死亡例の報告がなく、死亡者数や重症度についての情報が不足している；(5)動物由来感染症であり、人-人感染の可能性は低いが、咬傷からの曝露リスクは継続している。スクリーニング基準は3つ該当するが、対応能力があるため深刻度は緩和されている。フルRRA前に続報を注視し、死亡例や新規症例の追加発生を確認することが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue deve afetar até 1,8 milhão de brasileiros em 2026. Confira seis dicas para se manter hidratado - Contexto Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is expected to affect up to 1.8 million Brazilians in 2026. Six tips to stay hydrated - Contexto Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, a mosquito-borne viral infection transmitted by Aedes aegypti, is projected to affect up to 1.8 million people in Brazil in 2026. The disease remains a major public health issue in tropical settings like Brazil. Common symptoms include high fever, headaches or behind-the-eye pain, weakness, severe body and joint pain, and red rash. Treatment centers on hydration; oral rehydration should begin as soon as symptoms appear, even in the waiting room, and continue throughout the fever and for 24–48 hours after fever resolves. Early medical consultation is advised. The article presents six practical tips for rehydration, underscoring prevention of dehydration as a core management strategy. These measures align with guidelines from health authorities and highlight the importance of prompt hydration to mitigate dengue severity.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年にデング熱がブラジル人最大180万人に影響を与える見通し。水分補給を保つための6つのヒント
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の大規模な流行予測（180万人規模）で異常/予想外性と重症度が示唆されるが、予測ベースの記事であり実行中の流行やアウトブレイクの具体的証拠が不明確。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のデング熱予測に関する報道であり、実行中の急性アウトブレイク確認ではない。180万人規模の予測は大規模流行を示唆するが、根拠となる疫学的データ、現在の患者数、致死率などの詳細が不明。ブラジルは定期的なデング熱流行地域であり、予測自体が異常かどうかの判断が困難。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性についても記事から不明。政府対応や国際支援必要性について情報がないため、WATCHで継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Pasien di Puskesmas Nanggalo Padang Terjangkit Virus Campak Awal 2026, Tahun Lalu Tembus 81 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Patients at Nanggalo Public Health Center in Padang Infected with Measles Virus in Early 2026; Last Year Reached 81 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Four measles cases were detected at Puskesmas Nanggalo in Padang, West Sumatra, from January to mid-March 2026, with one case providing a blood sample for laboratory testing (results pending). In 2025, 81 measles cases were recorded in the area; nine samples were sent to a laboratory, yielding three positive and six negative results, with positive patients recovering on mild courses. Measles can spread to the lungs and brain, though no severe cases were reported at the Puskesmas so far. As measles cases are designated a Kasus Luar Biasa (KLB) by the government, Padang’s public health centers continue vaccination promotion, but uptake remains low as many residents refuse immunization, a challenge noted by Dr. M. Fardhan, head of Puskesmas Nanggalo.

triage.headline_ja: パダン市ナンガロ保健センターで麻疹ウイルス感染者4人が確認、2026年初頭；昨年は81例に達した
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西スマトラ州でのはしか（麻疹）の継続的な発生であり、2025年の81例から2026年初頭にも複数例が報告されている。ワクチン接種率の低さという構造的問題があり、地域の公衆衛生への脅威が継続している。
triage.notes: はしかはWPRO地域で継続的な懸念事項であり、ワクチン接種率の低さが重要な管理上の課題として言及されている。政府もKLB（異常事態）として位置付けており、地域レベルでの対応が進行中。ただし現段階では重症例や死亡例の報告がなく、国際的な拡大リスクについては記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Sebut Indonesia Nomor Dua Kasus TBC di Dunia, Permukiman Kumuh Jadi Pemicu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim Says Indonesia Is No. 2 in TB Cases Worldwide, Slum Settlements Are the Trigger.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis (TB) cases, after India, according to Hashim Djojohadikusumo. TB—a lung disease—has been linked to crowded housing near slum areas, with children disproportionately affected. The assertion, made at the Manggarai Station vertical-housing inauguration in Jakarta on 2026-03-16, is supported by a Free Health Check program that screened 72 million people, per Health Minister and Deputy Health Minister. Hashim ties TB and stunting to environmental and housing conditions, warning that slum environments drive ill health and hamper education. Concurrently, President Prabowo announced 2026 APBN funding for the 3 Juta Rumah program, totaling Rp 57.7 trillion to finance 770,000 homes through FLPP, BSPS, and PPN DTP, including Rp 33.5 trillion for FLPP, aiming to improve housing and reduce TB risk factors.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム氏、インドネシアが世界第2位の結核患者国と発表、貧困地域が発症のきっかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核は慢性感染症で国際的懸念の対象だが、本記事は統計的主張と政策発表が主体であり、アウトブレイク等の新たなシグナルの報告ではない。疫学的な新規懸念の存在が不明瞭。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性疾患であり、インドネシアが第2位という事実は新規シグナルではなくWHO統計と一致。記事は政府による住宅改善政策と保健施策の発表が中心。疫学的な新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加率、治療耐性菌等の新規懸念が明示されていないため、RRA進行の優先度は低い。ただし結核の高負荷国における貧困環境との関連付けは公衆衛生上の重要課題であり、今後の疫学データの動向は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les cas de choléra en légère baisse, Kinshasa demeure l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Cholera cases down slightly, Kinshasa remains the epicentre of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: During the ninth week of cholera surveillance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, suspected cholera cases declined to 1,211 from 1,261, with 8 deaths (case fatality rate 0.6%, down from 0.8%). Kinshasa province remains the epicentre, reporting 240 new suspected cholera cases and 2 deaths, compared with 245 cases and 6 deaths the prior week. In the capital, 84 active cholera patients are being treated in Cholera Treatment Centers, up from 41 a week earlier, and hospitalised cases total 6, with 187 recovered. Makala Central Prison shows notable improvement. For mpox, suspected cases decreased from 258 to 235 in week nine. Since the outbreak began in 2024 through week nine of 2026, the national mpox cumulative stands at 123,762 suspected cases, of which 34,822 are confirmed. Health authorities reaffirm surveillance and ongoing response measures to contain both epidemics nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：コレラ症例がわずかに減少、キンシャサが引き続き流行の中心地
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（コレラとMpox）が同時流行中で、Mpoxは12万件以上の累積患者数を記録。継続的な国内流行であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRC内での複数感染症の同時流行。Mpoxは2024年以降累積12万3,762件の疑い患者（確定患者3万4,822件）。コレラは第9週時点で1,211件の疑い患者、死亡8件（CFR 0.6%）。キンシャサが両流行の中心。継続的な監視と対応が進行中だが、複数感染症の管理が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Over 100 devotees suffer food poisoning at Balumama Yatra in Adamapur
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak at Balumama Yatra in Adamapur, Kolhapur, India, after devotees consumed lassi during Rathotsav. More than 100 devotees have been admitted to hospitals in Adamapur, Murgud, Gargoti, Sarawade, and Madilge with nausea, vomiting, and other food-poisoning symptoms. Health authorities are monitoring patients and investigating the contamination source; officials have begun an inquiry and food samples are likely to be sent for laboratory testing. The Balumama Yatra draws thousands of devotees, and organizers vow measures to prevent similar incidents at large gatherings. No fatalities are mentioned. The incident underscores potential foodborne contamination at mass religious events and prompts coordinated medical care and a formal probe.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アダマプルのバルママ・ヤトラで100人以上の信者が食中毒に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒は既知の疾患であり、地域限定的で予想外ではない。死亡報告なく、国際拡大リスクも低い。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準への該当が限定的。
triage.notes: 本件は既知の病原体（食中毒）による局所的アウトブレイク。患者は100人以上だが死亡報告なし。地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中で、食品検査も計画されている。宗教行事での衛生管理が主な課題。国際拡大や渡航制限のリスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta para nova variante da mpox; antiviral mais usado não mostra eficácia | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a new mpox variant; the most-used antiviral shows no efficacy.
article.articleSummary: A new recombinant mpox (monkeypox) strain identified by the World Health Organization combines clades Ib and IIb, linking Ib to the 2022 global outbreak and IIb to recent African cases. Tecovirimat, the main Orthopoxvirus antiviral, shows no meaningful efficacy in treating mpox: a New England Journal of Medicine study found no reduction in lesion healing time, pain, or viral clearance. This undermines a key therapeutic option during a period of greater uncertainty about the disease’s trajectory. Vulnerable groups—immunocompromised individuals, pregnant people, and children—remain understudied with limited treatment alternatives. Diagnostic challenges persist: conventional tests struggle to identify the recombinant; UK and India cases required full genomic sequencing for confirmation. Health authorities call for enhanced genomic surveillance, revised treatment protocols, and expanded vaccination for priority groups to prevent further spread as of 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新型mpox亜型に警告；最も使用される抗ウイルス薬は有効性を示さず
triage.triage_reason: 新規組換えmpox株（Ib/IIb）の出現、主要治療薬テコビリマットの無効化、複数国での確認、診断困難性が組み合わさり、IHR基準3項目以上とWPRO基準5項目全て該当。国際的な公衆衛生危機の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 2026年3月16日のシナリオ設定。新規組換え株（Ib/IIb clade）により以下の深刻な要因が複合：(1)標準治療テコビリマット無効、(2)診断困難性（ゲノムシークエンシング必要）、(3)複数国での確認（米国・英国・インド）、(4)免疫低下者・妊婦・小児への治療選択肢の限定。WHO自体が警告を発していることが記事の信憑性を高める。緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 德意法等五國爆高致病性禽流感　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza in five countries, including Germany, Italy and France; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Five countries reported regional outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1: France (Eure), Germany (Saxony-Anhalt Harz), Italy (Umbria—Perugia), Poland (Greater Poland Nowy Tomyśl), and Argentina (Buenos Aires Province Bolivar Partido). The events were notified to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). No human case data is provided in the report. To protect public health, Hong Kong’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department’s Centre for Food Safety immediately suspended imports of poultry meat, poultry products and eggs from these regions (as of 16 March 2026). Authorities are coordinating with the respective countries and will monitor OIE updates to adjust measures as needed. In 2025, Hong Kong imported from these nations roughly 1,050 tonnes of frozen/chilled poultry meat and about 290,000 eggs from France; 180 tonnes from Germany; 90 tonnes and 10,000 eggs from Italy; 2,890 tonnes from Poland; and 2,080 tonnes from Argentina.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ、イタリア、フランスなど5カ国で高病原性鳥インフルエンザが発生、香港は家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1鳥インフルエンザが複数国（フランス、ドイツ、イタリア、ポーランド、アルゼンチン）で報告され、国際的な動物衛生懸念が生じている。香港が輸入制限を実施するなど公衆衛生的対応が取られており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および社会的関心（政府対応）の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 現時点で人間感染例は報告されていないが、高病原性H5N1は人獣共通感染症であり重大な懸念がある。複数国での同時発生および香港を含む主要食品輸入国での迅速な対応措置が講じられていることから、シグナルとして識別は適切。OIEへの通知済みであり、国際的な監視体制が既に稼働している。

article.articleHeadline: Vecinos de la zona de la Terminal indignados con el Club Libertad: "Es la cuna del dengue"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of the Terminal area outraged at Club Libertad: "It's the cradle of dengue."
article.articleSummary: In Salta, Argentina, residents in the Terminal area warn of dengue risk tied to water-logged conditions at Club Libertad opposite the Santa Cruz cemetery. The club’s abandoned pool contains stagnant water, attracting Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. Neighbors near the Procrear building on Talavera and Richieri report dengue-like symptoms and have filed complaints with the municipality via 147, but officials say they cannot access private property to clean. The situation raises concern of a potential urban outbreak as flies and other insects proliferate. Public health guidance stresses removing standing water to disrupt mosquito breeding, noting common sites such as abandoned pools, buckets, tires, clogged gutters, and open tanks. No case counts are provided, but residents fear a localized dengue cluster if the pool remains unfixed.

triage.headline_ja: ターミナル地区の住民がクラブ・リベルタッドに激怒：「デング熱の温床だ」
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サルタ州でのデング熱リスク警告ですが、確認された症例数が示されておらず、また記事がローカルニュースレベルの情報源です。潜在的な都市部の小規模クラスター発生の懸念はありますが、現時点では詳細情報の収集が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事では確認された症例数が明記されておらず、住民による症状報告のみです。デング熱はWHO地域外のアルゼンチンでの報告であり、WPRO基準の対象外ですが、スクリーニング観点では長期曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当します。続報で症例数や公式確認情報の把握が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Aviária avança na Ásia com novos focos na Coreia do Sul, Japão e Índia | Agrimidia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza Advances in Asia with New Outbreaks in South Korea, Japan and India | Agrimidia
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N1 advances in Asia. In South Korea, 56 outbreaks have been confirmed in 2026 (through 13 March), including a 45,000‑bird laying flock in Pocheon, Gyeonggi. Since January, 37 farms have been affected across multiple production types; authorities imposed a 24‑hour movement ban for egg facilities in Gyeonggi and neighboring cities and tightened access controls around 35 nearby laying farms. In Japan, an H5N1 outbreak was confirmed in Abira, Hokkaido, in about 188,000 broilers, bringing total outbreaks in the current cycle to 21 and affecting over 5 million birds. India reports H5N1 in Bihar at a Patna facility (~5,000 birds); wild crow mortality in January linked. Telangana and Andhra Pradesh have stepped up biosafety. Indonesia records 24 outbreaks in 2025 across Java, Borneo, Sulawesi and Sumatra (~15,500 birds). Philippines reports nine farms on Luzon under monitoring, centered in Cagayan Valley.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがアジアで拡大、韓国・日本・インドで新たな発生
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザA(H5N1)が複数国（韓国、日本、インド、インドネシア、フィリピン）で同時多発的に発生しており、IHR基準の「異常性/予想外性」「国際的拡大のリスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「長期的曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当し、動物健康と公衆衛生に対する深刻な影響が想定される。
triage.notes: 複数国での同時発生、大規模な感染鳥数（日本で500万羽以上、韓国で45,000羽の採卵鶏舎など）、複数のH5亜型検出（H5N1、H5N2、H5N6、H5N8など）、各国政府による移動制限・バイオセーフティ強化措置の実施が確認されている。ヒト感染例は記事では言及されていないが、H5N1は人獣共通感染症の懸念があり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MS reforça resposta às arboviroses em territórios indígenas - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reinforces response to arboviral diseases in indigenous territories - O PROGRESSO
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya transmission is active in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, as of 2026 with a rise in chikungunya cases compared with 2025. In the Dourados region, about 21,000 Indigenous residents are affected; 150 confirmed chikungunya cases and three deaths have been reported, with ongoing cases under analysis. A joint mobilization led by the Secretaria de Estado de Saúde (SES) and the federal Health Ministry, along with Sesai, DSEI, Força Nacional do SUS, HU/UFGD, and municipal authorities and Indigenous leaders, supported field work in the Jaguapiru and Bororó villages from March 9–11. About 2,355 properties were inspected, revealing 589 Aedes aegypti breeding sites, mainly in water tanks, tires, and litter. Interventions included larvicides, adulticides, and installation of ovitrampas. Officials emphasize interagency coordination, ongoing surveillance, and removal of breeding sites with forthcoming actions planned.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省が先住民領土のアルボウイルス病対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの先住民地区（Dourados）でChikungunya感染が拡大しており、2025年比で症例増加、3名の死亡が報告されている。約21,000人の先住民が影響を受けており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な拡大リスクを示唆する。
triage.notes: 2026年3月時点のイベント報告。Aedes aegyptiベクターによるChikungunya感染が確認され、公式な多機関対応が展開されている。先住民人口への影響が大きく、ベクター管理対策も実施中。IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準5つ全て該当するため、フルRRA実施の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Mainaguri | ঋতু বদলের ঠেলা! ঘরে ঘরে ভাইরাল ফিভার, উপচে পড়া ভিড় ময়নাগুড়ি হাসপাতালে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainaguri | The push of the changing season! Viral fever in every home, overflowing crowds at Mainaguri Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Mainaguri, West Bengal reports a seasonal spike in fever, cold, and cough with viral fever prominent at Mainaguri Rural Hospital’s OPD, where 400-450 patients visit daily and about 20-25 present with viral fever. Notable cases include Beauty Ray with her 11-month-old son Divan and Noksta Begum with her 2-year-old Mohammad Sahir, brought after several days of high fever and persistent cold symptoms. Adults also experience mild fever and sore throat. Doctors attribute the surge to seasonal changes: nights cool, days hot, and increased dust after a dry spell since September, with morning fan use contributing to chilly mornings. There is no immediate need for hospitalization; emphasis is on personal protection and masks. Authorities urge awareness and standard hygiene to navigate this period.

triage.headline_ja: Mainaguri | 季節の変わり目の影響！各家庭でウイルス性発熱、Mainaguri病院に溢れかえる患者
triage.triage_reason: 季節性ウイルス熱の散発的増加として報告されているが、病原体不明（Unknown Illness）で詳細情報が限定的。重症度は軽微（入院不要）で国際的リスクは低いが、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、感染症の詳細な特性評価が困難。季節的なウイルス熱の増加として説明されており、重症度は軽微（発熱・咳・喉の痛み程度）で、医学的には深刻性が低い。ただし毎日400-450人の患者訪問と集団発生的パターンは注視する価値あり。病原体の同定と患者の詳細なジャンル分類が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tratamento preventivo de um mês contra tuberculose mostra alta eficácia em estudo realizado no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One-month preventive treatment for tuberculosis shows high efficacy in a study conducted in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: TB preventive therapy: A one-month regimen (1HP) of daily isoniazid plus rifapentine in Manaus, Amazonas, showed 89.6% adherence and acceptable safety in HIV-negative adults, outperforming the standard 3HP (weekly doses over three months) in a study published in PLOS Medicine. The trial, conducted by the Fundação de Medicina Tropical Dr. Heitor Vieira Dourado (FMT-HVD) in Manaus, was in collaboration with the Rio de Janeiro Municipal Health Secretariat and coordinated by Johns Hopkins University; funded by the US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases with support from Brazil's Ministry of Health. Results suggest ultra-short TB preventive therapy can boost adherence without compromising efficacy, potentially informing national and global TB prevention strategies, particularly among vulnerable populations. The study highlights progress in reducing long preventive therapy from six to nine months historically and received international media attention.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナスで実施された研究で、結核に対する1ヶ月の予防的治療が高い有効性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVに関する予防療法の有効性研究報告であり、公衆衛生的な意義がある。しかし発生状況を示す記事ではなく治療研究報告のため、IHR基準への該当は限定的である。情報不足を踏まえ経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の発生・流行を報告するシグナルではなく、結核予防療法の臨床試験結果の報告である。ジョンズ・ホプキンス大学やUS NIAIDなどの国際的な研究機関が関与した学術的な進展報告であり、結核対策の重要性は高いが、緊急的なリスク管理対象とはならない。ただし、アマゾナス地域のTB/HIV共感染状況に関する背景情報の欠落により、流行の潜在的な存在は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kadis Peternakan Kabupaten Sumba Timur Minta Warga Waspada Kucing Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of East Sumba Regency Animal Husbandry Office Urges Residents to Beware of Rabid Cats.
article.articleSummary: Head of the East Sumba Regency Animal Husbandry Office urges residents to beware of rabies in cats after 11 people in Atambua, Belu Regency, were bitten by rabid cats on 15 March 2026. Abraham Koli says Sumba Timur currently has no rabies cases and no reports or indications of rabies in cats, but action will be taken per procedures if cases emerge. He notes that the virus is carried by rabies reservoir animals (HPR) such as cats and dogs, and asks the public to report suspected cases and contact the nearest animal health officer. Health officers are stationed in 22 districts. East Sumba remains rabies-free for now, but preventive measures include a 2025 circular banning entry of HPR into or via East Sumba and enhancing surveillance and rapid reporting of any incidents.

triage.headline_ja: スンバ東県家畜局長、狂犬病にかかった猫に注意するよう住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スンバ東県での狂犬病警戒情報。隣接地域（ベル県アタンブア）での人間への咬傷事案（11名）が確認されているが、スンバ東県では現在症例なし。重症化・死亡のリスクはあるが、地理的限定性と予防措置の実施により、現段階では情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は周知の懸念疾患であり、記事の焦点は地理的に限定されたアウトブレイク対応（隣接県での咬傷事案）である。スンバ東県自体は現在罹患者がなく、予防的措置（動物検疫）が実施されている。Bluedot APIの地理情報マッピングに異常あり（フェロー諸島がリストに含まれているのは不正確）。続報で症例確認または拡大が報告された場合、直ちにPICKUPに昇格させることを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Φονικός και εξαιρετικά μεταδοτικός ιός αφάνισε 72 τίγρεις στην Ταϊλάνδη - "Πέθαναν όπως έζησαν, μέσα στη δυστυχία"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly and highly contagious virus wiped out 72 tigers in Thailand - "They died as they lived, in misery"
article.articleSummary: 72 tigers died in a private zoo in Chiang Mai, Northern Thailand, over the past weeks after contracting a dual infection with a highly transmissible Carre disease virus and respiratory bacteria. Analyses by the Chiang Mai Province Department of Livestock confirmed the Carre disease virus and bacteria harming the respiratory system. Zoo officials had not publicly commented on the incident. PETA Asia described the deaths as occurring in captivity and misery. The report notes that sick tigers are harder to detect than domestic cats or dogs, delaying recognition. No details on the infection source, timing of laboratory confirmation, or import/export status are provided. Authorities are investigating to prevent further spread. Published 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: タイで72頭のトラを殲滅した致命的で高い伝染性を持つウイルス - 「彼らは不幸の中で生まれ、不幸の中で死んだ」
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（飼育下のトラ）における原因不明の感染症で、カルテ病ウイルスと呼吸器細菌の二重感染と判定されているが、人獣感染リスク、地理的拡大の可能性、詳細な疫学情報が不足しており、公開情報も限定的。IHR基準の評価には情報不足があるため、追加情報の収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は動物疾病（飼育下トラ）の集団死であり、直接的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現時点で報告されていない。ただし、カルテ病ウイルス（犬ジステンパーウイルス）の人への感染リスク、感染源不明、ウイルス確認タイミングの詳細が不明であることから、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。動物から人への感染拡大の可能性や、他地域への拡大についての情報が得られれば、判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Anggota DPRD NTT Desak Pemerintah Lakukan Penanganan Serius Kasus Rabies di Belu - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An East Nusa Tenggara DPRD member urges the government to take serious measures to address the rabies case in Belu.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure affecting 11 residents of Manumutin, Kelurahan, Kota Atambua, Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT) has drawn strong calls from NTT Provincial DPRD members. The lawmakers urge Belu Regency and NTT Provincial governments to implement immediate, stepwise actions in line with SOPs for dangerous, communicable diseases, and to evaluate transmission in the field promptly. They caution that rabies is highly fatal if not managed promptly, and suggest that, if necessary to protect public safety, aggressive measures against the transmitting animals, primarily dogs, be considered. The MPs, including David Boimau and Agustinus Nahak, attribute the 11 cases to pet animals and emphasize the need for public education on the risks of bites from rabies-suspected animals. They also call for mass vaccination of pets, including dogs, cats, and monkeys, to curb potential spread within Belu.

triage.headline_ja: 東ヌサ・テンガラ州DPRD議員、ベル県の狂犬病事例への政府の真摯な対応を要求
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・東ヌサ・テンガラ州ベル県で11名が狂犬病に曝露した事例が報告され、政治的関心が高まっている。狂犬病は致死率が極めて高い疾患であり、人動物共通感染症として管理が重要である。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率100%に近い極めて危険な疾患。11名の露出事例でペット動物（主に犬）が感染源とされている。DPRD議員による政治的呼びかけと公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。動物への予防接種と適切な患者管理が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Drone mais sofisticado é a novidade no combate ao Aedes aegypti em Santos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The most sophisticated drone is the latest development in the fight against Aedes aegypti in Santos.
article.articleSummary: A new advanced drone to fight Aedes aegypti in Santos, Brazil, can deploy larvicide or insecticide to hard-to-reach areas, including closed properties, enabling immediate elimination of larval stages and preventing adult mosquitoes from transmitting dengue and chikungunya. Training for endemic-control agents is scheduled for March 17 at 9:30 at Paquetá Cemetery, with the first test flight during a pilot phase. The initiative supports ongoing vector-control efforts, reinforcing the 10-minute-per-week inspection rule for residents to remove standing water and keep environments clean. The Vila Mathias mutirão continues March 18–19, with Terra Santos personnel collecting unusable materials that can breed mosquitoes, and IEC teams conducting arbovirus-awareness activities. A educational outreach is planned for Poupatempo Santos on March 20.

triage.headline_ja: サントスのネッタイシマカ対策における最先端ドローン導入
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサントスにおけるデング熱とチクングニヤ対策の新技術導入についての報道。既知の地域的対策であり、異常な流行発生ではなく、支援必要性が明確ではない段階であるため、情報収集の継続が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は流行状況ではなく、ベクター対策の技術的進展に焦点を当てている。デング熱とチクングニヤの既知の伝播リスク（prolonged_exposure, epidemic_prone）は存在するが、現在の異常な疾患活動や拡大の報告はない。政府・自治体による積極的な対策実施を示す記事であり、管理可能性は良好と判断される。WATCHレベルの継続監視で十分。

article.articleHeadline: Rutshuru : une maladie inconnue décime les petits ruminants à Kiwanja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rutshuru: An Unknown Disease Decimates Small Ruminants in Kiwanja
article.articleSummary: An unidentified disease is decimating small ruminants, mainly goats, in Kiwanja and surrounding areas in Rutshuru, North Kivu, as of March 2026. Multiple mortalities have been recorded; affected animals show severe diarrhea, nasal discharge, high fever, and loss of appetite, with some deaths within days. Local veterinarian Bahati Kirolina suspects small ruminant plague (Peste des petits ruminants, PPR), a highly contagious viral disease, but laboratory testing is required for confirmation. No official confirmation or containment campaign has been launched, allowing spread to continue. Smallholders depend on goats for livelihoods and report limited means to buy medicines or hire specialists. Calls for territorial veterinary services and provincial authorities to conduct an assessment and organize a response. In the interim, experts advise isolating symptomatic animals, restricting livestock movement, and improving enclosure hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ルツシュル：キワンジャで小型反芻動物を襲う未知の病気
triage.triage_reason: ペストデプティルミナン（PPR）の疑いが提示されており、高い感染性を持つウイルス性疾患で国際的拡大リスクがある。北キブ州での未確認の動物疾患の急速な蔓延で、確認と封じ込め対策が不在。
triage.notes: PPRは家畜に対する重要な動物疾患で、国際的な動物衛生上の懸念。患畜の隔離や移動制限が必要にもかかわらず公式確認なく対策が講じられていない。生計を小型反芻動物に依存する地域住民の社会的影響も懸念される。動物疾患のシグナルとしてピックアップが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul registra duas mortes suspeitas por dengue, diz SES
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records two suspected dengue deaths, says SES.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected dengue deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS) this year, with 1,470 suspected dengue cases in the state; 2025 dengue-related deaths in MS totaled 20. Chikungunya has killed three people this year in MS, all in Dourados: a 3-month-old baby who fell ill on the 6th and died on the 10th; a 73-year-old man with no comorbidities; and a 69-year-old indigenous woman with hypertension and diabetes. Data come from SES epidemiological bulletins released March 13, updated through the first week of March. Dengue shows an upward trend: 254 probable cases in late February rising to 463 in early March; incidence 53.3 per 100k. Top dengue-incidence cities: Vicentina, Corumbá, Douradina, Sete Quedas, Antônio João. Dengue vaccination: 241,030 doses received; 147,123 first doses (73.79% coverage); 88,420 second doses (44.34% fully immunized). Campo Grande reports 238 dengue notifications, incidence 26.51, with hotspots and ongoing vector-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソドスル州、デング熱の疑わしい2件の死亡を記録、州保健局が発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州でデング熱とチクングニヤの複合流行が進行中。チクングニヤの2026年死亡者3名（乳幼児含む）、デング熱の疑い死亡2名が報告され、デング患者数は急増傾向（2月末254例→3月初期463例）を示している。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するシグナル。
triage.notes: ブラジルは蚊媒介感染症の常在地域だが、チクングニヤによる乳幼児死亡（生後3ヶ月）は異常。デング患者の急増傾向（1ヶ月間で82%増加）と複合流行の併発が懸念される。ワクチン接種戦略も進行中（第1回接種率73.79%）。州保健局による疫学速報が定期的に発表されており、監視体制は整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Новосибирской области ввели режим ЧС из-за массового заболевания скота
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Novosibirsk Oblast imposed a state of emergency due to a mass outbreak of cattle disease.
article.articleSummary: Novosibirsk Oblast, Russia, declared a regional state of emergency over outbreaks of pasteurellosis and rabies among cattle. On March 16, TASS cited regional Agriculture Minister Andrey Shindelov. The emergency enables coordinated response and tighter movement controls on livestock and animal products. Outbreaks were detected in early March; in districts with sanitary measures, no new foci were observed. The region lists 5 pasteurellosis foci and 42 rabies cases. Farmers in Novo-Pichugovo, Kozikhu, Lukoshino and Novoklyuchi blocked roads amid mass cattle slaughter; journalists were detained. Officials attribute culling to the outbreaks; some residents fear it could mask foot-and-mouth disease and trigger export bans to China, though the ministry denies this. The Investigative Committee opened checks into the regional ministry and farmers’ complaints; owners are urged to file compensation claims with district veterinary administrations.

triage.headline_ja: ノボシビルスク州が牛の大量発病により緊急事態体制を導入
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来疾病（狂犬病・口蹄疫）の複数焦点の発生と州レベルの緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準2つ以上該当。国際的な貿易制限リスク（中国への輸出禁止の懸念）と国内の対応困難性が認められるためWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病と口蹄疫（報告では「パスツレラ症」と「狂犬病」と記載）の複合発生。緊急事態宣言、家畜の大量殺処分、道路封鎖、記者拘束等の社会的混乱が報告されている。中国への輸出禁止リスクに関する住民の懸念も記載。動物疾病ではあるがフードセキュリティと国際貿易への影響の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Опасные комары и инфекция в воде: врачи рассказали, чем можно заразиться в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous mosquitoes and waterborne infections: doctors explain what you can catch in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: As of March 16, 2026, the Thai travel season poses health risks: in Phuket’s MBC Condotel (also reported in Koh Samui), tourists described mass gastrointestinal illness and conjunctivitis, with at least one child developing purulent tonsillitis; the cause is not yet known. Tourists attribute it to contaminated tap water used for rinsing and brushing teeth; water reportedly murky with a foul odor. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has sent an official inquiry to Thailand’s Ministry of Health for official investigation results and risk assessment under a bilateral sanitary cooperation memorandum. In addition to enteric infections, tropical diseases such as dengue and chikungunya pose threats; dengue can become severe on secondary infection. Travelers are advised to carry bottled water, or boil water and avoid ice.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な蚊と水の感染：医師がタイで感染する可能性のあるものを説明する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、ロシア保健当局による公式調査要請、観光地での集団発生、複数の病原体関与がある。
triage.notes: タイの観光地（プーケット、コサムイ）での集団発生事例。原因不明の胃腸炎・結膜炎と公知のデング・チクングニア熱が併存。ロシア連邦保健当局（Rospotrebnadzor）が公式調査を要請し、複数国間の協力枠組みが発動。国際観光客への曝露リスクが高く、水系感染症と蚊媒介感染症の複合発生の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: সারা গা র‌্যাশে ভরে গিয়েছে? চিকেন পক্সে আক্রান্ত কি না, বুঝবেন কোন কোন উপসর্গে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is your entire body covered in a rash? Which symptoms indicate that you have chickenpox?
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox, caused by Varicella Zoster Virus, is highly contagious and airborne. Incubation lasts 10–20 days, with initial fever, headache, fatigue, and loss of appetite, followed by a widespread, watery-vesicle rash. Some patients may have sore throat, pneumonia, or rare encephalitis. Transmission occurs via sneezing, coughing, saliva, and respiratory droplets; close household contact can spread infection, and vulnerable groups (children and the elderly) should be protected. There is no complete cure; recovery depends on the body’s immune response. Management emphasizes supportive care: ensure a clean, well-ventilated environment; avoid self-medication; use paracetamol for fever under medical advice; calamine lotion for skin inflammation; antivirals may be prescribed in some cases. Low-oil, low-spice meals are advised, and isolation helps prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 全身に発疹が出ている？水痘の症状をどう見分けるか
triage.triage_reason: 水痘（Varicella）は既知の感染症であり、本記事は啓発的なコンテンツです。ただし記事内に「稀な脳炎」という記載があり、未確認脳炎との関連が示唆されているため、情報確認が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事は主に水痘の症状認識と管理方法に関する啓発コンテンツ。Unknown Encephalitisの言及がありますが、具体的な発症例数や重症度の情報がなく、水痘に伴う稀な合併症の一般的説明と考えられます。インドでの特定の集団発生を示唆する具体的データは記事内に見当たりません。情報不足のため、WATCHとして経過を注視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: Минсельхоз Казахстана усилит профилактику заболеваний животных у границы с регионом РФ | Крестьянские ведомости
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kazakhstan's Ministry of Agriculture will intensify the prevention of animal diseases at the border with a region of the Russian Federation | Peasant Gazette
article.articleSummary: Kazakhstan's Ministry of Agriculture will intensify border controls to prevent animal-disease spread with Russia's Tyumen Oblast. Agriculture Minister Aidarbek Saparov, during a visit to a veterinary post in the border village of Yakor, ordered stronger veterinary surveillance and preventive measures to curb transmission of highly dangerous animal diseases and ensure timely, high-quality veterinary service for farmers. The facility serves about 3,500 head of livestock in the area. The move follows Tyumen regional authorities reporting more than 40 cases of animal rabies in 2026 to date, with emphasis on vaccinating all domestic animals in high-risk zones.

triage.headline_ja: カザフスタンの農業省がロシア連邦の地域との国境での動物疾病の予防を強化 | クレスチャンスキエ・ヴェドモスチ
triage.triage_reason: 動物狂犬病の多国境事象であり異常性と長期曝露のリスクが認められるが、ヒト感染への直接的な記載がなく、人的健康への影響の深刻度が不明であるため、追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: カザフスタンとロシア間での境界面での動物狂犬病事象。2026年現在、ロシア・チュメン州で40例以上の動物狂犬病が報告されており、カザフスタン側が積極的な国境警戒と家畜ワクチン接種を強化している。動物疾病であるが、狂犬病はヒト感染の可能性がある人獣共通感染症であるため、人的健康への潜在的リスクは否定できない。ただし現段階では記事にヒト感染者の記載がなく、対応状況からは管理的な対応がとられている印象。続報でヒト感染事例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Em 2026, SP registra o primeiro caso de sarampo: a doença está de volta?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In 2026, São Paulo records the first measles case: is the disease back?
article.articleSummary: First measles case in São Paulo in 2026: a six-month-old unvaccinated infant who imported from Bolivia, where she stayed until January; diagnosis confirmed March 4. Measles is highly contagious—an infected person can transmit to about 90% of susceptible contacts—and presents with high fever, exanthem, and a red rash, often with cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis; complications include otitis, pneumonia, seizures, encephalitis, and death. Brazilian expert Gonzalo Vecina says outbreak risk is minimal due to high vaccination coverage; Brazil regained measles elimination with ≥90% coverage, and WHO currently regards it as measles-free. Still, adults traveling should be vaccinated, especially when visiting outbreak regions such as Bolivia, the United States, and Canada. OPAS notes the Americas lost elimination status late in 2025, with 1,031 cases in 2026, up about 43-fold from 2025. Pre-travel immunoprophylaxis is available at institutions like Hospital das Clínicas da USP; seek care if ill. Border restrictions not deemed necessary.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、サンパウロで麻しんの初症例を記録：病気は戻ってきたのか？
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんと未知の脳炎が複数国（ブラジル、ボリビア、米国、カナダ）で検出され、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。さらにWPRO基準でも「異常性」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露リスク」が該当し、公衆衛生上の重大性がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2025年後半に麻しん排除状態を失失し、2026年に約1,031症例が報告されている。未知の脳炎が同時に言及されており、これは付加的な懸念要因。ボリビアでの流行地滞在の既往歴がある輸入症例であり、国際的な患者移動によるリスク拡大が実証されている。予防接種率は高いと報告されているが、複数国での流行状況の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Spray campaign kicks off in Madhubani to control kala-azar | Patna News - The Times of India
article.articleSummary: First round of indoor residual spray (IRS) launched in Madhubani district to prevent and control kala-azar. District vector-borne disease control officer Dr D S Singh said the IRS drive began Monday, targeting selected villages in five blocks—Kaluahi, Basopatti, Jhanjharpur, Ghoghardiha and Madhepur—based on last year’s kala-azar cases to curb potential infection sources. The campaign aims to destroy sand flies, the vectors transmitting kala-azar, by spraying insecticide on interior walls and corners. Purushottam Kumar, a vector-borne disease control official, urged residents to keep rooms open during spraying and to avoid touching or washing sprayed walls for several hours to ensure effectiveness. The health department asks residents to seek medical attention for symptoms such as prolonged fever, weight loss, or weakness.

triage.headline_ja: マドゥバニ県でカラアザル対策の噴霧キャンペーン開始 | パトナニュース - インディアン・タイムズ
triage.triage_reason: ビスセラ・リーシュマニア症（カラアザル）の既知の流行地域における定期的な媒介動物制御キャンペーンの報告。シグナルは明確な新規発生や急激な悪化を示しておらず、むしろ既存の公衆衛生対応の一環。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の大規模流行ではなく、ビハール州マドゥバニ県におけるカラアザル（リーシュマニア症）の定期的な予防・制御キャンペーン（IRS：室内残留噴霧）の実施報告。インドはカラアザル流行地域として知られており、本キャンペーンは既知のリスク管理活動と考えられる。新規患者数、死亡例、あるいは従来と異なるパターンに関する記述がないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には達しない。ただしビスセラ・リーシュマニア症は致死的疾患であり、長期的な曝露継続と流行可能性が存在するため、WATCH段階で動向を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Campak di Banten Mengarah KLB, Dinkes Diminta Jamin Stok Obat dan Vaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Banten on Track for an Outbreak, Health Office Asked to Guarantee Stock of Drugs and Vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak risk in Banten, Indonesia, with officials cautioning that conditions are moving toward a Kejadian Luar Biasa (KLB). The DPRD’s Health Commission members urge the provincial Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan) to guarantee adequate stock of measles medicines and the MR vaccine at puskesmas and health posts, amid rising surveillance-identified cases. From January to March 2026, more than 2,000 suspected measles cases have been reported across Banten, including red zones Pandeglang and Tangerang. In 2025, about 6,000 suspected cases were recorded, with roughly 510 laboratory-confirmed measles.
