Since the start of 2026, active surveillance at the care level has identified over 2,000 suspected cases; only one has been confirmed as measles in Tangerang. Dinkes is to be summoned for a hearing to report readiness and prevent distribution and supply bottlenecks if a KLB is declared.

triage.headline_ja: バンテン州の麻疹がKLB（異常集団発生）に向かっている、保健局に医薬品とワクチンの在庫保証を要求
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バンテン州で2026年1月～3月に2,000件以上の疑似麻疹症例が報告され、KLB（異常集団発生）リスクが指摘されている。地域的に限定されているが、予防接種体制の脆弱性と大規模流行の可能性がWPRO基準複数該当に値する。
triage.notes: バンテン州（Banten）はインドネシア首都圏に近い人口密集地域。2025年は約6,000疑似症例・510検査陽性、2026年初頭で既に2,000疑似症例が報告されている。パンデグラン（Pandeglang）とタンゲラン（Tangerang）が赤ゾーン（感染多地区）として特定されている。予防接種率や医療供給体制の脆弱性が懸念材料。地域発生の段階で国際的拡大リスクは現時点では判断不可。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis Symptoms: Tuberculosis can silently damage male fertility: Experts explain symptoms, sperm health risks and why early treatment matters - The Times of India
article.articleSummary: Genitourinary tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, can invade male reproductive organs (testicles, epididymis, prostate, urinary tract) and quietly damage fertility, particularly in India where extrapulmonary TB forms are substantial under the National TB Elimination Programme. Symptoms are often mild and may include testicular or scrotal pain/swelling, difficulty urinating, blood in semen or urine, and low-grade fever or weight loss, leading to delayed diagnosis. Early, full anti-TB therapy can prevent permanent damage; untreated infection may cause scarring, blockages, reduced sperm count or motility, and infertility. Diagnosis combines urine tests, semen analysis, ultrasound of reproductive organs, biopsy or culture. After treatment, fertility assessment guides the need for IVF or other interventions. Emphasizes screening both partners before pregnancy; TB remains airborne but is treatable, with many men regaining normal reproductive function when treated promptly, per 2026-03-16 reporting from The Times of India.

triage.headline_ja: 結核症状：結核は男性の生殖能力を静かに損傷する可能性がある：専門家は症状、精子の健康リスク、および早期治療が重要である理由を説明している - インドタイムズ紙
triage.triage_reason: 結核の泌尿生殖器合併症に関する医学的啓発記事であり、既知の公衆衛生課題の情報提供に該当。新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または急速な国際拡大の兆候は記事から認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の泌尿生殖器合併症に関する医学的教育コンテンツであり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。インドにおける結核患者の長期曝露リスクに言及しているが、疾患自体の急速な増加やコントロール不能な状況を示唆していない。国家結核排除プログラム（NTEP）下での既存の公衆衛生対応の枠組みを前提としている。シグナルトリアージというよりも、既知の感染症の臨床管理に関する情報提供記事として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim Sebut Indonesia Nomor Dua Kasus TBC, Soroti Permukiman Kumuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim Says Indonesia Ranks Second in TB Cases, Highlighting Slum Settlements
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis (TB) cases, behind only India, according to Hashim Djojohadikusumo, at the Manggarai Station vertical-housing inauguration in Jakarta on 16 March 2026. He attributes the TB burden to slum-adjacent housing, citing validation from a Free Health Check program that screened 72 million people and found TB and related illnesses. He warns TB and stunting as national calamities, linking health outcomes to living environments. The event aligns with APBN 2026 funding for the 3 Juta Rumah program, totaling 57.7 trillion IDR to support about 770,000 housing units through schemes including FLPP (33.5 trillion), SMF blending (6.6 trillion), SBUM (5.6 trillion), BSPS (8.6 trillion), and KUR Perumahan with up to 20 billion per borrower and a 130 trillion target. Additionally, a 3.4 trillion IDR PPN DTP tax incentive is allocated for 40,000 units.

triage.headline_ja: ハシムがインドネシアは結核患者数で第2位と述べ、スラム居住区に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、この記事は既存の疾病負担を述べたものであるため、IHR基準2つ以上の該当はない。ただし、インドネシアの第2位の結核負担という公衆衛生的重要性とスクリーニング基準の複数該当から、継続的な監視の対象とする。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、新規アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。ただし、インドネシアの第2位の全球結核負担、スラム居住環境との関連性、57.7兆IDRの3百万住宅プログラムによる政府の対応など、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。記事は政策立案者（Hashim）による公式声明であり、政治的関心が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Chuva e calor reforçam alerta para prevenção da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Rain and heat intensify dengue prevention alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, heavy rains and heat in São Paulo state, Brazil, raise a dengue prevention alert as ongoing downpours since the start of the year create ideal conditions for Aedes aegypti breeding. In Jundiaí, 156 dengue cases are confirmed and 37 suspected awaiting test results, according to the city's Arboviroses Bulletin. Health experts emphasize simple home and outdoor measures to eliminate standing water and reduce transmission risk. Dengue typically presents with abrupt fever, malaise, muscle pains, rash, and headache; in severe cases, fluid accumulation can occur in body cavities. The critical phase often centers in the first ten days, with fever lasting through about the first week. Recovery varies and can last up to a month, depending on individual immune response and disease severity.

triage.headline_ja: JJ: 雨と暑さはデング熱予防アラートを強化する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州のデング熱確認症例（156例）と気候条件による媒介蚊の繁殖リスク上昇が報告されているが、国際的拡大の即時的脅威や国家的危機管理の必要性を示唆する情報は不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジルのデング熱は季節的現象として認識されており、当該記事は予防啓発が主眼。ただし156確認例は軽微な数値であり、全体的な流行状況の把握が必要。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、フルRRA前の情報不足により WATCH 判定。続報で症例数急増、死亡者数増加、国境を越えた拡大などが確認されれば PICKUP に昇格する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Tanjungpinang Temukan 26 Kasus Suspek Campak Sejak Awal 2026, Ingatkan Warga soal Imunisasi - Kepri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tanjungpinang Health Office Finds 26 Suspected Measles Cases Since the Start of 2026, Reminds Residents About Immunization - Kepri
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Tanjungpinang, Kepulauan Riau, have reached 26 suspected since the start of 2026, according to the city Health Office. Eight samples have been sent to a laboratory for confirmatory testing to determine if they are positive for measles; results are pending. Nationally, Indonesia reported about 10,453 suspected measles cases to date. In 2025, Tanjungpinang recorded 10 confirmed measles cases and 2 rubella cases. Despite the rise in suspected cases this year, health officials say transmission remains under control and the situation is normal. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease especially dangerous for children around 9 months. Preventive measures emphasize routine immunization per schedule from infancy through school age, along with good nutrition to support immunity. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets; key symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a red rash.

triage.headline_ja: タンジュンピナン保健所、2026年初頭から麻疹疑い患者26例を発見、住民に予防接種を呼びかけ - ケプリ州
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の複数症例発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、確定例の情報不足と「状況は正常」との当局評価があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: タンジュンピナン市で26件の麻疹疑い患者が2026年初頭から報告されており、8サンプルが検査中。インドネシア全国では約10,453件の疑い患者が報告されている。2025年は同市で麻疹10例、風疹2例が確定。当局は「感染は制御下にあり状況は正常」と述べているが、確定例の詳細情報が不足しており、検査結果待ち。麻疹は高い伝播性を持つウイルス性疾患であり、児童約9ヶ月齢で特に危険。予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária: vigilância se intensifica e 93 propriedades rurais entram no radar sanitário | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: surveillance intensifies and 93 rural properties enter the sanitary surveillance radar | South Zone
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (H5N1) detected at Estação Ecológica do Taim, located between Rio Grande and Santa Vitória do Palmar in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The outbreak has resulted in 25 dead birds at the reserve, with the most recent death recorded on Friday 13 March; the sanctuary has been closed since 3 March and will remain closed until authorities consider the focus controlled. To prevent spread to domestic or commercial flocks, the state Department of Agriculture intensified sanitary surveillance, planning inspections of 93 rural properties within a 10-km radius of the detection site. Since early March, teams have assessed farm sanitation and clinical signs. A training program reached 186 health and social workers in Rio Grande, Santa Vitória do Palmar, and Chuí. Additional inspections cover Pelotas regional commercial poultry farms and ornamental-bird breeders. Suspected cases should be reported immediately to authorities; look for respiratory or neurological signs and sudden mortality in birds.

triage.headline_ja: トリ インフルエンザ：監視が強化され、93の農村地域が衛生監視下に入る｜南地域
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1の検出という異常で予想外のイベントであり、野生動物での確認と国内・商業養鶏フロックへの拡大リスクが存在。IHR基準2つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ブラジル南部Rio Grande do Sulでの高病原性H5N1の野生動物での初期検出。既に93の農村地域が監視対象となり、186名の保健従事者が訓練を受けている。商業養鶏フロックおよび愛玩鳥飼育者への拡大を防ぐための積極的な防御対応が展開中。南米における家畜への動物インフルエンザ拡大リスクは国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com teste de HIV positivo confirmado em voz alta em UPA no interior de SP: veja o que se sabe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with a confirmed positive HIV test announced aloud at a UPA in the interior of São Paulo: see what is known.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old man in Ribeirão Preto, interior of São Paulo, alleges that at UPA Oeste Sumarezinho his HIV-positive result was announced aloud by healthcare staff, exposing him and causing public humiliation. He had sought Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) after a suspected risk; PEP is free, confidential, should be started within 72 hours and lasts 28 days. The patient says a nurse insisted on blood collection and, while waiting, others could hear the diagnosis; minutes later another nurse reportedly confirmed two additional reactive tests in front of his niece and other patients. He reported the incident to the Civil Police; the case was initially filed as defamation, later changed to injúria racial/equivalent to homophobia, and medical confidentiality violation. The Municipal Health Secretariat initiated an administrative investigation and has suspended a professional. Brazilian law prohibits disclosure of health status for HIV; confidentiality is a professional duty.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州内陸部のUPAでHIV陽性検査結果が大声で告知される：分かっていることを確認
triage.triage_reason: 本件は個別患者の医療プライバシー侵害事件であり、感染症集団発生や公衆衛生上の急性脅威ではない。HIV感染者1例の事例報告であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは医療提供者による患者プライバシー侵害および人権問題として重要だが、感染症サーベイランス対象外。患者数は1例、集団発生の兆候なし。感染症危機管理シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Belém está entre cidades em alerta para Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave, alerta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belém is among the cities on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome, Fiocruz warns.
article.articleSummary: Belém, Pará, is among capitals on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe Bulletin released March 13, covering epidemiological week 9 (through March 7). Pará is in a group of states with alert, risk or high-risk activity in the last two weeks. Nationally, all states except Tocantins show SRAG growth; 12 states are in alert/risk/high risk: Acre, Amazonas, Pará, Amapá, Rondônia, Roraima, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Distrito Federal, Ceará and Sergipe. Long-term and short-term SRAG increases are driven mainly by rhinovirus (notably in ages 2–14), influenza A, and RSV, with SARS-CoV-2 contributing modestly. RSV strongly affects children under 2 in the North/Northeast; vaccination is emphasized: influenza vaccination underway in the North, and RSV vaccine for pregnant women from 28 weeks. Mask use and isolation advised. Nationally, 16,882 SRAG cases in 2026, with 6,064 lab-positive (35.9%).

triage.headline_ja: ベレンは重症急性呼吸器症候群に対するアラート対象都市の中に含まれている、Fiocruzが警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国12州を含む複数の州での重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の増加が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。また、複数州での同時多発的な呼吸器症候群流行は国際的懸念事項となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: ブラジル北部・北東部で複数の呼吸器ウイルス（ライノウイルス、インフルエンザA、RSV）による同時流行が確認されている。2026年の全国SRAG患者数は16,882例（検査陽性6,064例、35.9%）。Fiocruzは公式な流行情報速報（InfoGripe Bulletin）を発表しており、政府レベルでの対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 经济观察报 记者 张铃经济观察报获悉，3月16日，由中国创新药公司华辉安健原研的肝病新药立贝韦塔单抗开出全球首张处方。当天，在经过全面的研究及病情评估后，北京友谊医院肝病中心首席专家贾继东为一位男性慢性丁型肝炎病毒（HDV）感染患者开出处方。该患者8年前查出慢性乙型肝炎，5年前又诊断出慢性丁型肝炎。经过药物控制，他的乙肝病毒得到了控制，但丁肝病毒未能有效控制，导致其出现早期肝硬化症状。在病毒性肝炎领域，立贝韦塔单抗是全球首个抗体类药物，也是中国首个丁肝治疗药物，填补该领域治疗空白。此前，该药已分别获得中国药品审评中心（CDE）和美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的突破性疗法认定。立贝韦塔单抗是中国自主研发的源头创新产品。2012年，北京生命科学研究所研究员李文辉在世界上首先发现了乙肝病毒受体，为药物研发开辟了新路径。三年后，基于此发现，他与妻子隋建华，北生所同事黄嵩、齐湘兵作为联合创始人成立了华辉安健，尝试研发更安全有效的治疗乙肝和丁肝的药物。十年过去，第一款新药立贝韦塔单抗终于上市，实现从靶点机制到药物创制的全流程自主创新。在药物研发全流程中，贾继东带领北京友谊医院肝病中心推动Ⅰ期临床试验落地、敲定研究方案并首发临床核心数据，协调Ⅱ期、Ⅲ期临床试验阶段国外受试者诊疗相关事宜，在监管部门、企业、医院与患者间搭建起沟通桥梁。长期以来，慢性丁型肝炎在全球范围内面临有效治疗药物严重匮乏的困境，临床需求极为迫切。贾继东介绍，慢性丁肝由乙肝病毒和丁肝病毒合并感染导致，是最严重的慢性病毒性肝炎，显著加速肝脏相关死亡及肝细胞癌的进展。在临床诊疗中，医生可在乙肝抗病毒治疗的基础上，联合使用立贝韦塔单抗注射液，能有效抑制丁肝和乙肝病毒复制，改善肝功能，降低肝脏硬度，更好地控制患者病情，降低肝硬化、肝癌的发生风险，显著改善患者预后。华辉安健董事长隋建华此前在接受经济观察报采访时透露，立贝韦塔单抗开出首张处方单后，将争取早日进入医保，并争取尽快出海到"一带一路"丁肝高发国家。
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global first prescription issued for Huahui Anjian's liver-disease monoclonal antibody Libiveta
article.articleSummary: On March 16, 2026, Huahui Anjian’s liver-disease monoclonal antibody Libiveta received the world’s first prescription for a male patient at Beijing Friendship Hospital’s Liver Disease Center. The patient has chronic hepatitis B diagnosed 8 years ago and chronic hepatitis D (HDV) diagnosed 5 years ago; HBV was controlled under therapy, but HDV remained active with early cirrhosis. Libiveta is the first antibody therapy for hepatitis and China’s first HDV treatment, with Breakthrough Therapy Designations from CDE and FDA. Developed domestically, Libiveta stems from 2012 HBV receptor discovery by Li Wenhui and the formation of Huahui Anjian. Dr. Jia Jidong led Phase I and coordinated Phase II/III with international sites, bridging regulators, industry, hospitals. HDV co-infection accelerates liver death and hepatocellular carcinoma; combined with HBV antivirals, Libiveta inhibits HDV/HBV replication, improves liver function, reduces fibrosis, and lowers cancer risk. The company aims for insurance coverage and Belt Road expansion to HDV hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: 経済観察報: 華輝安健の肝臓疾患新薬立貝韋塔単抗が全球初処方を発行 - 北京友誼医院で慢性丁型肝炎患者に投与
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは医学的に重要な新薬承認・治療開始ですが、既存の疾患患者への治療イベントであり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の急性危機、または国際的な感染拡大を示すものではありません。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しません。
triage.notes: 本記事は新薬承認・臨床応用のニュースです。既存の慢性B型肝炎・D型肝炎患者への治療開始を報じるもので、疾患サーベイランスやアウトブレイク検出のシグナルではありません。感染症危機管理フレームワーク（IHR/WPRO基準）の対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Precision mapping identifies household hotspots of schistosomiasis
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis, affecting more than 250 million people worldwide, persists in localized household hotspots as regions edge toward elimination, a 13-year study reports. Researchers from the Colorado School of Public Health and the Sichuan Center for Disease Control and Prevention, with NIH support, used high-precision mapping that blends field data and AI to show transmission concentrates around specific households rather than villages. The study followed Chinese villages over 13 years, focusing on Schistosoma japonicum; earlier work contrasted snail surveillance with risk mapping based on roads, water sources, and land use. Implications for low-resource settings include using census data and Village Health Teams, but obtaining reliable infection data remains a challenge. Findings suggest mass treatment alone won’t end transmission; sanitation, farming practices, and environmental exposure must be addressed. Policy should sustain surveillance, improve sanitation, and target high-risk groups near lakes to prevent resurgence; methods may apply to the US and other regions.

triage.headline_ja: 精密マッピングが住家単位の住血吸虫症ホットスポットを特定
triage.triage_reason: 13年間の疫学研究報告であり、現在の流行拡大や急性危機を示唆する記事ではない。ただし250万人以上が罹患する公衆衛生問題の除去戦略に関わる重要な科学的知見のため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の四川省における過去13年間の研究成果の報告であり、緊急性の高い現在進行形の流行拡大ではない。住血吸虫症は慢性感染症であり、公衆衛生上の重要な問題だが、本記事は流行状況の急変や国際的な危機を示唆しない。ただし根絶戦略の科学的基盤に関わる情報として一定の価値があるため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 16 suspek campak di Kabupaten Madiun sepanjang Januari-Maret 2026 - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 16 suspected measles cases in Madiun Regency over January–March 2026 - ANTARA News
article.articleSummary: 16 suspected measles cases among children were recorded in Madiun Regency from January to mid-March 2026, according to the Madiun District Health Office. The health office continues outreach to communities and healthcare workers and is intensifying measles vaccination to prevent a wider outbreak, especially ahead of Lebaran. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details or infection sources, and no confirmed case or death counts are listed. Emphasis remains on vaccination and public information as preventive measures. The article also notes ongoing surveillance and vaccination campaigns by the district health office to curb potential transmission among children as of March 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年1月～3月のマディウン県における麻疹疑い患者16例 - ANTARA News
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の疑い患者16例が報告されているが、確定症例なし、死亡なし、検査確認なし、感染源不明と情報が限定的。地域限定的（インドネシア単一県）で国際拡大リスク不明だが、麻疹は本質的に感染しやすい疾患のため継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 16例はすべて疑い患者であり確定症例数不明。死亡報告なし。検査確認の詳細なし。マディウン県（インドネシア）に限定された報告。地域保健所による予防接種キャンペーン継続中。麻疹は高い感染性を有するため、今後の確定症例増加や地域拡大があれば重要度が上昇する可能性あり。WPROスクリーニング基準で「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」が該当するため WATCH レベルの経過観察が推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kecamatan Saradan dan Geger Jadi Penyumbang Terbanyak Suspek Campak di Madiun Selama 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saradan and Geger Districts Become the Largest Contributors of Suspected Measles in Madiun During 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles (Campak) suspected in Madiun Regency, Indonesia, through mid-March 2026, with 16 pediatric cases reported by the Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Madiun. No laboratory-confirmed measles cases yet; blood samples have been collected and sent to Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Surabaya for confirmation. The most affected districts are Saradan and Geger, each with three suspected cases; others are scattered across the district. Common symptoms include high fever, red rash, conjunctivitis, runny nose, and nausea/vomiting. Health authorities issued vigilance notices to 26 puskesmas and three hospitals (RSUD Caruban, RSUD Dolopo, RS Paru Dungus) and are launching a Catch-Up immunization campaign from 30 March to 12 April 2026 to immunize children with incomplete vaccination status. Immunization schedule: first dose at 9 months, second at 18 months, booster at 5-7 years.

triage.headline_ja: マディウン県における麻疹疑い例：2026年のサラダン地区とゲゲル地区が最多報告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・マディウン県で小児16例の麻疹疑い例が報告されており、麻疹はIHR対象疾患です。国内で継続的な曝露リスクがあり、予防接種キャンペーン実施予定など公衆衛生上の対応が取られています。IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な影響・予想外性）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 麻疹は国際的に注視される疾患です。現在のところ確定例はなく検査中ですが、16例の疑い例、複数地区での散発的発生、小児層への影響、当局による迅速な対応（予防接種キャンペーン計画）が確認されています。今後の検査結果と発生動向に注視が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Kucing Rabies, DPRD Sumba Timur Minta Pengawasan HPR dari Luar Diperketat - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Rabies in Cats, East Sumba DPRD Calls for Tightened Monitoring of Out-of-Region Rabies-Transmitting Animals - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleSummary: Rabies in cats triggered a call by East Sumba Regency's DPRD to tighten monitoring of rabies-transmitting animals entering Sumba Island. A rabies-infected cat reportedly bit 11 people in Atambua, Belu Regency, on 16 March 2026, indicating exposure outside Sumba. The member Umbu Hapu Mbeju urged stricter entry controls at borders, coordinating with Balai Karantina Hewan, Waingapu Port authorities, Waingapu Airport unit, and PELNI to curb cross-region incursions. He also urged training to recognize rabies signs and public education for early prevention. He warned the virus could already be present in East Sumba Timur despite no confirmed cases. Dinas Peternakan notes health officers in 22 districts, and residents should report suspected cases to nearby animal health workers for rapid action. Rabies vectors include cats and dogs; emphasis on surveillance and community vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 猫の狂犬病を予防、東スンバDPRDは域外からの狂犬病媒介動物の監視強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の動物での検出と人への曝露事例（11名）が報告されており、異常性と公衆衛生上の懸念は認められるが、死亡例の有無、現地での確認確定診断、国際的拡大リスクの詳細が不明であるため、現在は経過観察段階が適切である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの地理情報に異常あり（フェロー諸島、ケニアなど無関連地域を含む）。記事実質はインドネシア・スンバ島での猫咬傷による狂犬病曝露事例（11名）と予防措置の呼びかけ。死亡例の有無、確定診断状況、地域医療体制の対応能力が評価に必要。狂犬病の高致命率を考慮すると、死亡例有無の確認次第でPICKUPへの昇格を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: "Estamos desnudos": productores de huevos pidieron comenzar a vacunar para detener el avance de la influenza aviar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We're naked": Egg producers asked to start vaccinating to halt the advance of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Argentina’s poultry sector faces pressure to vaccinate against avian influenza to halt spread. While the European Union, the Americas, and countries like China vaccinate poultry, Argentina persists with a non-vaccination policy. Capia president Javier Prida says: 'we are not vaccinating, and if we vaccinate, markets close for vaccinating.' He warns that when a farm contracts avian influenza, workers and producers lose livelihoods as authorities cull infected birds under World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE/WOAH) guidelines, with no compensation. The stance leaves producers exposed and highlights the clash between export-driven market access and disease control, with ongoing implications for imported/exported poultry and farm livelihoods in Argentina. The article does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: 「我々は無防備だ」：鶏卵生産者が鳥インフルエンザの蔓延を食い止めるためのワクチン接種開始を要求
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザのアルゼンチン国内蔓延と複数国への影響が示唆されているが、人間への感染の具体的な報告がなく、情報が限定的であるため。IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目で「不明」が多く、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンの家きん部門における鳥インフルエンザ蔓延を扱っており、IHR基準を3つ満たしている。しかし、記事タイトルに「Human Infection with Avian Influenza」が疾患として登録されているにもかかわらず、本文では人間への感染具体例の報告がない。アルゼンチン、スペイン（カナリア諸島）、中国が地域として列挙されており、複数地域への影響が示唆されている。ワクチン接種政策をめぐる国際的な対応の不一致も注目される。人間への感染確認と詳細な流行規模の情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alunos analisam ciclo do mosquito Aedes aegypti em Florianópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Students analyze the life cycle of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in Florianópolis.
article.articleSummary: In Florianópolis, elementary students at EBM Gentil da Conceição in the Rio Vermelho neighborhood study the Aedes aegypti life cycle to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Over a month, the class observes larvae, pupae, and adults, installs traps around the school, and monitors them for 15 days to detect ongoing mosquito activity. Collected samples are secured and examined with a magnifier and microscope, enabling students to visualize developmental stages and learn why the mosquito thrives in standing water. The project also includes educational outreach, with pupils preparing guidance for the school community on prevention and eliminating water-filled containers. As the main dengue vector in Brazil, Aedes aegypti poses public health risks, and the initiative links classroom science to real-world efforts to reduce breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: フロリアノーポリスでAedes aegypti蚊の生活環を学生が分析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、ジカウイルス感染症、チクングニア熱）の媒介蚊に関する教育的取り組みについての報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルを示していない。予防活動の学校教育プログラムであり、疾患の発生増加や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は蚊媒介感染症の予防教育に関する学校の教育的イニシアティブであり、感染症の患者発生やアウトブレイク、疾患統計の異常を報告していない。媒介蚊の生物学的知見に基づく予防活動の推進であり、シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Segundo caso de mpox em 2026 é confirmado no Ceará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second case of mpox in 2026 is confirmed in Ceará.
article.articleSummary: In Ceará state, Brazil, the second mpox (monkeypox) case of 2026 is confirmed, with data from IntegrSUS showing 27 suspected notifications, 17 ruled out and 8 still under investigation. The first case was confirmed on March 9 in a male patient who is improving clinically. Mpox is a viral disease transmitted primarily through close contact, causing fever, body aches, and skin lesions. Health authorities urge medical evaluation for suspected symptoms. The Ceará Health Secretariat states ongoing epidemiological surveillance since 2022, including case investigation and guidance to health services to ensure timely diagnosis, adequate patient care, and adherence to Ministry of Health guidelines. Preventive measures include avoiding direct contact with suspected or confirmed cases, regular hand hygiene with soap and water or sanitizer, and wearing a mask in high-risk situations or when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のセアラ州における2番目のmpox症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの確定症例2件は公衆衛生上の懸念を示しているが、患者数が限定的であり、現在のところ国際的拡大の明確な証拠がない。情報源が地域ニュースサイトのみで、詳細な疫学情報が不足しているため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 27件の疑似症通知があり、継続的な監視体制が2022年から整備されている点が注目される。患者数は現在少数だが、感染しやすい特性（ヒト-ヒト感染可能）があるため、増加傾向の有無を注視する必要がある。今後の更新情報によりPICKUP判定に変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt cao kèm rét run kéo dài: Cô gái mắc bệnh nhiễm khuẩn tiết niệu nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent high fever with prolonged chills: A girl contracts a dangerous urinary tract infection.
article.articleSummary: A 29-year-old woman in Hanoi presented with fever up to 40°C, chills, and back pain. Urinary tract infection due to Streptococcus agalactiae (Group B Streptococcus) was diagnosed; she has a history of polycystic ovary syndrome with amenorrhea for about a year. Laboratory tests showed CRP 59.32 mg/L; urinalysis revealed pyuria and hematuria. MEDLATEC Tay Ho confirmed Streptococcus agalactiae on urine culture at >100,000 CFU/mL, supporting UTI with possible progression to pyelonephritis. She received outpatient antibiotics guided by antimicrobial susceptibility testing. After one week, fever and flank pain resolved and repeat urinalysis normalized. UTIs are common in women; GBS can colonize the gut/genital tract and cause upper-tract infection if untreated. This case underscores early urine culture and targeted therapy to prevent complications such as renal involvement.

triage.headline_ja: 高熱と長引く悪寒：危険な尿路感染症に罹患した女性
triage.triage_reason: 本例はハノイの個別患者事例であり、集団発生や流行の兆候がなく、IHR基準を満たさない。公衆衛生上の広域的な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本報告は単一患者の尿路感染症（GBS起因）の臨床的経過を記述した医学的症例報告である。Group B Streptococcusによる尿路感染症は高リスク集団（妊娠中の女性など）では関心が高いが、本例は特定個人の治療結果を述べたもので、公衆衛生上の集団的懸念やアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。また、適切な抗菌療法により完治しており、新興感染症の警告信号としての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Santos testa drone para identificar e eliminar focos da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santos tests a drone to identify and eliminate dengue hotspots.
article.articleSummary: In Santos, Brazil, the municipal health department piloted a drone-equipped vector-control strategy against Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya, and Zika vector. The first test flight is planned at Paquetá Cemetery on Rua Dr. Cochrane. Trained vector-control agents will operate it. The drone can identify breeding hotspots in hard-to-access areas and can apply larvicide to larvae and insecticide to adult mosquitoes at identified sites, accelerating control measures and potentially reducing transmission risk. Public participation remains essential; residents are urged to periodically inspect yards, gutters, and water-holding containers. The city will also run mutirões and educational activities, including in Vila Mathias, with a waste-collection firm assisting in removing discarded items that collect water. A week-long agenda runs March 16–20, 2026, with events at Jabaquara Polyclinic, Paquetá Cemetery, Vila Mathias, Encruzilhada Market, UME Porchat de Assis, and Poupatempo Santos.

triage.headline_ja: サントスがデング熱の発生源を特定・排除するドローンをテスト
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサントス市による蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）対策のドローン導入試験。既知の地域的公衆衛生対策であり、新規の感染症クラスタ発生や異常な疾病パターンではなく、予防・コントロール技術の展開である。
triage.notes: 本件はブラジル・サントス市による既知の蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）に対する技術的な予防対策（ドローンによる蚊の発生源特定と駆除）の展開事例。新規感染症発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、公衆衛生施策の革新的な試みとして報道されている。シグナル識別の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau implanta Protocolo Estadual de Vigilância para Micoses Endêmicas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat Implements State Surveillance Protocol for Endemic Mycoses
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-16, in Maceió, Alagoas, Brazil, the State Health Secretariat (Sesau) hosted the Workshop for Implementation of the State Surveillance Protocol for Endemic Mycoses at Seplag to align surveillance, diagnosis, and management of systemic fungal infections. Key endemic mycoses include paracoccidioidomycosis, histoplasmosis, and cryptococcosis. The protocol strengthens the State Health Network’s capacity for ongoing monitoring of these diseases. The event also covered the National Surveillance Protocol for Endemic and Opportunistic Mycoses and the Ministry of Health’s Information System for Endemic and Opportunistic Mycoses, used for antifungal drug requests and consolidating detection, notification, and clinical management guidelines. Clarício Bugarim, coordinator of Sesau's State Zoonoses Control Program (veterinarian), noted that all fungal disease treatments are provided by the SUS. He urged people with fever, weight loss, weakness, cough or breathing difficulty, or skin/mucosal lesions to seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: State Health Secretariat Implements State Surveillance Protocol for Endemic Mycoses
triage.triage_reason: 本件は地方保健当局による既知の風土病（ヒストプラスマ症、パラコクシジオイデス症、クリプトコッカス症）の監視プロトコル実装に関する行政措置の発表であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または国際的拡大のリスクを示唆する情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本件は公衆衛生上の警告イベントではなく、ブラジル・アラゴアス州における既知の風土病に対する診断・管理能力の強化を目的とした行政的な監視プロトコル実装ワークショップの開催報告。新規発生、クラスター、または異常な疾病動向を報告するものではない。政府関係機関による計画的な公衆衛生上の取り組みとして評価される。

article.articleHeadline: CCSS inicia este lunes vacunación contra fiebre amarilla para viajeros a Brasil, Perú y África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCSS to begin yellow fever vaccination for travelers to Brazil, Peru, and Africa this Monday.
article.articleSummary: As of March 16, 2026, Costa Rica's Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social (CCSS) will begin administering the yellow fever vaccine to travelers aged 9 months to under 60 years headed to Brazil, Peru, Colombia (already covered), and African countries. The initiative, announced March 12, follows a directive from the Ministry of Health due to epidemiological risk in these regions and to bolster protection against yellow fever among international travelers. Vaccination is part of pre-travel health measures for destinations with transmission risk, reinforcing Costa Rica's preventive public health strategy. The report does not mention locally confirmed yellow fever cases or specific outbreak data, focusing solely on this policy change.

triage.headline_ja: CCSS、ブラジル、ペルー、アフリカへの渡航者向け黄熱病予防接種を今週月曜に開始
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病は重大な感染症であり複数国での流行リスク指摘があるが、記事は予防接種政策の発表に焦点であり、具体的な患者数やアウトブレーク情報が記載されていない。社会的関心はあるが、IHR基準の明確な該当を判断する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種政策の発表であり、具体的な患者数、死亡例、アウトブレークの規模などの詳細情報が欠落している。黄熱病の重篤性と複数国での流行リスクは明記されているが、現在の流行状況、患者統計、重症度データが記載されていないため、より詳細な情報を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kucing Rabies Ngamuk di Belu NTT, 11 Warga Digigit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid cat rampages in Belu, East Nusa Tenggara; 11 residents bitten.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia, after a rabid domestic cat bit 11 residents in Manumutin, Atambua City District, on Sunday 15 March 2026. All victims received immediate care the same day, with anti-rabies vaccination administered at local puskesmas. The cat, which had an owner, was captured; rapid testing at the Belu Animal Health and Fisheries Service laboratory returned positive for rabies. Health authorities are conducting community education on rabies risks and urged reporting of dogs, cats, and primates for vaccination; seized animals are to be confined to cut transmission. The owner-owned cat is suspected to have contracted rabies suddenly, possibly after an exposure to another rabid animal such as a dog. Ongoing measures emphasize vaccination, confinement of potentially rabid animals, and continued surveillance to halt the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 東ヌサトゥンガラ州ベル県での狂犬病ネコ暴動、11人が咬傷被害
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の動物由来事例であり、公衆衛生への潜在的な懸念は存在するが、現在のところ致死例は報告されておらず、また迅速な予防接種対応がなされている。情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が極めて高い疾患であり、理論的には公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。ただし、本事例では被害者11名全員が咬傷当日に抗狂犬病ワクチン接種を受けており、適切な対応がなされている点が重要。死亡例や重症化の報告がないため、現段階では情報不足として「不明」と判定。原因動物の検査が実施され、陽性確認および隔離措置が取られており、管理可能性は確保されているものと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Com 118 casos suspeitos de leptospirose em Ubá, Secretário de MG nega surto: 'Maioria negativo'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 118 suspected leptospirosis cases in Ubá, Minas Gerais' secretary denies outbreak: 'Most are negative'.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Ubá, Minas Gerais's Zona da Mata remains under investigation rather than a declared outbreak. Since Feb 24, Ubá recorded 118 suspected cases following severe floods; 19 discarded and 98 remain under laboratory investigation, with results from Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte. The only confirmed diagnosis is a 33-year-old woman from Ubá who died from leptospirosis, a disease transmitted through water or mud contaminated with rodent urine. Authorities emphasize no vaccine exists; early notification and prompt treatment are critical. Common symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, nausea and malaise; severe cases involve persistent fever, vomiting, breathing difficulty. Preventive guidance focuses on protective gear during cleanup. Minas Gerais government is allocating about R$ 8.3 million to Ubá to strengthen health services and storage of medicines and vaccines; an epidemiological alert and intensified surveillance were issued on Feb 24.

triage.headline_ja: ウバでレプトスピラ症の疑い例118件、ミナスジェライス州の担当官は感染症流行を否定：「大多数は陰性」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、重症度、国際的拡大リスク）し、死亡例を含む確定例が存在。また洪水後の水系媒介感染症であり、公衆衛生上の影響と継続的な曝露リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 洪水関連の水系媒介感染症であり、環境因子による継続的曝露リスクが存在。確定死亡例が報告されており、98件の検査結果待機中。政府は保健サービス強化のため約830万レアル（R$8.3 million）を配分予定。ブラジルは西半球における重要な感染症監視対象国。

article.articleHeadline: कुत्ते के काटने के बाद भौंकने लगा 12 साल का किशोर, तबीयत बिगड़ने पर BHU रेफर - mirzapur boy barks like dog after rabies incomplete vaccine fatal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12-year-old Mirzapur boy began barking like a dog after a dog bite; condition worsened, referred to BHU after incomplete rabies vaccination, fatal.
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old Karan from Mirzapur’s Jogi Pur ward developed rabies symptoms four months after a dog bite in Harhua, Varanasi district. After receiving two rabies vaccine injections during the initial bite and one later at a private clinic, two doses remained missing. On Friday night he suddenly grew fearful, his voice deepened, and he began barking like dogs. He was taken to CHC Kachwan, where clinicians diagnosed rabies and referred him to the Varanasi Trauma Center (reported as BHU in the headline). He remains with his maternal grandfather in Harhua, with no improvement reported. The incident underscores that incomplete rabies vaccination can be fatal; the full post-exposure schedule is 0, 3, 7, 14, 28 days, and vaccination within 24 hours after any animal bite is essential. Early symptoms include fever, headache, weakness, agitation, or paralysis.

triage.headline_ja: イヌに咬まれた後、犬のように吠えるようになった12歳の少年。不完全な狂犬病ワクチン接種後に重篤化し、BHUに紹介され、致命的な転帰。
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡症例であり、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響・重篤度）に該当。予防接種遺漏による予防可能な死亡であり、シグナルとしてフルRRA進行を要する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は確定的に致命的な疾患（Case Fatality Ratio ~100%）。本事例は予防接種遺漏が直接的な死因であり、公衆衛生上の予防接種プログラム管理の失敗を示唆。インド北部における狂犬病の継続的なヘルスシステムチャレンジを反映。ただしIHR基準「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」には該当しない散発事例。WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当（異常・重症度・管理可能性）。

article.articleHeadline: Pau D'arco do PiauÃ­ recebe equipe para combater esquistossomose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pau D'arco in Piauí receives a team to combat schistosomiasis.
article.articleSummary: Pau D'Arco do Piauí, Brazil, was designated to receive a state government technical team tasked with patrolling and curbing the freshwater snail vector that transmits schistosomiasis (barriga d'água). Occurring in the rainy season when environmental conditions favor snail reproduction and raise transmission risk, the one-week operation will include monitoring, public guidance, and risk-area surveys across urban and rural parts of the municipality, with particular focus on leisure venues and locations with standing water. Schistosomiasis is caused by the parasite Schistosoma mansoni, and humans become infected through contact with contaminated freshwater inhabited by infected snails. The effort highlights municipal public health commitment and institutional partnerships for ongoing sanitation surveillance and disease prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州パウ・ダルコが住血吸虫症に対処するためのチームを受け入れる
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である住血吸虫症の既存制御活動の報道。新規発生やアウトブレークではなく、季節的な予防措置であるため、IHR基準の該当が限定的。
triage.notes: ブラジルではいくつかの地域で風土病として定着している住血吸虫症。本ニュースは雨季における既存の制御・監視活動であり、新規のアウトブレークシグナルではない。スクリーニング基準で「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が該当するが、政府対応が実施されており管理可能と判断される。情報不足のため段階的に監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Program Perumahan Rakyat untuk Kesehatan Masyarakat: Tekan Kasus TBC dan Stunting - RRI.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Housing Program for Public Health: Curb TB Cases and Stunting - RRI.co.id
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's 3 Million Homes public housing program is touted as a public-health strategy to curb tuberculosis and stunting by improving living environments. On 16 March 2026 at Manggarai Station, Jakarta, Hashim Djojohadikusumo, chair of the Housing Task Force, stated that healthy, affordable housing can reduce TB transmission and childhood stunting, noting crowded slums as key risk factors. He warned Indonesia ranks poorly in certain health metrics, with TB prevalence linked to dense settlements; free health checks have reached about 72 million people and helped identify TB cases. The initiative, supported by PT Kereta Api Indonesia's Bobby Rasyidin, seeks to repurpose land to create healthy neighbourhoods, aiming to lower TB and stunting and to boost human capital and educational outcomes across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 公営住宅計画による公衆衛生推進：インドネシアで結核とスタンティングを抑制
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する一般的な公衆衛生政策・予防イニシアティブの報道であり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、異常な死亡率上昇、急速な感染拡大、または緊急対応が必要な事象を報告していない。記事は既知の公衆衛生課題への対策を紹介するもの。
triage.notes: インドネシアの結核問題は既知の課題であり、記事は政府による予防・対策プログラムの進捗状況を報道したもの。新規アウトブレイクや異常な疾病クラスターではなく、通常の公衆衛生イニシアティブの発表。シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Barra Mansa realiza ação intensiva sobre a esporotricose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barra Mansa City Hall carries out an intensive campaign on sporotrichosis.
article.articleSummary: Barra Mansa's Health Department launched a week-long campaign on sporotrichosis at USF Vila Delgado in Ano Bom, starting 16 March 2026. Environmental Health Surveillance agents will be on site to educate residents, screen for suspected cases, and reinforce prevention, symptoms, and transmission after identifying animals positive for sporotrichosis in the area. Veterinary specialist Millena Borges notes the disease is caused by a fungus found in soil, plants, and organic matter; human infection occurs mainly via scratches, bites, or contact with secretions from infected animals, with cats as the principal transmitters. In humans, skin lesions may develop and progress; in animals, especially felines, lesions are common on the head, paws, and tail. A tent at Vila Delgado will facilitate access to information and evaluations; a physician will conduct consultations for suspected cases. Early diagnosis and treatment exist for humans and animals; community engagement is crucial to containment.

triage.headline_ja: バッラ・マンサ市が、スポロトリコーシスに関する集中的キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは既知の土壌真菌感染症であり、重篤度は低い。ただし動物との接触を介した地域的な発生との報告があり、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスはブラジルで周期的に発生する既知の感染症。今回の報告は動物（特に猫）からのヒト感染リスクに基づく公衆衛生キャンペーンであり、局所的対応が可能。死亡例や重症化の情報はなく、IHR基準に該当しない。ただしWPRO基準で「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、WATCHレベルでの経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por transmisión sostenida de fiebre amarilla en Sudamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of sustained transmission of yellow fever in South America.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever transmission remains sustained in parts of South America, per OPS epidemiological alert on 2026-03-16. Since Sept 2024, cases have occurred outside traditional Amazonia foci, with 2025 reporting 346 lab-confirmed cases and 143 deaths across seven countries in 2025, with a 41% case-fatality rate; 2026's first seven weeks tally 34 cases and 15 deaths in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru and Venezuela. The associated sylvatic cycle (mosquitoes and non-human primates) reactivates periodically, but human cases have appeared in areas near urban centers, raising concern for urban transmission via Aedes aegypti. Notable spread includes detection near São Paulo, Brazil, and Tolima, Colombia. Public health response emphasizes vaccination campaigns to achieve at least 95% coverage in exposed populations, strengthened surveillance (epidemiological and epizootic in primates), vector control, and rapid vaccine stockpiles. Travelers should be vaccinated at least 10 days before travel. The infection is preventable by vaccination; there is no specific cure.

triage.headline_ja: 南米における黄熱病の持続的な伝播に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国にわたる持続的な流行と都市伝播の懸念があるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2025年に346例の確定症例と143死亡（致命率41%）、2026年初週に34例と15死亡を報告。南米7ヶ国に拡大し、従来のアマゾン流行地以外での発生やサンパウロ近郊での検出、トリマ県での発生が記録されている。シルバティック サイクル（蚊と非ヒト霊長類）と都市伝播（ネッタイシマカ）の両方のリスクが存在する点が重要。OPS（汎米保健機関）による公式疫学警告が発表されている。

article.articleHeadline: Organizaciones urgen medidas ante el "inicio" de epidemia de fiebre amarilla en Venezuela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Organizations Urge Measures in Response to the Onset of a Yellow Fever Epidemic in Venezuela.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela confronts the onset of a yellow fever epidemic, with first cases reported in June 2025 and an eight-month delay before public notification. Twenty-four health-sector organizations, including Provea and the National Academy of Medicine, urged urgent government action, calling for publication of 2024–2026 epidemiological bulletins and stronger transparency and interagency coordination. Health Minister Nuramy Gutiérrez acknowledged deaths in 2025 but did not specify numbers, while confirming an epidemiological alert. By March 2026, seven confirmed yellow fever cases had been reported for 2026, and 36 cases were recorded from June 2025 through February 27, 2026. The vaccination drive targets 95% coverage; about 49,000 people were recently immunized, joining roughly 3 million vaccinated in the prior decade. Venezuela has received vaccine donations from India, South Korea, Russia, Brazil, and others to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラの黄熱病流行の始まりに対策を求める組織団体
triage.triage_reason: 2025年6月以降ベネズエラで黄熱病流行が報告され、8ヶ月の報告遅延、2026年3月までに43例が確認された。複数国での感染報告と複雑な対応状況から、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、フルRRAを実施すべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: ベネズエラにおける黄熱病流行は、2025年6月の初発症例から8ヶ月の報告遅延という重大な公衆衛生上の問題を示している。複数国（インド、韓国、ロシア、ブラジルなど）からのワクチン支援を受けており、国際的な関心と支援が既に動いている。24の健康セクター組織による透明性と調整の強化要求は、政府対応の不十分さを示唆している。黄熱病の国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスク、ベクター媒介による流行拡大の可能性が全て示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Pedro da Aldeia adota nova estratégia de proteção para bebês contra vírus respiratório
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Pedro da Aldeia Adopts New Protection Strategy for Babies Against Respiratory Virus
article.articleSummary: São Pedro da Aldeia, in Rio de Janeiro’s Região dos Lagos, Brazil, is adopting a new protection strategy under the Unified Health System (SUS) to shield infants against Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), the main cause of bronchiolitis and severe respiratory infections, using the monoclonal antibody nirsevimabe. The plan prioritizes the most vulnerable: newborns up to 36 weeks and six days gestation, and children under two with conditions that raise respiratory risk. Priority groups include congenital heart disease, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, severe immunodeficiencies, Down syndrome, cystic fibrosis, neuromuscular diseases, and airway abnormalities. The objective is to reduce severe bronchiolitis and related hospitalizations in young children. Parents are advised to visit the nearest health unit for guidance on eligibility and the timing of the medicine’s availability in the municipal network.

triage.headline_ja: サンペドロ・ダ・アルデイア、呼吸器ウイルスに対する乳幼児保護の新戦略を採用
triage.triage_reason: RSV感染症に対する既知の公衆衛生対応（モノクローナル抗体ニルセビマブの導入）であり、異常な発生報告ではない。社会的・政治的関心も限定的で、シグナル基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のRSV感染症に対する予防プログラムの地方自治体レベルでの実施発表であり、新規の感染症危機ではなく、確立された公衆衛生対策の運用開始である。侵襲的感染のリスク報告や異常な流行の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: South African farmers reeling from foot-and-mouth disaster
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in South Africa, declared a national disaster in February, has generated nearly 1,000 outbreaks across all nine provinces, with the Eastern Cape hub near Humansdorp hardest hit. The virus has also appeared in Botswana, Eswatini and Zimbabwe in recent months. A 100-km quarantine area surrounds affected farms; meat sales and slaughter are prohibited as controls tighten. Symptoms include fever and blisters on hooves and in the mouth, leading to feeding difficulties; the virus can spread by wind and remain viable in cow dung for up to six months. South Africa received 2.5 million imported vaccine doses in late February—the first use of a vaccine in the country—part of a 10-year plan to inoculate nearly 20 million cattle, criticized as too late. In a Humansdorp cooperative of 245 cattle, 128 fell ill and 14 died, with losses about 180,000 rand and annual income ~540,000 rand. Beef exports have been banned in Zambia and China.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカの農民が口蹄疫の大惨事に直面
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であるが、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク（複数国への既出現）と経済的影響に該当。WPRO基準で異常性、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性が複数該当し、農業産業への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾病だがIHR対象外と考える見方もあるが、畜産業への甚大な経済的影響、複数国への国際的拡大（ボツワナ、エスワティーニ、ジンバブエ、中国での牛肉輸入禁止）、南アフリカでの国家的災害宣言、食糧安全保障への潜在的脅威により、シグナルとして識別。従来の感染症トリアージ機能に含まれないが、CEPRのEBS活動スコープでは動物疾病の大規模発生も監視対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox em Santa Catarina: número de casos suspeitos chega a 16
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in Santa Catarina: Number of Suspected Cases Reaches 16.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of March 16, 2026: 16 suspected cases are under investigation by DIVE, with no locally acquired infections confirmed. The sole positive mpox diagnosis in the state involves a patient from another state, not counted as local. Two cases are classified as probable, due to inconclusive or inadequate samples with no re-collection but epidemiological links. In late February, six suspected cases were reported in Greater Florianópolis (Biguaçu, Florianópolis, Palhoça, Santo Amaro da Imperatriz). The scenario remains controlled; since July 2022, SC has 3,307 mpox notifications: 599 confirmed, 2,626 discarded, 61 probable, six lost to follow-up, 15 still suspected, and one death in 2022. Nationally, 149 suspected/confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 93 confirmed in São Paulo and over 570 suspected nationwide. Transmission via skin lesions, bodily fluids, contaminated materials; incubation 6–13 days (up to 21). Symptoms: vesicular lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy. Seek care and report contact history.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のMpox：疑い例数が16件に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンタカタリーナ州でMpox疑い例が増加中だが、地元感染の確認例がなく、状況は管理下にある。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade IおよびClade IIが関連しており、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性がある。ただし、サンタカタリーナ州では地元感染の確認例がなく、ブラジル国内の他州での輸入例が大部分。2月下旬以降の疑い例増加と確率例（2件）の発生は注視対象。全国で2026年には149件の疑い例/確定例があり、国家レベルでの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Piraúba promove mutirão de limpeza para combater o Aedes aegypti e prevenir doenças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piraúba promotes a cleanup drive to combat Aedes aegypti and prevent diseases.
article.articleSummary: On March 16, 2026, the city of Piraúba launches Mutirão de Limpeza to curb Aedes aegypti, vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The four-day neighborhood focus runs March 16–20: Piraubinha (Mon 16), Santa Terezinha (Tue 17), São Sebastião (Thu 19), Granja Aurimar (Fri 20). Health agents with volunteers and residents will inspect and remove items that collect standing water—bottles, cans, tires, buckets—and provide guidance. Residents are urged to remove or empty containers and keep yards, sidewalks, and common areas clean. The campaign also distributes informational materials and hosts brief preventive talks to broaden community knowledge. It emphasizes social integration and evidence from prior campaigns that combined cleanup and education reduce dengue and other arboviruses. It aligns with the Ministry of Health and the National Program to Control Aedes aegypti, which call for active community participation; residents should report suspected foci to Vigilância Epidemiológica for intervention outside scheduled days.

triage.headline_ja: ピラウーバ市、ネッタイシマカ対策と疾病予防のための一斉清掃運動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的な衛生キャンペーン活動の報道であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事象の報告ではない。既知のアルボウイルス（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）に対する定期的な蚊媒介感染症対策として、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのピラウーバ市による定期的なAedes aegypti蚊対策キャンペーン（2026年3月16-20日）の報道。感染症の発生報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の予防活動の一環。感染症イベント監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará confirma dois casos de mpox em 2026; veja sintomas, transmissão e formas de tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará confirms two mpox cases in 2026; see symptoms, transmission, and forms of treatment.
article.articleSummary: Two mpox cases confirmed in Ceará, Brazil in 2026; the first case, a man, was confirmed on March 9 with favorable outcome. IntegrSUS records 27 notifications in 2026, with 17 discarded and 8 under investigation. Nationally, 140 mpox cases have been confirmed in 2026, with 539 suspected notifications across states. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus (MPXV), a zoonotic Orthopoxvirus. Transmission occurs via contact with infected people, contaminated materials, or wildlife, principally rodents. Diagnosis relies on laboratory tests (molecular assays or genetic sequencing) from lesion secretions or crusts. Treatment is symptomatic; most cases are mild to moderate and need no hospitalization. Home care emphasizes pain and fever relief, skin care, hydration, and isolation until lesions heal. Prevention includes avoiding direct contact with cases, hand hygiene, and mask use in risk situations. Vaccination priority targets people living with HIV/AIDS, laboratory workers, and those exposed to fluids or secretions.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州が2026年のmpox2例を確認；症状、感染、治療法を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのmpox確認例は既知の感染症パターンであるが、全国140例という件数増加とHIVとの関連性の記載、ならびに不完全な情報があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文が提供されていないため詳細な重症度評価が困難。ブラジル全国で140例の確認、527例の疑い例という一定規模の流行状況が存在。HIV患者への優先予防接種が明記されており、HIV患者への特異的影響が想定される。国内では公式な通知・追跡システム(IntegrSUS)が機能していることが確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Establishment of a rapid Brucella detection method based on MCDA-CRISPR dual signal amplification system for reducing transfusion-transmitted diseases - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis, a zoonotic disease caused by Brucella, is addressed by a novel MCDA-CRISPR dual signal amplification platform integrating MCDA with a CRISPR-Cas12a biosensing system. Applied to voluntary blood donors in Xinjiang, China, the assay operates isothermally at 64 °C with a simple water bath, completes in 60 minutes, and yields a visual UV-readout without complex interpretation. It achieves a detection limit of 1 fg/μL Brucella DNA, 100-fold more sensitive than conventional PCR, and shows 100% specificity with no cross-reactivity to non-Brucella pathogens. In donor samples, the assay demonstrates sensitivity and specificity equivalent to culture. This rapid, visual, and highly specific Brucella test is suitable for routine blood donor screening in high-prevalence areas like Xinjiang and holds promise for resource-limited settings to reduce transfusion-transmitted brucellosis.

triage.headline_ja: MCDA-CRISPR双信号増幅システムに基づくブルセラ迅速検出法の確立：輸血感染症削減に向けて - Scientific Reports
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症は人畜共通感染症であり、中国新疆地域での血液ドナー検査への応用が報告されている。ただし、本記事は新規な検査法開発に関する科学論文であり、現在のアウトブレイク情報ではなく、具体的な患者発生数・流行状況の情報が不足しているため、情報確認まで経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規検査法開発に関する科学論文（Nature Scientific Reports）であり、現在の疾病発生状況を報告するものではない。中国新疆地域はブルセラ症の高流行地域として知られており、人畜共通感染症としての感染リスク、輸血感染の可能性がある。ただし、現在のアウトブレイク状況、患者数、死亡例などの具体的な流行情報が記事に含まれていないため、フルRRAには至らない。新疆地域でのブルセラ症発生状況に関する続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: High prevalence of bancroftian filariasis and comorbidities in the eastern coalfield regions of West Bengal, India following COVID-19 disruption - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: In four LF-endemic eastern coalfield districts of West Bengal, India, a community-based cross-sectional survey (Aug 2021–Mar 2024) screened 3,705 individuals. Overall lymphatic filariasis (LF) prevalence was 16.65% (n=617). Asymptomatic mf+ICT-positive cases were 10.63% (n=394); symptomatic LF 6.02% (n=223). Among symptomatic cases, 144 had circulating microfilariae with ICT positivity and lymphedema, mainly Grade II (34.79%) and Grade III (43.48%). Chronic mf-negative lymphedema accounted for 2.13% (n=79). Active LF prevalence (mf and ICT positive) was 14.52% (n=538). Acute dermato-lymphangio-adenitis (ADLA) ranged 8.71–39.79% across clinical categories. LF prevalence was higher in rural areas; hypertension, diabetes, and fungal infections were common comorbidities. The region shows heightened severe chronic lymphedema and a marginal rise in new LF likely linked to COVID-19–related interruption of mass drug administration and morbidity management.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19による中断後のインド西ベンガル州東部炭田地域におけるバンクロフト糸状虫症の高い有病率と合併症 - Scientific Reports
triage.triage_reason: リンパ系フィラリア症は既知の風土病であり、COVID-19関連の保健プログラム中断との関連が指摘されているが、新規感染の急速な拡大や国際的な懸念の直接的証拠が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: リンパ系フィラリア症はWest Bengalの既知の風土病であり、本調査は2021年8月から2024年3月の横断的研究。高い有病率（16.65%）と重度のリンパ浮腫が報告されており、COVID-19関連の質量医療投与プログラム中断との関連が示唆されている。しかし新規感染の急速な国際的拡大やWHO SARS-CoV-2緊急終了後の急性的な脅威の直接的証拠は記事から見出せない。社会的・政治的関心度が不明なため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: First case of virus that sparked 2022 outbreak confirmed in New York
article.articleSummary: New York City confirms the first local case of the severe mpox Clade I strain in the United States since November 2024, in a traveler recently returned from Europe who is now isolated; officials report no evidence of community transmission and the public risk remains low. The case is the 12th Clade I mpox in the US. Europe has reported locally acquired Clade Ib mpox in Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Portugal; NYC subclade is not yet identified. Clade I, endemic to the Congo Basin, carries higher mortality (NIH: 1.4% to >10%). Incubation is 5–21 days; symptoms include fever, severe headache, myalgias, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, followed by a characteristic rash. NYC also records 398 Clade II mpox cases in 2025 and 45 mpox cases from Jan 1–Mar 10, 2026 (16 in the past month). Vaccination with JYNNEOS (two doses, 28 days apart) reduces risk and severity; vaccination advised for at‑risk groups and travelers to affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 2022年の流行を引き起こしたウイルスの最初のケースがニューヨークで確認
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade I（高致死率1.4～10%）がNYCで初めて確認され、米国内での12番目のClade I症例。欧州での多国家での局所伝播（スペイン、オランダ、イタリア、ポルトガル）と複数地域での流行により、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Clade I mpoxは高致死率（1.4～10%）であり重症化リスクが高い。欧州での多国間流行（Spain, Netherlands, Italy, Portugal）と米国での確認により、国際的な伝播リスクが顕著。患者は隔離中で現時点での社会感染証拠はないが、継続監視が必要。ワクチン対策（JYNNEOS）が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos suspeitos de leptospirose em Ubá chega a 92
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected leptospirosis cases in Ubá reaches 92.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in Minas Gerais, Brazil. As of 16 March 2026, Ubá in Zona da Mata reports 92 suspected leptospirosis cases, with 1 confirmed case and 1 death—a 33-year-old woman whose death was reported on 10 March. Across the Zona da Mata, 117 leptospirosis cases (investigated and confirmed) had been recorded up to 13 March, linked to heavy rains. In Juiz de Fora, 3 cases are confirmed and 1 remains under investigation; no deaths. In Matias Barbosa, 20 suspected cases await confirmation, with no deaths. The Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Minas Gerais (SES-MG) notes continuous monitoring, epidemiological investigations, and laboratory analyses via Sinan data. Citizens with fever, body pains, headache, nausea, or malaise are advised to seek immediate medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: ウベ（ウーバ）におけるレプトスピラ症の疑い例が92例に達した
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州のウベ市でレプトスピラ症の集団発生が報告されており、確認例1例、死亡1例を含む92例の疑い例が発生。複数地域に拡大（Zona da Mata全域で117例）し、国内で公衆衛生的な懸念となっているため、シグナルトリアージの対象となる。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は豪雨に関連する環境的危険要因（水浸水）により、引き続き曝露リスクが存在する。ブラジル保健当局（SES-MG）による能動的な疫学調査・検査が実施中。2026年3月という最新報告日付であり、発生は現在進行中と考えられる。WPRO地域外（南米）のため、WPROスクリーニング基準は参考値だが、IHR基準の2つ以上該当とスクリーニング基準複数該当により、フルRRA進行が正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: Depois de caso positivo em São Paulo, Saúde do Paraná reforça alerta contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a positive case in São Paulo, Paraná's Health Department reinforces its alert against measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles alert reinforced in Paraná after Brazil's first imported case in 2026, a six-month-old with recent travel to Bolivia, detected in São Paulo. Despite Brazil's 2024 PAHO recertification as measles-free, the Americas saw 1,031 confirmed cases in early 2026, about 45 times higher than the same period last year. Paraná's Health Department urges sustained vaccination coverage, noting the state has one of the highest triple-viral vaccination rates: in 2025, 1-year-olds first dose 96.91%, second dose 89.72%. Vaccination is free at all Basic Health Units; routine schedule is first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months. For ages 1–29, two doses; ages 30–59, one dose; health workers two doses. Travelers should verify vaccination at least 30 days before travel; pregnancy is a vaccination contraindication, and women of childbearing age should avoid pregnancy for at least one month post-vaccination. Vigilance for fever, rash, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and prompt reporting remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでの陽性例確認後、パラナ州保健省は麻疹に対するアラートを強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルが2024年にPAHOから麻疹排除認定を受けた直後の2026年初の輸入例であり、異常・予想外であることに加え、ボリビアから入国した事例が確認され、国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年にPAHOから麻疹排除認定を得たばかりであり、今回のボリビアからの輸入例は重大な逆転を示す。アメリカ大陸全域で2026年初期に1,031例の確認事例があり、前年同期比約45倍という急増状況。パラナ州は高いワクチン接種率（2025年：1歳児第1回96.91%、第2回89.72%）を維持しているが、警戒継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Carlos confirma 180 casos de dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Carlos confirms 180 dengue cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, São Carlos Epidemiological Surveillance reports 180 confirmed dengue cases in 2026, with 5 additional cases awaiting laboratory results and 48 suspected cases discarded this week; no dengue-related deaths have been recorded. Among other arboviruses, 51 chikungunya notifications were investigated and all were ruled out after testing, while 50 Zika virus notifications were likewise discarded; there were no yellow fever notifications. The surveillance effort continues to monitor arboviral activity and stresses prevention, particularly eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites, to curb transmission in the municipality. These figures reflect current year-to-date data; the report underscores ongoing preventive measures and community involvement to eliminate standing water and Aedes aegypti breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロス市、2026年にデング熱180例を確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域的な確認事例であるが、死亡者なし、他のアルボウイルスは否定され、監視体制が機能している。情報は限定的だが、アウトブレイク規模の詳細が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクの評価が困難。
triage.notes: ブラジルは定期的なデング熱の流行地域。180例は地方自治体レベルでは懸念される規模だが、死亡者がなく、公衆衛生当局が積極的に監視・対応している。他のアルボウイルス（Zika、Chikungunya、Yellow Fever）は除外または報告なし。記事は2026年という将来日付を含むため、情報の信頼性確認が必要。アウトブレイクの拡大速度や死亡率、感染経路の詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCHとして経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Persistent back pain could be sign of tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: 25-year-old Gurgaon-based man, Giri, presented with persistent left shoulder pain and reduced movement. Initial misdiagnosis as frozen shoulder gave way to MRI showing destruction of the upper humerus with fluid buildup; lab tests confirmed tuberculosis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. He received anti-tubercular therapy for over nine months, with follow-up scans showing bone healing and meaningful improvement in arm function within six to eight weeks. Bone tuberculosis is a form of TB, less common than pulmonary or lymph node TB but fairly frequent in India, and often misdiagnosed due to atypical symptoms. TB bacteria reach bones or joints via the bloodstream from the lungs or another infected site, causing osteomyelitis and, if spread, septic arthritis. Early detection and treatment are highly curable.

triage.headline_ja: Persistent back pain could be sign of tuberculosis（持続的な背中痛は結核の兆候である可能性がある）
triage.triage_reason: 単一の臨床症例報告であり、新規感染症クラスター、流行の兆候、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆する証拠がない。結核は周知の疾患であり、診断・治療が確立されている。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別症例（Gurgaon地域の25歳男性）の医学的教育記事であり、感染症シグナルではない。骨結核の臨床的特徴と診断・治療の重要性を述べた啓発記事と判断される。結核自体は既知疾患であり、異常な流行やクラスター、新規検出事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Com 150 doentes, poder público tenta conter avanço do Aedes em áreas indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 150 patients, public authorities try to contain the spread of Aedes in indigenous areas.
article.articleSummary: 150 confirmed Aedes aegypti–related cases with three deaths in Indigenous reserves Jaguapiru and Bororó, Dourados and Itaporã, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, indicating active arbovirus transmission within villages. In 2026, chikungunya incidence is higher than 2025. The state government mobilized to confront arboviruses in the region, with 21,355 Indigenous people served by four primary health units and six teams. A March 9–11 mutirão mobilized ~100 professionals who inspected 2,355 properties, identified 589 mosquito breeding sites (90% in water tanks, garbage, and tires), treated 1,156 properties, and sprayed 43 properties with backpack sprayers; two LECO-based insecticide deployments were used. 77 endemic agents and 20 Indigenous health workers participated. Actions included larviciding, insecticiding, and ovitrapping, guided by SES, the Ministry of Health, Sesai, DSEI, and local leaders to eliminate Aedes breeding sites and curb arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: 150人の患者数でAedesの先住民地域での拡大を抑制しようとする公共当局
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの先住民保護区におけるChikungunya確定症例150件、死亡3件を報告。2026年の発生率が2025年より高く、IHR基準2項目該当（異常/予想外な増加、重症度）およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 先住民地域での集団発生であり、保健体系の脆弱性、Aedes媒介性アルボウイルス（Chikungunya、Dengue、Zika）の同時流行リスク、および公式な政府対応が展開中。2026年の発生率上昇は疫学的に重要。国際的拡大リスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de leptospirose chegam a 92 em Ubá após chuvas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected leptospirosis cases reach 92 in Ubá after rains.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, Ubá in Zona da Mata, Minas Gerais, reports 92 suspected leptospirosis cases, with 1 confirmed case and 1 death (a 33-year-old woman). In the region, Sinan records 117 total cases (suspected and confirmed). Juiz de Fora has 3 confirmed cases and 1 under investigation, no deaths; Matias Barbosa reports 20 suspected cases, no deaths. Transmission stems from contact with water or mud contaminated by urine from infected animals, especially rats; flooding elevates exposure risk. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, malaise, myalgias, red eyes. Prompt antibiotic treatment is crucial. Prevention priorities: PPE during cleanup, disinfection with about 200 mL bleach in 10 L water, and discarding foods touched by floodwater. Symptoms appearing 7–30 days after exposure should prompt medical care; severe cases require emergency care.

triage.headline_ja: 雨水後、ウバでレプトスピラ症の疑い例が92件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、重症度、国際拡大リスク）。レプトスピラ症の集団発生で1死亡が確認され、洪水による環境汚染という明確な拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 複数の自治体（ウバ、ジュイス・デ・フォーラ、マチアス・バルボーザ）にまたがる地域的クラスターの報告。洪水による環境汚染が継続的な曝露リスクを示唆。地域内の基礎衛生情報は不明だが、限定的資源での管理可能性評価は不確定。

article.articleHeadline: Recife inicia nesta terça-feira (17) imunização de vacina do Butantan contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recife begins dengue vaccination with the Butantan vaccine on Tuesday (the 17th).
article.articleSummary: Recife, Brazil begins dengue vaccination with the Butantan-DV in a one-dose regimen. With 3,682 doses available on March 17, 2026, 40% of the estimated eligible population at this stage will be covered, targeting primary healthcare workers in SUS, including community health agents, nurses, doctors, and other registered staff. Butantan-DV, approved by Anvisa in early December, is for ages 12–59 and uses a live attenuated virus technology akin to those used in yellow fever, oral polio, and the MMR vaccines. It showed an overall efficacy of 74.7% against symptomatic dengue and 89% protection against severe disease and cases with warning signs in the target age group. Vaccinated individuals tend to have lower viral load. Previously Recife used a two-dose dengue regimen for ages 10–14, with 42,724 first doses and 18,299 second doses administered.

triage.headline_ja: レシフェ、17日火曜日にブタンタンワクチンによるデング熱予防接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: これは予防接種キャンペーンの開始報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや疾病発生の報告ではない。記事は疾患制御の進展を示しており、公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく対応活動を報告している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月17日のデング熱ワクチン接種開始を報告しているが、これは計画的な公衆衛生対応であり危機管理の対象外。Bluedot APIが疾患名としてYellow Fever、Dengue、Polioを抽出しているが、記事の実質はワクチン導入のニュースであり新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Un análisis de mapas filtrados del mercado de Huanan revela detalles inéditos del origen de la COVID-19 y apunta a animales infectados y 17 vendedores con anticuerpos contra el SARS-CoV-2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An analysis of leaked maps of the Huanan Market reveals unpublished details about the origin of COVID-19 and points to infected animals and 17 vendors with antibodies against SARS-CoV-2.
article.articleSummary: Analysis of leaked WeChat maps from Wuhan's Huanan Market, conducted by CNRS evolutionary biologist Florence Débarre, reopens questions about the late-2019 origin of SARS-CoV-2. The maps pinpoint market stalls, environmental positives for the virus, and, notably, 17 vendors with antibodies against SARS-CoV-2, implying past worker infections. A stall labeled 6-29 reportedly yielded 18 animal samples positive for SARS-CoV-2; later 2023 genomics work detected a mix of coronavirus RNA with DNA from animals such as raccoon dogs, civets, and dogs at the market. While this does not prove transmission direction, the findings align with the presence of infected animals and support a zoonotic origin hypothesis, though human-to-environment-to-animal routes remain plausible. The maps circulated in 2021 amid a discredited frozen-seafood theory (Maine lobsters) about introduction, raising questions about access to non-public information and keeping the origin debate unresolved.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢市華南市場の流出地図の分析により、COVID-19の起源に関する前代未聞の詳細が明かされ、感染した動物と17人のSARS-CoV-2抗体陽性の販売業者が指摘されている
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の起源に関する追加的な疫学的証拠の報告であり、学術的・政治的な関心は高いが、新規患者発生や流行拡大を示唆する情報がなく、現在の公衆衛生に対する直接的な重大な影響は不明である。続報と学術的検証の経過を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは過去のCOVID-19起源に関する歴史的な疫学調査の報告であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。2019年後期の事象に関する新たな分析結果（流出地図、動物サンプル、販売業者の抗体検査など）を報告するもの。公衆衛生上の現在の脅威ではなく、学術・政治的な関心事項である。

article.articleHeadline: Área de luxo cheia de ratos: homem contrai leptospirose ao correr na Praia Brava, em Itajaí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Luxury area teeming with rats: man contracts leptospirosis while running on Brava Beach in Itajaí.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk linked to urban rodent activity in Itajaí, Brazil, with sightings at Praia Brava and around the Hospital Marieta Konder Bornhausen, Beira-Rio, and near Casa da Cultura. A resident reports contracting leptospirosis after running barefoot on the sand at Praia Brava, describing 15 days of illness and a five-day hospital stay with a platelet transfusion. Municipal health data record a death from leptospirosis in Itajaí. Rats are reported accessing litter bins along the seafront, roaming the sand and entering bins overnight, raising risk to beachgoers, including children. Vigilância Sanitária will intensify inspections and contract an urban pest-control company; actions to desratize public spaces and areas around the hospital are planned. Authorities continue monitoring the situation amid calls for public health measures to curb urban rat infestations.

triage.headline_ja: 豪華地域でネズミが殺到：イタジャイのプライア・ブラバでランニング中にレプトスピラ症に感染した男性
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の確認症例（死亡例を含む）、人獣共通感染症、都市部でのネズミ媒介感染リスク、公衆衛生への著しい影響が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ブラジル・イタジャイでのレプトスピラ症事例報告。確認死亡例あり、複数の患者が報告されており、都市部での継続的なネズミ媒介感染リスクが存在。市当局はすでに対応を開始しているが、ビーチ利用者を含む市民へのリスク継続。地域的な疾患流行の可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais registra mais de 8 mil casos confirmados de dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records more than 8,000 confirmed dengue cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, as of 16 March 2026, reports 8,144 confirmed dengue cases and 26,471 probable dengue cases, with 14 dengue deaths under investigation and six confirmed. Chikungunya accounts for 2,306 confirmed cases and 4,048 probable cases, with one death confirmed. Zika shows 3 confirmed cases and 19 probable cases, with no deaths. Dengue symptoms include high fever, headache (behind the eyes), nausea, malaise, joint pain, and red body rash. Chikungunya presents with fever, intense joint and muscle pain, headache, rash, eye pain, back pain, non-purulent conjunctivitis, nausea/vomiting, abdominal pain (more common in children), throat pain, chills, and potential edema in affected joints. Data come from the Minas Gerais State Health Secretariat (SEE-MG) surveillance; no infection source or import/export details are provided in this brief.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、2026年にデング熱確定患者8,000例以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州において3つのアルボウイルス感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時多発が報告されており、デング熱は8,144例の確定患者と死亡例6件確認、チクングニアは2,306例確定患者が報告されている。IHR基準の複数項目該当が認められ、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: デング熱、チクングニア、ジカの3種アルボウイルスが同時に発生している複合型流行の状況。ブラジルにおけるデング熱は風土病的ではあるが、報告数が多く死亡例確認されている。記事にはインポート/エクスポート情報や流行拡大のリスク評価が記載されていないため、詳細なRRA実施が推奨される。ベクター関連の記載あり（蚊媒介感染症）。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis outbreak in Natuashish presents low community spread risk, NLHS says | CBC News
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis outbreak declared in Natuashish, Labrador, NL Health Services and the Mushuau Innu First Nation say the risk of broader community transmission remains low. As of 2026-03-16, authorities monitor an increase in active TB cases over recent weeks; the exact number of residents affected is not disclosed due to privacy. TB is airborne and commonly causes persistent cough, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. The Friday outbreak in Natuashish is the second TB outbreak in Labrador since fall; the November northern Labrador outbreak remains active but is not connected to this one. Testing and contact tracing are ongoing; contacts should follow health advice and return for follow-up testing. Precautions include handwashing, staying home if sick, and not sharing smoking devices.

triage.headline_ja: ナトゥアシッシュのツベルクリン菌感染症アウトブレイクは低い地域拡大リスクを提示、NLHS発表 | CBC News
triage.triage_reason: 結核の多地域同時発生事例であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当の可能性があるが、当局が地域拡大リスク「低い」と明示しており、詳細な症例数や重症度情報が不足しているため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: フィリピンのイロコス地域とカナダのナトゥアシッシュ・ラブラドール地域で同時に結核アウトブレイクが報告されている。カナダ側は秋以降2番目の発生で、前回の北部ラブラドール事例との関連性は否定されている。詳細な症例数・重症度情報が非公開のため、PICKUP判定に必要な詳細情報が不足。当局が地域拡大リスク低を明示しているが、2地域での同時報告であり、継続的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: VOCÊ SABIA? Ovos do Aedes aegypti podem sobreviver até 1 ano sem contato com a água - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did you know? Aedes aegypti eggs can survive for up to a year without coming into contact with water - Perfil News.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, Aedes aegypti eggs can survive up to a year without contact with water, keeping dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission possible even during dry periods. Eggs are laid on the walls of water-holding containers such as plant pots, buckets, bottles, tires, and water tanks. When water returns, eggs hatch into larvae quickly, and the complete egg-to-adult cycle can take about 7–10 days under favorable conditions. Dry seasons increase home water storage in unsealed containers, creating ideal breeding sites. Larvae develop only in standing water; eliminating any container that can collect water is the most effective way to interrupt the mosquito life cycle. Health authorities urge weekly yard inspections, keeping water tanks sealed, proper disposal of nonessential items, and preventing water accumulation. Prevention remains essential even during drought periods.

triage.headline_ja: ご存知ですか？ネッタイシマカの卵は水と接触しなくても1年間生き残ることができます - Perfil News
triage.triage_reason: ネッタイシマカの生態に関する科学情報記事であり、現在の具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告がない。記事は予防啓発・教育目的のため、IHR基準に該当する進行中の公衆衛生上の危機ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はZika・Chikungunya・Denguの3疾患に関連する媒介蚊(Aedes aegypti)の生態学的情報を提供する予防啓発記事。具体的なアウトブレイク事例や死亡・入院数の報告がなく、現在進行形の感染症クライシスではない。ブラジルにおける乾季の水貯蔵に関連した蚊媒介疾患の増殖リスクは継続的な脅威として存在するため、関連情報の続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 16 Kasus Campak Ditemukan, Dinkes Madiun: Belum Ada yang Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 16 Measles Cases Detected, Madiun Health Department: No Positive Cases Yet.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Madiun Regency, East Java: 16 suspected pediatric cases reported January–mid March 2026, but no confirmed measles cases yet. The Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Madiun (Dinkes) says reports began at multiple facilities; clusters include Saradan and Geger with 3 cases each, others spread across 13 districts. Blood samples from suspects sent to Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Surabaya for confirmation; results pending. Health authorities alerted 26 Puskesmas and three hospitals (RSUD Caruban, RSUD Dolopo, RS Paru Dungus) to report and trace quickly. A catch-up immunization campaign is planned for 30 March–12 April 2026, per the Ministry of Health, with measles vaccines at 9 months, 18 months, and 5–7 years boosters. Emphasis on droplet precautions, exclusive breastfeeding for 6–12 months, hygiene, and limiting infant contact ahead of Lebaran (Eid al-Fitr).

triage.headline_ja: 16件の麻しん疑い例を検出、マディウン保健局：陽性例はまだなし
triage.triage_reason: 麻しん疑い例16件が報告されているが、確定例がなく検査結果待機中。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 確定例がなく、血液検査結果が保留中である点が重要。麻しんは高い感染性を持つため、確定例が報告された場合は即座にPICKUPへ引き上げるべき。イードアルフィトル（Lebaran）時期の人口移動増加による流行リスクが懸念される。小児科症例のみの報告で、18歳以上の患者情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Common waterborne bacterium may fuel resistance to last-resort antibiotics
article.articleSummary: Aeromonas, a waterborne bacterium found across South Asian rivers, ponds, and wastewater systems, carries widespread antimicrobial resistance (AMR) genes, including those to last-resort drugs such as carbapenems and colistin. In a large genomic study, researchers analyzed 1,853 genomes, including 996 newly sequenced isolates from India and Bangladesh, producing one of the most comprehensive population snapshots of Aeromonas to date. They identified 162 AMR genes, with environmental strains showing little genomic distinction from those causing human infections, suggesting environmental reservoirs readily spill over to people. Aquatic reservoirs linked to aquaculture—farmed fish like trout and catfish—may play a key role in transmission. A diagnostic blind spot was found in northern India, where about 67% of colonies on cholera-selective media were Aeromonas, potentially distorting cholera surveillance. Integrating environmental genomics into disease surveillance could track resistance gene movement between aquatic ecosystems and humans.

triage.headline_ja: 一般的な水媒介菌が最後の砦抗生物質への耐性を助長する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: コレラと関連する水媒介菌（Aeromonas）による多剤耐性化が南アジア地域で確認され、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。環境から人への伝播メカニズムが特定されており、サーベイランスの盲点も指摘されている。
triage.notes: Nature誌に掲載された大規模ゲノム解析（1,853株、インド・バングラデシュから996株の新規配列）による信頼性の高い科学的証拠。カルバペネム・コリスチンなどの最後の砦抗生物質への耐性遺伝子が環境菌と臨床菌で区別されず、養殖場との関連性も示唆。北インドでのコレラサーベイランスの診断上の盲点（67%がAeromonas）は検出感度の問題として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Hashim: Pembangunan 3 juta rumah untuk tekan stunting dan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hashim: Building 3 million houses to curb stunting and TB.
article.articleSummary: Hashim Djojohadikusumo, chair of the Housing Task Force and Presidential Special Envoy, says Indonesia's plan to build 3 million homes aims to curb stunting and tuberculosis by improving unhealthy living environments. Speaking at the Manggarai rail station site on land belonging to PT Kereta Api Indonesia, he linked crowded, poorly sanitized, and inadequately ventilated settlements to stunting in children and to high TB prevalence. He noted Indonesia is among the countries with the highest TB burden globally, second only to India, a disease mainly affecting the lungs and driven by housing conditions. No current case or death counts for stunting or TB were provided. The initiative positions housing quality improvement as a preventive public-health measure aligned with national programs.

triage.headline_ja: ハシム：スタント化と結核を抑制するための300万戸の住宅建設
triage.triage_reason: 結核の公衆衛生対策に関する政策発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。具体的な患者数、死亡数、異常な発症増加の報告がなく、予防的政策イニシアティブの発表に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアの結核対策としての住宅改善政策に関する官僚的発表であり、新規のアウトブレイク情報ではない。記事内に現在の患者数や死亡数などの具体的な疾患統計が記載されていない。結核は既知の風土病であり、インドに次いで世界的な患者負担があることは既知事実である。シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma primeiro caso de chikungunya e dengue segue em alta - O Diário Interativo Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms first chikungunya case and dengue remains high - The Interactive Online Diary.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, Brazil confirms first chikungunya case in 2026: 1 confirmed; 34 notifications; 19 negative; 14 under investigation. Dengue continues to rise with 45 confirmed as of 16 March 2026 (up from 35 on 13 March); total dengue notifications this year: 574, with 476 negative and 53 pending; no deaths. Chikungunya symptoms include sudden high fever, severe joint pain in hands and feet, plus headache, muscle pain, and red rash 2–10 days post-bite. Public health actions include house-to-house vector-control visits on 17 March in Nova Barretos, Christiano Carvalho, and Santa Cecília; backpack fogging in São Francisco; vehicle fogging in Zequinha Amêndola (phase 1) and Fortaleza. Highlights ongoing dengue transmission and local vector-control efforts to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が初のチクングニア熱患者を確認、デング熱は引き続き増加傾向 - オンライン・インタラクティブ・ダイアリー
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の初確認症例と急速に拡大するデング熱の同時発生。複数州での二重感染リスク、ベクトル媒介感染の継続的曝露、国内複数地域への地理的拡大が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱の初症例確認とデング熱の急速増加（13日時点35件→16日時点45件）が同時に報告されており、ベクトル制御対策（家戸訪問、燻蒸処理）が既に実施中。複数州（ミナスジェライス、サンパウロ、サンタカタリーナ、セアラ）への地理的拡大リスク。2026年時点の報告となっており、信憑性の検証が必要だが、二重感染シナリオの疫学的重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta em São Carlos: ação busca identificar pessoas com sintomas de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in São Carlos: initiative aims to identify people with tuberculosis symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Active tuberculosis (TB) case-finding campaign in São Carlos, Brazil, runs March 17–31, 2026, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat through the Chronic Infections Care Center (CAIC). Timed to World TB Day on March 24, the effort seeks early identification of TB cases to start treatment promptly and interrupt transmission. Symptoms prompting screening include persistent cough for two to three weeks or longer, plus nighttime fever, fatigue, and weight loss. Diagnosis relies on sputum smear microscopy after respiratory symptoms prompt care. When properly treated, TB cure rates are about 95%. In 2023, São Carlos reported 55 new TB cases; 64 in 2024; 66 in 2025; currently 45 patients are under CAIC follow-up. BCG vaccination is free via SUS at birth or up to age 4 years 11 months 29 days to prevent severe TB. CAIC is at Rua José de Alencar 36, Tijuco Preto; contact numbers (16) 3419-8240/8250.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロスの警報：結核症状の患者を特定するための活動
