triage.triage_reason: 結核症例数の段階的な増加（2023年55例→2024年64例→2025年66例）が観察され、公衆衛生の継続的な懸念がある。ただし、適切な管理体制下の個別地域での症例発見キャンペーンであり、国際的な急速な拡大リスクについては情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、記事は組織的な症例発見キャンペーンと適切な治療体制の存在を示している。症例数の増加傾向（3年で20%増加）には注視が必要。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクについては明示的な情報がないため不明と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Kembali Merebak, Batuk, Pilek, Ruam Bisa Jadi Gejala Awal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Resurges Again; Cough, Runny Nose, and Rash Could Be Early Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Measles resurges in Surabaya, Indonesia, with early symptoms of cough, runny nose, and a red rash typically behind the neck, and high fever. Prof. Irwanto Sp.A(K) from Universitas Airlangga stresses early recognition to isolate infected individuals, as transmission occurs via droplets and direct contact, with public spaces posing high risk. The disease remains highly contagious and carries a risk of death, particularly for children and those with weakened immunity. The Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccine coverage is emphasized; parents are urged to vaccinate children at health facilities to prevent outbreaks and protect vulnerable groups. Health authorities are advancing community education on measles danger and vaccination as an effective preventive measure. The article underscores that timely isolation and vaccination are crucial to curb transmission and protect against potential outbreaks as of 16 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再び蔓延、咳、鼻水、発疹が初期症状となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の同時発生がインドネシア・スラバヤで報告されており、高い伝播性、死亡リスク、ワクチン接種率の問題を指摘する専門家の警告から、IHR基準（異常性・国内広がりリスク）およびWPRO基準（重症度・流行適性）で複数該当。公衆衛生当局の警告と社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 麻疹と風疹の2つの疾患が同時に報告されている点が重要。インドネシアはワクチン接種率が課題となっている地域であり、公共の場での高いリスク、特に免疫力が低い児童への影響が強調されている。2026年3月現在のリアルタイムイベントであり、地域の保健当局による積極的な対応が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná reforça alerta contra sarampo e importância da vacinação contra o vírus | Governo do Estado do Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná reiterates warning about measles and the importance of vaccination against the measles virus | Government of the State of Paraná
article.articleSummary: Paraná reiterates the importance of measles vaccination after Brazil confirms its first imported measles case of the year, a six‑month‑old in São Paulo with recent travel to Bolivia. Despite being recertified measles‑free by PAHO in November 2024, the Americas report a surge in cases in early 2026 (1,031 confirmed), about 45 times higher than the same period in 2025. State Health Secretary Beto Preto emphasizes maintaining high vaccination coverage to prevent reintroduction. Paraná tracks strong triple viral (MMR) vaccine uptake: in 2025, 97% of 1‑year‑olds received the first dose and 90% the second. Measles vaccination is free at all Basic Health Units, with doses at 12 months and 15 months. Proximity to Argentina, Bolivia, and Paraguay keeps vigilance high and vaccination remains the key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、麻疹警告を再度強調し、ウイルスに対するワクチン接種の重要性を周知 | パラナ州政府
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで輸入麻疹症例が2026年初めて確認され、南米全域で症例が急増（前年同期比45倍）。複数国での同時発生と国際的な拡大リスクが明らかであり、IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ブラジル、アルゼンチン、スペイン（カナリア諸島）、ボリビア、パラグアイの複数国・地域にまたがる発生。2024年11月にPAHOから麻疹排除認定を受けたばかりの南米での急速な再興が懸念される。6ヶ月児の重症例確認済み。南米は麻疹に対する流行リスクが高く、隣国との地理的近接性により監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria : comment protéger les soignants contre la fièvre de Lassa ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: How to Protect Healthcare Workers from Lassa Fever?
article.articleSummary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria shows significant risk to health workers: six healthcare workers infected in one week, raising the year-to-date toll to 37 among frontline staff. The Nigerian Centre for Disease Control reports 65 new confirmed cases last week, a slight decrease from the previous week, underscoring persistent transmission. Lassa fever is a viral hemorrhagic illness endemic in West Africa, with thousands of deaths annually, often due to delayed diagnosis. Cases have been reported beyond Nigeria, including the United States, South Africa, and even China, illustrating international concern about spread. Health authorities call for strengthened protective measures for frontline workers and accelerated case detection and reporting to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：ラッサ熱から医療従事者を保護する方法？
triage.triage_reason: ラッサ熱の国際的拡大（米国、南アフリカ、中国での報告）、医療従事者への重篤な影響（1週間に6人の感染）、及び西アフリカでの高い死亡率を示すエンデミック疾患として、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ラッサ熱は西アフリカにおいてエンデミック疾患であるが、米国、南アフリカ、中国での報告例が記事で明記されており、国際的な拡大懸念が顕在化している。医療従事者の感染リスクが高い（1週間に6人、年間計37人）という点は、管理可能性への懸念を示唆している。配信日時が2026年3月であり、将来の日付であるが、評価対象として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde da Paraíba promove capacitação para fortalecer combate às arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba Health Department promotes training to strengthen the fight against arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: On March 16, 2026, the Paraíba State Health Department (SES-PB), via Health Surveillance Management (GEVS), launched a training in João Pessoa to deploy entomological surveillance using ovitraps to monitor Aedes aegypti and strengthen arboviral response. The program runs through March 17 and gathers technicians from the 7th Regional Health Management and local municipalities. Ovitraps attract eggs; samples identify vector presence and map high-risk areas, guiding deployment. Nilton Guedes calls it modernization, enabling targeted interventions and faster responses to arboviral alerts. Training reinforces environmental surveillance, home visits, surveys in high-risk sites, and larviciding, with emphasis on integrating environmental surveillance with primary health care. Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika remain challenges. As of Feb 6, 2026, Paraíba reported 317 probable arboviroses (292 dengue, 25 chikungunya); no Zika or Oropouche confirmed; no deaths. One dengue case under investigation in João Pessoa. Community action to remove standing water is crucial. Caaporã participation cited.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州保健部がアルボウイルス感染症対策強化のための研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 複数のアルボウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ、オロポーシュ）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の関心がある。しかし記事は主として対策強化の研修内容であり、新規の深刻な急増や異常な拡大パターンは明確ではない。情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月16日時点で、パライバ州は317件の可能性のあるアルボウイルス患者（デング292件、チクングニア25件）を報告しており、ジカおよびオロポーシュは確認されていない。死亡者はなし。複数の蚊媒介性疾患が同時に発生しており、地域の公衆衛生当局が積極的に対応しているが、現段階では国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な医療上の圧迫は記事から明確ではない。続報により患者数の急増や重症化の報告があれば、PICKUP判定に変更される可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया जोखिम वाले गांव में फीवर सर्वे का कार्य आरंभ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever survey work begins in a malaria-prone village.
article.articleSummary: Fever survey and malaria prevention drive has begun in malaria-prone blocks of Western Singhbhum district, India. The campaign covers all malaria-risk villages, including those inside forested regions, with health workers deployed from the district headquarters and block-level Community Health Centers and Sub-Centers. The fever screening and malaria surveillance effort runs through 25 March 2026, with Chaibasa—the district headquarters—listed as a base for operations. The initiative aims to enhance detection, prompt treatment, and prevention of malaria transmission in high-risk areas by systematic field screening and active case finding. No specific case counts or laboratory-confirmation results are provided in the report; the focus is preventive surveillance and rapid response in malaria-affected localities to mitigate outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア危険地帯の村で発熱調査が開始
triage.triage_reason: 本報告はマラリア高リスク地域における予防的サーベイランスおよび感染症対策キャンペーンであり、新規発生の深刻な事例報告ではない。具体的な患者数や異常な死亡率の記載がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当が認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的なマラリアサーベイランスおよび予防キャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規クラスターや異常な疾病負荷を示唆するものではない。インド国内の地方部におけるルーチン対応であると評価される。

article.articleHeadline: 28岁上海女健身教练确诊艾滋病，痛苦坦言：早有异常，当时没重视_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 28-year-old Shanghai female fitness coach diagnosed with AIDS, painfully admitting: there were warning signs early on, and I didn't take them seriously at the time.
article.articleSummary: Shanghai, China: a 28-year-old female fitness coach was diagnosed with HIV/AIDS, underscoring the urgency of testing. Acute infection occurs in about 50–70% within 2–4 weeks, with fever, sore throat, lymphadenopathy, rash, myalgia; the window period is roughly 10 days to 4 weeks by test type. She experienced fatigue and painless swelling in the neck but did not test. Recurrent oral ulcers and thrush can signal immune compromise. Sexual transmission remains the main route, even from healthy-appearing partners. Without treatment, HIV attacks CD4+ T cells and increases viral load, risking Pneumocystis pneumonia and cryptococcal meningitis. ART within 6 months preserves immunity, often via a single daily pill. PEP within 72 hours and PrEP for high-risk individuals are key. Now on ART with CD4 recovery; she urges testing and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 28歳上海女性フィットネスコーチがエイズと診断、痛ましくも告白：早期に異常があったが、当時は重視しなかった
triage.triage_reason: 個別の症例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性の基準を満たさない。ただし、HIV感染の啓発価値と社会的関心の可能性があるため経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: 本報告は個別症例の媒体向け啓発記事である。感染者の個人情報公開と啓発メッセージを含むため社会的関心は高いが、集団発生や流行の兆候は認められない。上海におけるHIV流行状況の全体像に関する情報が不足しているため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná alerta sobre a importância de se vacinar contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná warns about the importance of getting vaccinated against measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles case detected in Brazil in 2026: in São Paulo, a six‑month‑old infant with recent travel to Bolivia has been diagnosed, marking Brazil’s first measles case of the year. Paraná state warns that the episode could risk reintroducing the virus and emphasizes vaccination as a preventive measure. Across the Americas early in 2026, measles activity has surged with 1,031 confirmed cases, about 45 times higher than in 2025. PAHO/OPAS notes Brazil was certified measles‑free in November 2024, highlighting the importance of preventing importation of the virus. Paraná reports the highest 1‑year‑old coverage for the measles‑mumps‑rubella triple vaccine, with 2025 first‑dose at 96.91% and second‑dose at 89.72%; vaccination is free in all 399 Paraná municipalities. The aim is to prevent reintroduction via travel‑related cases and safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、麻疹ワクチン接種の重要性について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年11月に麻疹排除認定を受けたが、2026年初頭にボリビア渡航歴のある患者から輸入症例が検出された。南米全域で麻疹患者が昨年比45倍に増加している状況下での再導入リスクはIHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、国際的拡大可能性と公衆衛生への重大な影響がある。
triage.notes: 2026年初頭の南米での麻疹流行状況（2025年比45倍）が背景にある。患者は6ヶ月児でボリビア渡航歴があり、輸入症例の可能性が高い。ブラジルの麻疹排除認定（2024年11月）からの初の確認症例であり、再導入防止が重要課題となっている。スペイン領カナリア諸島も発生地域に含まれており、多地域への潜在的拡大リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: MG confirma mais de 8 mil casos de dengue e investiga 14 mortes possivelmente causadas pela doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais confirms more than 8,000 dengue cases and investigates 14 deaths possibly caused by the disease.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, reported 26,471 probable dengue cases in 2026 as of March 16, with 8,144 confirmed. The state investigates 14 dengue-related deaths, with six deaths already confirmed this year. For chikungunya, 4,048 probable cases have been recorded, of which 2,306 are confirmed; one death is under investigation and one death has been confirmed from chikungunya. Zika shows fewer cases: 19 probable, of which three are confirmed, with no deaths confirmed or under investigation to date. Data come from SES-MG. Aedes aegypti remains the primary urban vector; prevention: eliminating standing water and maintaining clean environments remains essential, requiring ongoing public health education and community action to reduce arboviral disease burden in Minas Gerais.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州がデング熱8千件以上を確認し、疾病が原因の可能性のある14件の死亡を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡確認・調査中）と異常性が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例）、流行しやすさ（Aedes aegypti媒介、確認例8,144件）、管理可能性（複数疾患同時流行）が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ブラジル南東部ミナスジェライス州における複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ熱）の同時流行。2026年3月16日時点でデング熱の確認例8,144件、6件の死亡確認および14件の死亡調査中という高い重症度が特徴。チクングニアは2,306確認例と1件死亡確認。Aedes aegyptiベクターの継続的な存在により長期曝露リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmaron en Argentina el primer caso de viruela del mono de una variante más contagiosa - Nogoyá Times
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Argentina confirms the first case of a more contagious monkeypox variant - Nogoyá Times.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) Clade Ib case confirmed in Argentina. A 31-year-old man from Buenos Aires with no travel history was diagnosed as an outpatient and is recovering. On March 10, real-time PCR and vesicular-content sequencing confirmed Mpox Clade Ib; epidemiological investigation continues. This is Argentina’s first Clade Ib case; Clade Ib, identified in 2023 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is more transmissible and potentially more virulent than Clade IIb, with transmission via close contact and sexual networks. By 2026 Argentina had five mpox cases, all Clade II (four in Buenos Aires City, one in Río Negro). In the Americas, 14 Clade Ib cases have been reported: United States 9, Canada 2, Brazil 2, Mexico 1, Argentina 1, with community transmission in France, Portugal, Spain. Transmission primarily by direct contact with lesions or secretions; incubation 5–21 days. Isolation until crusts fall; 21-day contact follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンがより感染性の高い天然痘の亜種の最初の症例を確認 - Nogoyá Times
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ib（より感染性・病原性が高い亜種）がアルゼンチンで初めて確認された。すでに米国、カナダ、ブラジル、メキシコで確認され、フランス、ポルトガル、スペインでコミュニティ伝播が報告されている国際的に拡大するリスクの高いシグナルである。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ibは2023年コンゴ民主共和国で同定された亜種で、従来のClade IIbより感染性が高く病原性も高い可能性がある。渡航歴のない患者からの感染確認は地域内での伝播リスクを示唆。既にアメリカ大陸14例、ヨーロッパでのコミュニティ伝播確認により、WHO通知基準（IHR4項目すべて該当）かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当のため、直ちにフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: R.Pires realiza treinamento sobre arboviroses para profissionais da Atenção Básica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: R. Pires conducts training on arboviruses for primary care professionals.
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Pires conducted a training on arboviruses (dengue, chikungunya, Zika) for primary care professionals, including doctors, nurses, and technicians, to update protocols and strengthen diagnosis, treatment, and case monitoring. The session presented local epidemiology, surveillance strategies, prevention actions, patient flow, alarm signs, clinical management, and notification/follow-up, emphasizing integrated work among epidemiological surveillance, primary care, and community mobilization to curb Aedes aegypti. The city reported a 70% drop in dengue from 2024 (687 cases) to 2025 (199 cases); as of 2026, four cases are confirmed. The Centro de Controle de Zoonoses operates with over 900 traps, the first ABC region city to install them at strategic sites (commerce, schools, bus terminal). Vaccination doses were provided for community health workers and endemia control agents, with adolescents aged 10–14 being vaccinated across 11 health units.

triage.headline_ja: R. ピレスがアルボウイルスについての初期医療専門家向けトレーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱の3つのアルボウイルス感染症が対象だが、記事内容は訓練・啓発活動が主であり、新たな急速な疾患流行や異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ただしブラジルにおける複数のアルボウイルスの継続的な存在と対策強化の動きは注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主内容は自治体による予防・対策活動（訓練、ワクチン接種、ベクター監視）の強化であり、緊急的なアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただしデング熱の症例数は2024年から2025年で減少（687→199）しており、2026年は現在4例のみと報告されている。複数のアルボウイルスが地域に存在し、ヒト-ヒト感染（蚊媒介）のリスクが存在するため、長期曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当するが、オンゴーイングな監視対象レベルに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 加速构建AI全链条防治包虫病体系（退病录）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Accelerating the construction of an AI-enabled end-to-end prevention and control system for echinococcosis (Remission Record).
article.articleSummary: Hydatid disease (echinococcosis) on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau is being tackled through AI-enabled, end-to-end prevention and control. From 2005 to 2024, patients declined from about 50,000 to 23,622. The disease has cystic and alveolar forms; liver cysts cause compression and, in alveolar disease, liver damage with potential spread to lungs or brain leading to multi-organ failure. In Qinghai's Guoluo and Yushu regions, prevalence once reached 8.9–12.8%, with strong familial clustering; untreated 10-year mortality exceeded 90%. Medical advances include ex vivo liver resection with autotransplantation for end-stage recurrence (2025), widespread liver surgery, minimally invasive options (laparoscopic cystectomy for cysts under 5 cm), and percutaneous/ablation therapies (microwave) with high survival (98–99% at 5 years). AI-enabled screening and tracing, plus portable AI ultrasound, enable rural diagnosis. By 2030, all endemic counties aim for basic control; 95% dog deworming; 100% livestock vaccination and harmless processing of diseased organs; no stray dogs in Qinghai’s endemic counties.

triage.headline_ja: AI全链条防治包虫病体系の加速構築（退病录）
triage.triage_reason: 包虫病は地方病ではあるが、本記事は予防・制御の進展と医学的成果を報じるもので、新規の感染症危機や異常な発生状況を示していない。患者数は過去20年で減少傾向を示しており、国家的対策が機能している状況である。
triage.notes: 包虫病は青海・チベット高原の風土病であり、長期的な曝露と感染リスク存在は認められる。しかし、記事は危機的な発生やアウトブレイクではなく、AI導入を含む予防・制御体系の成功事例として報じられており、患者数の減少傾向（2005年約50,000人→2024年23,622人）が示されている。中国国家レベルでの関心は高いが、国際的な蔓延リスクや支援要求は示唆されていない。シグナルレベルの新規危機とは判定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Uberaba registra primeira morte por chikungunya em Minas Gerais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uberaba records first chikungunya death in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Uberaba, Minas Gerais, recorded its first chikungunya death in 2026. The victim was an elderly woman aged 70–79. Uberaba has 14 confirmed chikungunya cases this year, with a transmission rate of 0.11, indicating low current circulation. In Minas Gerais overall, 4,048 probable chikungunya cases have been reported, of which 2,306 are confirmed. For dengue, Uberaba has about 1,600 probable cases in 2026 with nine confirmed and no deaths locally; the state totals 26,471 probable dengue cases and six deaths. Zika in Minas Gerais shows 19 probable and three confirmed cases, with no deaths. The disease transmission vector is Aedes aegypti. In the Triângulo Mineiro region, authorities launched preventive actions and a task force to train primary, secondary, hospital care, surveillance, and health services.

triage.headline_ja: ウベラバ、ミナスジェライス州で初のチクングニア熱死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での初の死亡事例報告であり、複数の蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア熱、デング熱、ジカ熱）の同時流行が確認されている。死亡例の報告は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州における初のチクングニア熱死亡事例であり、同時にデング熱（4,048例中2,306確認）とジカ熱（19例中3確認）の同時流行が進行中。Aedes aegyptiによる媒介により感染しやすい環境が存在。当局が既に対応タスクフォースを立ち上げている点から管理可能性への懸念あり。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ Detectan el primer caso en Argentina de la variante más agresiva y contagiosa de la "viruela del mono | Actualizado marzo 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ▷ First case in Argentina of the most aggressive and contagious variant of Monkeypox | Updated March 2026.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports its first mpox (Monkeypox) case caused by the more aggressive Clade Ib, marking a shift from previously detected Clade II infections (five cases, four in Buenos Aires City and one in Río Negro). In 2026, Clade Ib cases in the Americas total 14 (US 9; Canada 2; Brazil 2; Mexico 1; Argentina 1), with community transmission reported in France, Portugal, and Spain. The Ministry of Health urges heightened clinical suspicion for mpox in patients with umbilicated rash, proctitis, lymphadenopathy, extreme fatigue, or sore throat, and to assess travel or contact history. Isolate patients until crusts fall and new skin forms; enforce PPE; initiate contact tracing within 24 hours, with 3-week follow-up. The incubation is 5–21 days (typically 6–13), and illness usually resolves in 14–21 days with symptomatic care. On March 10, PCR and vesicular DNA sequencing confirmed the Clade Ib mpox in the patient; no further suspected cases yet.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンでより攻撃的で感染性の高い「猿痘」の変異体（Clade Ib）の最初の症例を検出 | 2026年3月更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）および複数国での確認されたClade Ib感染により、シグナルとして識別される。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ibは従来のClade IIよりも攻撃性および感染性が高い。アルゼンチンでの初確認であり、米国（9例）、カナダ（2例）、ブラジル（2例）、メキシコ（1例）に加えて、フランス・ポルトガル・スペインでのコミュニティ伝播が報告されている。複数大陸への拡散とClade転換が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará registra 2º caso de mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará records second mpox case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, Ceará State, Brazil, reports 27 suspected mpox notifications, with 17 discarded, 2 confirmed, and 8 under laboratory analysis. The second 2026 mpox case was recorded in Fortaleza, per the IntegraSUS dashboard updated on 16 March; the first confirmed case in 2026 was in February in Fortaleza, involving a patient aged 30–39. In 2025 Ceará had 13 confirmed mpox cases, and in 2024 there were 24. Mpox is a viral zoonosis of the Orthopoxvirus genus, transmitted by close contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials, causing fever, lymphadenopathy, and painful skin eruptions. Preventive measures from the Ceará Health Secretariat include avoiding contact with suspected/confirmed cases, hand hygiene, and masking in high-risk scenarios or when symptomatic. Four suspected cases are under investigation in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州が2026年の2番目のmpox症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でmpox症例が継続的に報告されており、2026年上半期で既に2例確認されている。ただし、症例数は限定的（2確認例、27疑い例中17は除外）であり、国際的拡大やWHO通知レベルの深刻度の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: mpoxはヒト-ヒト感染可能な既知の病原体であり、セアラ州では2024年24例、2025年13例と継続的な発生が記録されている。本報告は新規イベントというより既存の流行継続の監視データに該当。症例数は現在のところ限定的であるが、人獣共通感染症としての特性と接触感染の可能性により、引き続き経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: SES participa de conferência nacional de hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat participates in National Leprosy Conference.
article.articleSummary: SES-MT participated in the National High-Level Leprosy Conference in Rio de Janeiro (March 11–14, 2026) to discuss strategies to confront leprosy, a continuing epidemiological challenge in Brazil. Delegates from the Mato Grosso State Health Secretariat—epidemiological surveillance and health care teams—emphasized surveillance strengthening, service access, social inclusion, and innovative approaches within the SUS. Alessandra Moraes stressed alignment with national and international elimination efforts and the need for integrated policies in the public health system. Silvia Tomaz highlighted training programs at the Public Health School: since 2022, 37 doctors have been trained to recognize early leprosy symptoms; 23 more become specialists in April. By month's end, the School will inaugurate the second cohort of the Interprofessional Specialization for Care of People with Leprosy, forming 30 additional specialists. The conference also covered early diagnosis, primary care strengthening, stigma reduction, and new technologies for prevention and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: State Health Secretariat participates in National Leprosy Conference.
triage.triage_reason: 記事は進行中の麻疹対策会議の報告であり、新規発生イベント、異常な流行、または国際的な懸念を示す情報がない。国家的な対策強化と人材育成が主な内容であり、公衆衛生上の新たなリスク信号は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は麻疹の国家的対策推進に関する会議報告であり、既知の地域的課題への対応策の共有が主題。新規または異常な疾病負荷、流行の兆候、国際的リスクについての具体的記述がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Jovem com tuberculose é levado em carrinho de mão até ambulância que não acessa bairro: 'Esquecidos na lama'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young person with tuberculosis is carried in a wheelbarrow to an ambulance that can't reach the neighborhood: 'Forgotten in the mud'.
article.articleSummary: A 25-year-old man with tuberculosis and pneumonia was carried by a wheelbarrow for about 30 minutes to reach an ambulance in Parque Santana, Botujuru district, Campo Limpo Paulista, São Paulo, Brazil, when rain-induced mud blocked access to the neighborhood. The Samu ambulance could not reach his home; the pickup point was reached after the 30-minute struggle. He was transported to the Hospital de Clínicas de Campo Limpo Paulista, medicated, and discharged on the morning of Friday 13 March. The incident underscores severe infrastructure deficits in Parque Santana, which lacks asphalt and basic services, complicating medical access during rains. The patient’s mother, Angelita Ribeiro, described feeling abandoned. The report does not indicate an ongoing outbreak or laboratory-confirmed cases beyond this individual.”} } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } }}} } } } } } } } } } }}}

triage.triage_reason: 個別の結核症例報告であり、集団発生（アウトブレイク）の兆候がない。インフラアクセス問題は公衆衛生システムの課題だが、感染症危機管理シグナルとしての特性を満たさない。
triage.notes: 結核は周知の風土病疾患。報告内容は個別症例の医療アクセス問題であり、アウトブレイク、集団発生、または異常な疫学的パターンの証拠はない。地方メディアの社会問題報道の性格が強い。EBS監視対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Número de aves mortas por gripe aviária sobe para 30 na Estação Ecológica do Taim | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of dead birds due to avian influenza rises to 30 at the Taim Ecological Station | South Zone
article.articleSummary: As of March 16, 2026, thirty wild birds have died from highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) at the Taim Ecological Station in Rio Grande, southern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Confirmed fatalities comprise two garça-moura and 28 white swans, found at Lagoa da Mangueira within the reserve, which has been closed since March 3 and will remain closed until authorities declare the outbreak controlled. Avian influenza is a viral disease that primarily affects birds but can also infect mammals and, rarely, humans after direct contact with contaminated animals. Transmission occurs via secretions, feces, or carcasses. Seapi states that detection does not alter the sanitary status of Rio Grande do Sul or Brazil as avian influenza–free areas, and there is no impact on poultry product trade, since the disease is not transmitted by ingestion.

triage.headline_ja: タイム生態学的保護区での野鳥の鳥インフルエンザ死亡数が30羽に増加 | ゾーナ・スル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部でH5N1による野鳥30羽の死亡が確認され、異常性と重症度は認められるが、現時点では公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響、確認された人間感染、または国際的な拡大リスクが記事から明示されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性で人獣共通感染症だが、記事では人間感染の報告はなし。野生動物での確認であり、国内当局は商業的家禽および国際貿易への影響はないと述べている。ただし、未検出の人間感染リスク、継続的な野鳥死亡、および家禽群への潜在的な拡大リスク（記事に明記されていない）があるため、追加情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Comum em cães, giardíase também pode afetar gatos; conheça sinais de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Common in dogs, giardiasis can also affect cats; learn the warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Giardiasis, caused by Giardia duodenalis, is common in dogs but can also affect cats. A Brazilian article notes cats may show digestive signs similar to dogs, though some remain asymptomatic. Transmission occurs when cats ingest cysts in water, contaminated food or surfaces, or via cysts on fur or objects; cysts shed in feces can survive long in the environment, especially in busy multi-animal settings. Signs in cats include watery or foul-smelling diarrhea, greasy stools, abdominal discomfort, gas, weight loss, and reduced appetite; severity varies with age, immune status, and stress. Puppies, immunocompromised animals, and crowded living conditions increase risk. Diagnosis relies on fecal exams to detect cysts; treatment involves antiparasitic medication prescribed by a veterinarian and rigorous hygiene of bowls, litter boxes, and shared spaces to prevent reinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に多い ジアルジア症は猫にも感染する可能性がある。警告兆候を知ろう。
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物（イエネコ）におけるジアルジア症に関する一般的な情報提供であり、人間への公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆する情報は含まれていない。ヒト感染症の集団発生や異常なヒト発症の報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物（ペット）向けの健康情報であり、ヒト感染症監視対象外。ジアルジア症はヒトにも感染可能な人獣共通感染症だが、本記事ではペットケアの教育情報に限定されており、ヒト発症事例、集団発生、または公衆衛生上の懸念は報告されていない。影響カテゴリが「animals」に限定されている点も確認。

article.articleHeadline: Evaluating dengue transmission dynamics in an endemic urban setting in Viet Nam: an index-household contact cohort study
article.articleSummary: Dengue transmission dynamics are evaluated in an endemic urban setting in Vietnam via an index-household contact cohort study (published 2026-03-16). The research is an international collaboration involving Vietnam's Pasteur Institute in Nha Trang and the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology in Hanoi, alongside the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (UK), Nagasaki University (Japan), and collaborators in Belgium and the USA. The study design centers on identifying dengue index cases and tracing household contacts to elucidate transmission patterns in urban Vietnam. The available metadata does not report results, case counts, deaths, or specific outbreak status. The work aims to inform understanding of dengue spread within households and urban settings in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの風土病流行都市部におけるデング熱感染動態の評価：指標世帯接触コホート研究
triage.triage_reason: 学術論文の研究方法論に関する記事であり、新規アウトブレイク、死亡報告、または緊急の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すエビデンスがない。メタデータに具体的な症例数、死亡情報、または異常な流行状況の報告がない。
triage.notes: これは学術研究論文（The Lancet Infectious Diseases掲載）の研究デザイン・方法論に関する記事である。新規事例報告やアウトブレイク警告ではなく、既知の風土病についての学術的な研究協力の紹介に過ぎない。具体的な症例数、死亡、または急性の流行状況の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Liderança de terreiro de Magé participa de Conferência sobre Hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leadership of Magé's terreiro participates in a conference on Hansen's disease.
article.articleSummary: Hansen's disease (leprosy) is highlighted in Magé, Brazil, as religious leadership from a terreiro, Pai Paulo de Ogun, participates in Brazil's National High-Level Conference on Hansen's Disease. The event links public health policy with human rights and traditional knowledge, emphasizing the strategic role of terreiro communities in health promotion, equity, and addressing long-standing inequalities affecting Black populations and vulnerable territories. By engaging alongside public managers, international bodies, scientific experts, and social movements, the participation broadens understanding of Hansen's disease beyond a purely biomedical frame, underscoring that the illness is deeply influenced by social, cultural, and territorial determinants that impact early diagnosis, access to treatment, and stigma reduction. The involvement of religious and community leaders in policy discussions reinforces social oversight and participatory approaches toward more inclusive, effective disease responses. Pai Paulo reaffirmed a commitment to a Brazil free of Hansen's disease, without stigma, guided by social justice and health equity.

triage.headline_ja: マジェのテレイロ指導者がハンセン病に関する会議に参加
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の公衆衛生政策会議における宗教指導者の参加に関する記事であり、新規の疾患流行や異常な疾患発生を示す信号ではない。背景情報や政策的枠組みの報道であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する明確なシグナルはない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのハンセン病撲滅に向けた公衆衛生政策会議における宗教・地域指導者の参加を扱っており、健康公平性と社会正義の推進に関する政策的イニシアティブである。新規の流行、症例増加、異常な疾患パターン、または国際的拡大の懸念を示す疫学的データは含まれていない。一般的な疾患対策・社会施策の報道であるため、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis at a crossroads
article.articleSummary: 2024 TB mortality was 1.23 million, with 10.7 million people developing active TB. Development aid cuts risk reversing progress, with up to 606,900 additional TB deaths projected 2025–2030 across 55 countries. USAID funds over 20% of TB programmes; the US provided about half of international donor TB funding from 2015–2024. Since these cuts, several countries report severe losses in TB technical support, diagnostics, and anti-TB drug procurement. TB burden concentrates in poverty and with comorbidities; a tuberculogenic environment demands cross-sector action beyond health, including housing, nutrition, and education. The RATIONS trial shows nutrition could prevent 39–48% of household TB cases over two years and may be cost-effective in India. Ending TB by 2030 requires multi-sector coordination and complex systems thinking across Africa and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の岐路
triage.triage_reason: 結核の世界的な死亡負荷（2024年123万人死亡、新規患者1070万人）と、開発支援削減による大規模な追加死亡予測（2025-2030年に55カ国で606,900人）がもたらす国際的な公衆衛生への重大な影響。アフリカ、インド、米国を含む多地域にわたる異常で予想外の疾病負荷増加傾向が確認される。
triage.notes: 高名な医学雑誌The Lancet Global Healthでの発表。開発支援（特にUSAID）の削減による保健システムへの具体的な悪影響が報告されており、政策的な重大性も高い。結核は世代的な課題であり、貧困・栄養不良などの社会的決定要因との関連が強調されている。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当、IHR基準も3つ以上該当でシグナルとしての価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 24 organizaciones alertan sobre el "inicio" de epidemia de fiebre amarilla y piden transparencia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 24 organizations warn about the "start" of a yellow fever epidemic and call for transparency.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-four organizations, led by the National Academy of Medicine and the NGO Provea, warn of the start of a yellow fever epidemic in Venezuela and urge immediate government action. They criticize opacity, noting first cases were detected in June 2025 but eight months passed before acknowledgment. In a letter to the Health Ministry and Parliament, experts urge release of the 2024–2026 epidemiological bulletins to restore transparency and evidence-based decisions. Health Minister Nuramy Gutiérrez confirmed deaths from the disease last year, while official tallies show seven confirmed cases in 2026; Isabel Iturria had cited 36 infections since mid-2025. The government declared an epidemiological alert aiming for 95% vaccination coverage, reporting 49,000 recently immunized, adding to about three million vaccinated over the past decade, with donations from India, Russia and Brazil. Despite efforts, the Expanded Immunization Program has not met targets, underscoring the need to strengthen health systems to reach all Venezuelans.

triage.headline_ja: 24の団体が黄熱病流行の「開始」に警告し、透明性を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国への地理的広がり、政府機関への警告、透明性の欠如が報告されており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: ベネズエラを中心とした流行が報告され、ブラジル、ロシア、インドを含む複数国が関連。2025年6月初回症例検出から8ヶ月間の情報開示遅延、政府の透明性不足が指摘されている。ワクチン接種プログラムの目標未達成も懸念要因。Bluedot APIが4カ国の発生地を検出しているが、ベネズエラが流行の中心と推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue encontra 148 criadouros do mosquito em bairros de Limeira | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Task Force Finds 148 Mosquito Breeding Sites in Limeira Neighborhoods | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, March 14, 2026, Limeira's Zoonoses Division conducted a vector-control drive across Vila Camargo and neighboring neighborhoods, identifying 148 Aedes aegypti breeding sites in 2,241 inspected properties. Of these, 79 containers held water and 13 contained larvae, signaling direct proliferation risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Larvae were mainly found in common domestic items such as buckets, pet water dispensers, bottles, plastic packaging, and plant saucers that accumulate standing water. The division urges residents to perform weekly 10-minute home inspections to eliminate potential breeding sites. Citizens can report stagnant water or suspected foci via the e-Ouve 156 platform used by the city hall.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策タスクフォース、リメイラの各地区で148カ所の蚊の繁殖地を発見
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンパウロ州リメイラでデング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニアの媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の大量繁殖地が確認されたが、既知の流行地域での対策活動報告であり、現段階では新規の地理的拡大や深刻な患者発生の報告がないため、情報不足での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱、ジカ、チクングニアの媒介蚊の繁殖地発見に関する地方自治体の対策活動報告。患者数や死亡事例の報告がなく、既知の流行地域での予防キャンペーンの一環と考えられる。ただしネッタイシマカの大量繁殖地の確認とそれに伴う感染リスク増加の可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。IHR基準では該当0件だがWPRO基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」で該当。

article.articleHeadline: Campak en Kalimantan Timur: Baja Cobertura de Vacunación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in East Kalimantan: Low Vaccination Coverage.
article.articleSummary: Measles in East Kalimantan, Indonesia, with vaccination coverage in Samarinda (region known as Bumi Etalase Ibu Kota Nusantara) at 65% for the measles vaccine, well below the national 95% target, leaving about 30% of children unvaccinated and at high risk. As of March 17, 2026, health officials warn that measles is a highly contagious virus causing high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a red rash, with babies and young children most vulnerable; malnourished adults can also be carriers. To curb transmission, the government has updated the immunization schedule from a single dose to three doses at 9 months, 18 months, and first grade of primary school. 9-month coverage is 62%, 18-month coverage 60%, while first-grade primary school coverage reaches 92%. Cooperation with schools is highlighted as effective, alongside promoting healthy lifestyles to bolster immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタンの麻疹：予防接種カバレッジの低さ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東カリマンタン州サマリンダにおける麻疹発生。予防接種カバレッジが全国目標95%に対し65%にとどまり、約30%の小児が未接種で高リスク状態。IHR基準「異常/予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高感染性疾患（R0=12-18）で、ヒト-ヒト感染。予防接種カバレッジが全国目標を大幅に下回り、幼児・免疫不全者での重症化リスク高い。インドネシア政府は対応策を講じているが、地域的な予防接種戦略強化が必要。2026年3月17日の報告であり、現在の流行状況の追跡が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Jovem com tuberculose é levado em carrinho de mão até ambulância no bairro Parque Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young person with tuberculosis is carried in a wheelbarrow to an ambulance in the Parque Santana neighborhood.
article.articleSummary: On the night of March 12, a 25-year-old resident of Parque Santana, Botujuru district, Campo Limpo Paulista, São Paulo, Brazil, with tuberculosis and pneumonia, suffered a severe breathing crisis. Muddy streets after heavy rain prevented ambulance access, so he was carried in a wheelbarrow to reach a Samu ambulance; the 30-minute transfer underscored critical access delays. He was transported to Hospital de Clínicas de Campo Limpo Paulista, treated, and discharged on March 13. The incident highlights chronic infrastructure neglect in Parque Santana—an asphalt-less, underserved area with limited basic services that hampers emergency response. Authorities were asked for comment, but no response was provided by publication date (March 16, 2026). The case emphasizes the vulnerability of marginalized communities and the urgent need for safer road access to protect life during medical emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: パルケ・サンタナ地区で肺結核患者が一輪車で救急車まで搬送される
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本件は個別症例の地域インフラ問題に関する記事。IHR基準2つ以上の該当なく、WPROスクリーニング基準における複数項目が「不明」または「No」であり、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は結核患者1名の個別事例であり、ブラジル国内で既知の風土病である結核そのものの流行シグナルではない。記事の主眼は地域インフラ（道路整備）の不備と緊急医療へのアクセス困難さであり、感染症の流行・拡大リスクとは直結していない。継続的な監視対象にはならない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Chile refuerza vacunación contra la influenza ante circulación de una nueva variante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chile steps up influenza vaccination amid circulation of a new variant.
article.articleSummary: Chile intensifies influenza vaccination as an A(H3N2) variant circulates regionally. The campaign targets 85% coverage among high-risk groups, including health and education workers, older adults, people with chronic diseases, pregnant individuals, lactating women, and schoolchildren. For the second year, Chile’s Health Ministry advanced the vaccination program to reduce infections and complications before winter. Authorities confirm A(H3N2) circulation in Chile and neighboring Peru, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Brazil, a strain linked to higher transmissibility and more severe outcomes in the elderly. About 1,200 vaccination points operate nationwide. Preventive measures are reinforced: frequent handwashing, covering coughs or sneezes, staying home with symptoms, and seeking urgent care for severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: チリがインフルエンザの新規変異株流行に伴い予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: A(H3N2)インフルエンザ変異株が南米5カ国で確認されており、スクリーニング基準複数に該当するが、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、医療逼迫などの重症度情報が不足している。政府の予防接種強化対応が取られているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当（異常性と国際的拡大のリスク）。WPRO基準は4つ該当し、新規変異株の流行（異常性）、複数国での域内拡大（長期曝露・流行性）が確認されている。ただしIHR基準の『公衆衛生への深刻な影響』と『渡航制限リスク』は記事では明記されていない。患者数、重症度、死亡数などの具体的な疫学データが不足しており、政府が適切に対応しているため直ちにPICKUPではなくWATCH判定。続報で患者数や重症度の情報が得られればPICKUP昇格の可能性あり。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Cambodia Reports Second Human H5N1 Bird Flu Infection of 2026 Near Thailand Border - Thailand Medical News
article.articleSummary: Cambodia confirms its second human H5N1 avian influenza case in 2026. A 45-year-old woman from Ropai Village, Preah Netr Preah District, Banteay Meanchey Province near the Thailand border tested positive after confirmation by the National Institute of Public Health; she was admitted to hospital and remains under close medical supervision. Preliminary epidemiology links the infection to poultry exposure: she raises chickens and ducks, several birds in her flock had died, and she had direct contact with dead poultry about three days before testing. Public health teams are sampling the village environment and contacts; close contacts are monitored and receiving Tamiflu as a preventive measure. Cambodia reported 19 confirmed human cases in 2025 (eight deaths). A previous 2026 case in Kampot Province (mid-February) involved a 30-year-old man who cooked/handled a dead chicken and recovered. The current strain is under investigation, likely clade 2.3.2.1c; no link to clade 2.3.4.4b confirmed. Surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: カンボジア、2026年第2例となる人間のH5N1鳥インフルエンザ感染をタイ国境近くで報告
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ヒト感染例の2026年第2例で、重篤度が高く、国際的拡大リスク（タイ国境近くでの発生）があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: カンボジアは2025年に19例の確定症例（死亡8例）を報告しており、2026年に既に2例確認されている。患者は家禽（ニワトリ、アヒル）飼育者で、死んだ家禽への直接接触が感染源と推定される。環境サンプリングと接触者監視が進行中。タイ国境への近接性と継続的な家禽への曝露リスクにより、地域的拡大の懸念がある。株はclade 2.3.2.1cと推定されており、clade 2.3.4.4bとの関連は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: MG tem 6 mortes por dengue e mais de 8 mil casos confirmados; há uma morte por chikungunya e cerca de 2 mil casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais has six dengue-related deaths and more than 8,000 confirmed cases; there is one chikungunya-related death and about 2,000 chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports ongoing dengue, chikungunya, and Zika activity as of March 16–17, 2026. The state health secretariat (SES) urges intensified prevention and control of Aedes aegypti, the vector for all three diseases. Dengue: 8,144 laboratory-confirmed cases and six deaths in 2026, with 14 dengue deaths under investigation; probable dengue cases stand at 26,471. Chikungunya: 2,306 confirmed cases and one confirmed death, with one death under investigation; probable chikungunya cases total 4,048. Zika: 3 confirmed cases and 19 probable, with no deaths reported. A dengue vaccine from Butantan is highlighted, maintaining protection for five years and reducing severe cases. The report also notes ongoing epidemiological updates and current transmission patterns, underscoring the importance of vector-control measures and continued surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州でデング熱の6人の死亡と8,000件以上の確認症例；チクングニアの1人の死亡と約2,000件の症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、ブラジルにおける複数の蚊媒介性疾患の同時流行で死亡者を伴う事象のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州で3つの蚊媒介性ウイルス疾患（デング熱8,144確認例・6死亡、チクングニア2,306確認例・1死亡、ジカ3確認例）が同時に流行している重大事象。Aedes aegypti媒介による広範な曝露が継続中。国家保健機関による対応とワクチン導入の言及あり。WPRO地域（西太平洋地域）の基準をすべて満たし、国際的な監視対象事象。

article.articleHeadline: Pembangunan 3 juta rumah untuk tekan stunting dan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Construction of 3 Million Houses to Curb Stunting and Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Indonesia plans to build 3 million new homes to curb stunting and tuberculosis by improving living conditions in crowded, unhealthy settlements. Announced by Hashim Djojohadikusumo at a Manggarai Station site in Jakarta, the project uses land from PT Kereta Api Indonesia to create healthier, well-ventilated housing. The initiative follows evidence that poor housing contributes to stunting and TB, a major public health challenge, with the Global TB Report 2024 estimating about 1.09 million TB cases and 125,000 TB deaths annually in Indonesia. Health checks have reached 72 million people, yet TB remains prevalent due to sanitation and ventilation gaps. Officials frame housing as a strategic health intervention with broader economic and social equity benefits, referencing international examples (China, Japan, Korea, Singapore) and aligning with TB-focused acceleration efforts highlighted by the Health Ministry in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 結核とスタンティング抑制のための300万戸の住宅建設
triage.triage_reason: 結核は公衆衛生上の重要な課題であり、インドネシアの年間109万人の患者と12.5万人の死亡という深刻な負担が報告されている。しかし本記事は政策公表であり、新規の疾患発生イベントではなく、情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核流行の新たなアウトブレイク報告ではなく、インドネシア政府による公衆衛生政策（住宅建設プログラム）の公表である。結核自体は深刻な公衆衛生課題（年間109万患者、12.5万死亡）だが、記事は新規感染増加や異常な事象を報告していない。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみ、かつ疾患発生イベントの監視という文脈では情報が限定的であるため、WATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Naik, Dinkes Jabar Buka Layanan Vaksinasi di Ratusan Pos Mudik Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rise, West Java Health Office opens vaccination services at hundreds of Eid al-Fitr homecoming checkpoints.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in West Java surged in 2025 to 1,785, with 252 cases reported in Jan–Feb 2026. In response, the West Java Health Office set up measles vaccination at hundreds of Eid al-Fitr homecoming health posts along mudik routes and tourist areas. A total of 282 health posts across 27 districts/cities will be staffed around the clock by 762 doctors, 3,726 nurses, 51 traditional health workers, and 758 ambulance drivers. Vaccination for measles is offered at these posts, alongside health checks, emergency care for heart attacks, lacerations, traffic injuries, and referrals; traditional services like acupressure and herbal drinks are also available. Hasan Sadikin Hospital in Bandung confirmed its Emergency Department will operate fully during Lebaran, with outpatient clinics open on March 18 and 24, 2026. This reflects ongoing measles control amid peak travel season.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹患者数増加、西ジャワ保健局が数百か所のレバラン帰省チェックポイントでワクチン接種サービスを開設
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州における麻疹患者の増加（2025年1,785例、2026年1月-2月252例）を受けた公式対応であり、IHR基準「異常性」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。ピーク旅行季における多数の保健施設の動員と国家的対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事日付が2026年3月17日（未来日時）であり、ブルードットシステムの配信データの妥当性確認が必要。重症度情報（死亡例、入院率）が記事に明記されていないため「不明」と評価。しかし西ジャワ州全域にわたる282か所の保健施設の同時稼働、762名の医師配置など、規模の大きい公式対応が確認されており、フルRRA実施の根拠あり。麻疹はWPRO地域における常時監視対象疾患であり、インドネシアでの流行はシグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária é tema de evento em Montenegro nesta terça-feira - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu is the topic of an event in Montenegro this Tuesday - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (Avian Influenza) headlines the second Rio Grande do Sul State Avian Influenza Forum in Montenegro, Vale do Caí, RS, at Teatro Roberto Atayde Cardona on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, from 13:30. Organized by Seapi’s Department of Vigilance and Sanitary Defense of Animals (DDA) with Asgav and Fundesa, the event aims to share prevention and response strategies after a recently identified focus in Gaucho properties. The program includes 14:00 a session on the Avian Influenza scenario in Brazil and worldwide (Daniela Pacheco Lacerda, MAPA), 14:30 biosafety basics (Paulo Raffi), and a 15:00 panel on the country’s Avian Influenza situation with Daniela Pacheco Lacerda, Fernanda Pinto Piccinini (MBRF), Fernando Groff (DDA), José Eduardo dos Santos (Asgav), João Paulo Zuffo (Seara Alimentos) and Paulo Raffi, followed by closing at 15:40. Live stream via Seapi YouTube; details at agricultura.rs.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザはモンテネグロの今週火曜日のイベントのテーマ - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（Rio Grande do Sul州）での野鳥インフルエンザの最近の検出に関連する公式フォーラムであり、予防・対応戦略を共有するイベントだが、現時点で具体的な患者数、重症度、地理的拡大リスクに関する詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はイベント告知であり、新たな流行を報告するニュース記事ではない。ブラジルRio Grande do Sul州で「最近発見された焦点」が言及されているが、具体的な症例数、確認日、感染者の有無は不明。ただし公式な政府部門（Seapi DDA）による組織的なフォーラムの開催と、複数の関係機関の参加から、当局は状況を重視していることが示唆される。フルRRAのために詳細な疫学情報の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 282 Posko Mudik di Jabar Sediakan Vaksin Campak Gratis, Dinkes Ingatkan Risiko Penularan Saat Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 282 Mudik Posts in West Java Provide Free Measles Vaccines, Health Department Reminds of Transmission Risk During Eid al-Fitr
article.articleSummary: West Java's Health Department provides 282 free measles vaccination posts at mudik health posts during Eid al-Fitr 2026 to curb measles transmission amid high population movement. Vaccines are available across mudik posts in all districts and cities of West Java, with stock managed by the provincial health office in collaboration with local puskesmas. If a district/city declares a measles outbreak (KLB), outbreak-management funding is covered by the local government. Most measles cases occur in children with negative or absent vaccination history, underscoring the need for immunization education. Measles is highly contagious and can cause serious complications such as encephalitis, blindness, pneumonia, and severe malnutrition. Health officials urge those with symptoms to isolate, wear masks, and seek prompt care. Nationally, as of February 23, 2026, 8,224 suspected measles cases and 4 deaths; 21 KLB in 17 districts/cities across 11 provinces, led by West Sumatra, South Sumatra, DI Yogyakarta, West Java, and Central Java.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州の282の移動保健所で無料麻疹ワクチンを提供、保健局は断食明け（レバラン）時の感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全土で麻疹の集団発生（KLB）が確認され、2026年2月23日時点で8,224人の疑似症例と4人の死亡報告、11州17地区で21件のKLBが発生しており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常・予想外」「国際拡大のリスク」に該当する。また脳炎などの合併症リスクも記載されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月17日配信だが、全国統計は2月23日時点。麻疹はWHO優先監視疾患であり、脳炎合併症の報告も含まれている。レバラン期間の大量人口移動による感染拡大リスクが認識されており、政府による広域的ワクチン対応が実施されている。複数州での複数発生地点が存在することから、RRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Va a viajar? Bogotá centraliza vacunas de sarampión en el Aeropuerto y Terminales ante falta de dosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are you traveling? Bogotá centralizes measles vaccines at the airport and terminals due to a shortage of doses.
article.articleSummary: Bogotá centralizes measles-rubella vaccination at El Dorado International Airport and at Salitre and Satélite del Sur transport terminals due to a dose shortage, prioritizing international travelers and ring vaccination. The Expanded Immunization Program currently has about 5,000 doses available, insufficient for over 200 vaccination points; demand surged from 7,995 doses in Q1 2025 to 22,064 by March 2026 (275% increase). The city reports three imported measles cases and maintains an epidemiological alert while awaiting vaccine replenishment from the Ministry of Health. A request for 50,000 additional doses was submitted on February 20, 2026 but remains unassigned. Travelers are advised to be vaccinated at least 15 days before departure. Families should verify children’s vaccination cards and ensure two doses of the measles-rubella (MMR) vaccine, with Bogotá confirming adequate MMR stock across more than 200 points until supplies normalize.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行予定者へ：ボゴタ、麻疹ワクチン不足のため空港と駅でワクチン接種を集約
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹およびルベオラの複合発生、3例の輸入確認症例、ワクチン供給不足による国内流行リスク、複数国（コロンビア・ブラジル）での地理的分布が確認されており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: ワクチン需要が2025年Q1の7,995用量から2026年3月の22,064用量へと275%増加。現在5,000用量のみ利用可能で200以上のワクチン接種拠点に不足。2026年2月20日に5万用量の追加要請が提出されたが未割当。コロンビア・ブラジル両国にまたがる地理的分布と輸入症例の確認により、地域的な流行可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pasca Kasus Gigitan Kucing Rabies, Tim Pokja Disnak Belu Sisir dan Vaksinasi HPR di Manumutin - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following a rabies cat-bite case, Belu's Animal Husbandry Office Working Group sweeps and vaccinates rabies-transmitting animals in Manumutin - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, following a lab-confirmed rabies case from a cat bite that infected 11 residents in Kelurahan Manumutin (Kuneru) on March 14–15, 2026. About 30 officers in seven teams conducted a two-day sweep to identify and vaccinate cats and dogs owned by residents not yet vaccinated, starting from RT 09 to RT 14 on day one. This marks the first reported human exposure to rabies from a cat in Belu; prior rabies cases in the district have been due to dogs. A coordination meeting led by the Belu Vice Regent approved accelerating vaccination, field surveillance, and risk communication. Vaccine stock is 18,325 doses intended for roughly 36,000 dogs, while Belu’s cat population was about 4,008 in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の猫咬傷事例後、ベル県動物衛生局作業部会がマヌムティンで犬猫への予防接種と掃討を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：11人の感染者、予想外：猫からの初の報告ケース、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。インドネシアにおける確認された狂犬病集団発生であり、動物媒介感染症としての重要性が高い。
triage.notes: インドネシアのベル県（東ヌサトゥンガラ州）における2026年3月14-15日の確認狂犬病集団発生。11人が猫咬傷で感染し、同地域で猫からの報告は初例。当局は急速な対応（予防接種加速、野外監視、リスク通信）を承認し、18,325用量のワクチン在庫あり。動物媒介感染症の地域流行として国際通知相当と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmaron el primer caso de viruela del mono de la variante más contagiosa en Argentina: cuáles son sus síntomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They confirmed the first case of the most contagious variant of monkeypox in Argentina: what are its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Clade Ib, a newly identified mpox (monkeypox) variant detected in late 2023 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, shows higher transmissibility and virulence than prior strains. Authorities warn it can spread rapidly through sexual and community contact. In 2026, Argentina reported five mpox cases, all linked to Clade II, amid a shifting landscape as Clade Ib expands regionally. Reports of Clade Ib infections have surfaced in the United States, Canada, Brazil, and Mexico, with Argentina also affected; community transmission has been documented in France, Portugal, and Spain. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin or mucosal lesions in close or sexual contact; contaminated objects and prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions can also spread the virus. Incubation is 5–21 days, and illness is typically self-limited over 2–3 weeks. Early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, swollen lymph nodes, fatigue, and sore throat, followed by lesions on the genital, anal, face, or limbs.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで最も感染力の強い変種の天然痘初感染を確認：その症状は何か
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ib（高い伝染性）の複数国での確認、アルゼンチンでの初例報告、国際的な地域拡大リスク、社会的関心の高さから、IHR基準および社会政治的関心において複数項目該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月の日付であるが、Mpox Clade Ibは2023年後半にDRCで検出された新型変種。複数の米州国（米国、カナダ、ブラジル、メキシコ、アルゼンチン）と欧州（フランス、ポルトガル、スペイン）での報告あり。性的接触および濃厚接触による二次感染の記載により、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高い。アルゼンチンにおけるClade Ib初例報告は区域的な異常事象。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Campak Saat Mudik, Ini Imbauan Kemenkes untuk Pemudik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Measles During Mudik: This Is the Health Ministry's Advisory for Mudik Travelers.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases are rising as Indonesians prepare for mudik, prompting the Health Ministry to issue preventive guidance for travelers. At the Mudik 2026 launch in Jakarta, Acting Director General of Disease Prevention and Control Andi Saguni urged mudik travelers to practice clean and healthy living (PHBS) during journeys, with regular handwashing using soap to curb transmission. He noted that increased mobility heightens measles spread, especially in crowded settings such as terminals, stations, airports, and ports. Mask use is advised, particularly in crowded places; people with coughs and colds should wear masks, and healthy individuals in crowds should also wear masks. The advisory aims to reduce spread of measles as cases rise, with emphasis on basic infection prevention in transit hubs.

triage.headline_ja: mudik期間における麻疹への警戒：インドネシア保健省の旅行者向け勧告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹発生の増加と予防啓発活動は報告されているが、具体的な症例数、死亡者、発症率などの定量的データが記事に含まれていない。情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹の季節的増加とmudik（帰省）シーズンの組み合わせにより、混雑した交通拠点（ターミナル、駅、空港、港）での人-人感染リスクが懸念される。インドネシア保健省による予防啓発が既に実施されており、管理能力は保有していると判断。具体的な症例数、重症度、死亡の報告がないため、公衆衛生への深刻な影響の判断は保留。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Berita Populer Padang: Kasus Campak, Pemudik Mulai Tinggalkan Padang dan Harga Emas Turun Tipis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Popular News in Padang: Measles Case, Returning Travelers Start Leaving Padang, and Gold Prices Slip Slightly.
article.articleSummary: Four measles cases were recorded at Puskesmas Nanggalo, Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia, from January to mid-March 2026. Kapus M Fardhan said the four individuals were diagnosed with measles, with one patient providing a blood sample for laboratory analysis; the sample has been sent to a lab and results are pending. In 2025, the same area reported 81 measles cases. The article does not detail infection sources, vaccination status, or any imported/exported cases. Health authorities continue surveillance and await laboratory confirmation for the four currently identified cases. Padang is a major city in West Sumatra Province, and measles surveillance is part of routine public health monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: パダン市の4つの人気ニュース：麻しん事例、帰省者がパダンを離れ始め、金価格が若干下落
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パダン市で麻しん4例が報告されており、異常性と重症度の評価には情報不足があるが、2025年に同地域で81例の過去の流行履歴があり、継続的な監視対象として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 限定的な情報のため不明項目が多い。4例は報告されているが、重症度、感染源、予防接種状態などの詳細が記事に記載されていない。2025年の81例との時系列比較が必要。ラボ確認結果待機中。定期的な国内感染症監視の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 加速构建AI全链条防治包虫病体系（退病录） --健康·生活--人民网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Accelerating the construction of an AI end-to-end prevention and control system for echinococcosis (Tuibinglu)
article.articleSummary: Echinococcosis (hydatid disease) in western China—centered in Qinghai, Tibet, and Sichuan—is shifting from high-burden hotspots to AI-enhanced, multi-sector control. A new evaluation framework covers nine provinces and 370 endemic counties to guide phased elimination. Disease burden fell from over 50,000 patients in 2005 to 23,622 in 2024. In Qinghai's Yushu and Guoluo, prevalence once ranged 8.93–12.83%, with familial clustering; without timely treatment, 10-year mortality exceeded 90%. In Sichuan’s Aba Prefecture, canine infections fell 97% and livestock infections 90% through dog deworming and livestock immunization. Since 2007, 2.27 million high-risk people underwent ultrasound screening; Qinghai reduced prevalence to 0.1% by 2012. Advances include microsurgical, ablation, and AI-powered diagnostics and surveillance, with targets for 2030 to eliminate hydatid disease from all endemic counties and achieve 95% dog deworming and 100% livestock immunization and organ disposal.

triage.headline_ja: 加速構築AI全チェーン包虫病防治体系（退病録）
triage.triage_reason: 慢性感染症の既存流行地における疾病負荷の低下と制御の進展を報告する内容。異常性や国際拡大リスクが低く、IHR基準を満たさないが、多地域（9省370県）と動物疾病を含む幅広い対象をカバーする点で監視価値あり。
triage.notes: 包虫病は既知の地方病で、記事は疾病負荷の顕著な低下（2005年50,000患者以上→2024年23,622人）と制御成果を報告している。AIを用いた新規診断・監視技術と多部門連携による予防・制御体系の構築推進が主な内容。国内での成功事例の報告であり、新規の懸念ではない。長期的な曝露リスク（WPRO基準5）のみ該当するが、全体的な管理可能性が高く、緊急シグナルの基準を満たさない。社会的・政治的関心は中国国内で高い。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Campak Saat Mudik, Ini Imbauan Kemenkes untuk Pemudik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Measles During Mudik: This Is the Health Ministry's Advisory for Homebound Travelers.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Health Ministry warns Mudik 2026 travelers amid rising measles cases. Key preventive measures include regular handwashing with soap and universal mask use in crowded places such as terminals, stations, airports, and ports. People with coughs and colds should wear masks, and even healthy individuals are advised to mask in crowds. Free health posts along mudik routes provide measles screening and immunization, with some posts offering tuberculosis screening as well. Parents are urged to ensure children are healthy before travel and fully immunized, especially MR/MMR vaccines, with two-dose schedules providing optimal protection. If a child develops fever, cough, or runny nose, travel should be postponed until recovery; if illness occurs during travel, visit the post for initial care. Authorities note collaboration with quarantine health centers and local health offices in Jakarta and across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: ムディク時の麻疹に注意：保健省から帰宅する旅行者への勧告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とTBの2疾患が報告され、ジャカルタでの流行上昇傾向が示唆されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡率、国際的な拡大リスクなどの詳細情報が不足しているため、追加情報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: ムディク（インドネシアの大規模帰宅移動）時期での麻疹流行警告であり、高い流動性人口への曝露リスクが高い。ただし、患者数、重症度分布、具体的な発生状況に関する定量的データが記事に含まれていない。TBの具体的な関連性も不明。保健省による公式勧告と無料スクリーニング実施により管理可能性は比較的高いと判断される。続報で患者数や重症度に関する情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 这种肉最脏，吃一口就可能引发脑膜炎，千万别再往冰箱里囤了！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This type of meat is the dirtiest; even a single bite could trigger meningitis—don't store it in the fridge anymore!
article.articleSummary: A 55-year-old woman from Henan, China, developed purulent meningitis caused by Listeria monocytogenes after eating frozen meat stored in a fridge for about 10 days. She presented with severe headache, high fever, and neck stiffness, and laboratory confirmation linked the meningitis to Listeria. The incident raises public concern about frozen-meat safety. The article notes that home freezers at -18°C or lower halt most microbial growth, but quality and safety depend on meat type and packaging. Generally, frozen meat kept around one month is often safe if continuously frozen and well sealed, though freshness and taste decline; experts vary: some advise not eating frozen meat beyond 6 months, others within 3 months. Best practices include portioning, vacuum sealing, removing air, labeling dates, and thawing in the refrigerator rather than at room temperature to limit bacterial growth. Freezing preserves but does not prevent nutrient loss or taste deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: この種の肉は最も汚い；一口食べるだけで髄膜炎を引き起こす可能性がある―冷蔵庫に詰め込むのはもうやめて！
triage.triage_reason: リステリア単核球増多症による髄膜炎の個別事例報告であり、重症度は高いが、単一症例で集団発生を示唆する証拠に乏しい。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: リステリア単核球増多症による髄膜炎は既知の食品由来感染症であり、個別事例の報告。公衆衛生上の深刻性は認められるが、流行やアウトブレイクの兆候は記事内に見当たらない。冷凍肉の食品安全に関する一般的な注意喚起として機能している。追加報告（集団発生、複数症例、原因究明など）があれば評価を引き上げる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Acre confirma primeiro caso de Mpox no interior e autoridades inicia rastreamento de contatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre confirms first Mpox case in the interior and authorities begin contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) confirmed in Acre's interior, Brazil. Acre's Health Secretariat (Sesacre) reports the first interior case; the patient was treated at Hospital Geral de Brasiléia in Vale do Alto Acre. The patient is a medical student studying in Cobija, Bolivia (Pando Department), who had recently been in São Paulo, Brazil. The patient tested positive and is in isolation; authorities have begun identifying and monitoring contacts. Mpox transmission occurs through direct contact with infected individuals, skin lesions, respiratory secretions, or contaminated objects, via close or intimate contact. Common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal eruptions. Sesacre urges anyone with suspected symptoms to seek medical care and to avoid physical contact or sharing personal items while the disease is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州がMpoxの州内初症例を確認、当局が接触者追跡を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北部の新規地域（アクレ州内部）でMpox確認症例が初めて報告され、国際的な移動歴（ボリビア、サンパウロ経由）を含むため、国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスク、WPROでも複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: 2024年以降のMpoxアウトブレイク状況下での新規地域確認であり、国境地域（ボリビア・ブラジル間）での症例発生のため、地域的波及の可能性が高い。患者の国際移動歴がある点が特に重要。記事配信日時が2026年となっているが、これはソースの誤記と推定。症例数や重症度の詳細情報が限定的であるため、フルRRAで追加情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma sanitaria en Argentina: confirmaron el primer caso de una variante más contagiosa de viruela del mono
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in Argentina: first case of a more contagious monkeypox variant confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Argentina confirms its first Monkeypox (Mpox) Clade Ib case, detected in a 31-year-old man in Buenos Aires City with no travel history; treated as an outpatient and recovering. Clade Ib, identified in late 2023 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is more transmissible and virulent, linked to higher mortality and pediatric impact. By 2026, five mpox cases of Clade II had been confirmed in Argentina (four in Buenos Aires, one in Río Negro). Authorities urge reinforced surveillance as mpox spreads globally, with 14 cases in the Americas. For the index case, isolation is advised until crusts fall, and contact tracing within 24 hours with a 21-day follow-up. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions or mucous membranes or with recently contaminated objects. Incubation is 5–21 days; disease is typically self-limiting over 14–21 days with symptomatic care. Prodromal symptoms may include fever, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, asthenia, sore throat, and anorectal/genital pain.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンの公衆衛生警報：より感染性の高い痘そうウイルス（サル痘）の新規変異体の最初の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ib（より高い伝播性と病原性を持つ）の初めての確認例がアルゼンチンで報告された。国際的な拡大リスク、重症度の懸念、広域流行の可能性があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ibはアルゼンチンでの初確認事例。より高い伝播性・病原性を持つ新規変異体。DRC発生源の国際的拡大を示唆。既に5症例のClade IIがアルゼンチンで確認されており、複数変異体の同時流行状況。スペイン（カナリア諸島）での事例も言及されており、南米・欧州両地域での拡大を示唆。現在のところ渡航歴がない市中感染は報告されていないが、監視強化が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 12.000 người tử vong do lao hằng năm, báo động số ca mắc phía Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12,000 people die from tuberculosis each year, raising alarm over TB cases in the South.
article.articleSummary: On World TB Day 2026, Vietnam reports 184,000 new TB cases annually, 9,400 drug-resistant TB cases, and about 12,000 TB deaths. The country ranks 12th among 30 TB-burden nations and 10th for drug-resistant TB; the southern region accounts for about 60% of detected cases. A major gap is TB screening not included in routine health checks: only about 23% of people undergo health examinations, leaving an estimated 40–50% unscreened among ~52 million working-age adults. From 2026, free annual health checks or TB screening should be provided at least once yearly, with TB screening integrated into free checks and annual checks for civil servants and workers. The National TB Program calls for provincial-level specialized TB hospitals; the Central Lung Hospital Training Center will train staff in TB diagnosis, treatment, and prevention under Resolution No. 72.

triage.headline_ja: 年間12,000人が結核で死亡、南部地域での感染者数の増加に警報
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける結核の継続的な公衆衛生上の課題を報告しているが、新規アウトブレイクではなく既知の地域的負担の報告。国際的拡大の直接的なシグナルは認められない。
triage.notes: ベトナムの結核は既知の地域的健康問題であり、新たなアウトブレイク宣言ではない。ただし年間死亡数12,000人、184,000新規症例、薬剤耐性TB 9,400件という重大な疾病負担と、南部地域での60%の症例集約に加え、スクリーニング率の低さ（約23%）が継続的な課題として報告されている。政府レベルでの対応強化（年間無料スクリーニング導入、結核専門施設の整備、Resolution No. 72に基づく人材育成）がWorld TB Day 2026の機会に報告されている。国際的拡大リスクは直接的には言及されておらず、IHR基準は1つのみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、既知の地域的負担であるため、フルRRAの前の継続監視段階が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: bats-vaccine-rabies-nipah-mosquitoes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bats-Vaccine-Rabies-Nipah-Mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Chinese scientists at the Wuhan Institute of Virology have developed vaccine-carrying mosquitoes and saline nets to immunize bats against rabies and Nipah virus. The strategy, termed environmental vaccination, aims to immunize wild bat populations without capturing or handling them, potentially preventing spillover of bat-borne viruses into humans. Bats are long recognized reservoirs for rabies and Nipah, with human outbreaks arising from zoonotic transmission. In the approach, mosquitoes carrying the vaccine bite bats to induce immunity, and saline nets are used to disseminate the vectors in bat habitats. If effective, environmental vaccination could offer a safer, scalable method to curb zoonotic transmission and future outbreaks, reducing reliance on direct intervention in forested ecosystems.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリ用ワクチン搭載蚊によるジフテリア、狂犬病、ニパウイルス対策
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスおよび狂犬病という重要な人獣共通感染症が関連しており、中国での新しい対策の報道だが、実際の患者発生や流行の報告ではなく、ワクチン開発技術の発表記事であるため情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の患者発生や流行事態ではなく、中国の研究機関による新規ワクチン技術開発の報道。ニパウイルスと狂犬病は高リスク病原体で注視対象だが、記事にはコウモリ個体群への対策の説明に留まり、人間への直接的な感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急性は記載されていない。続報にて実際の流行情報が出現した場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Detectan en Argentina el primer caso de la viruela del mono más agresiva: cómo prevenirla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Case of the More Aggressive Monkeypox Detected in Argentina: How to Prevent It
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports its first Mpox case of clade Ib, a more contagious and potentially more severe variant, in a 31-year-old man from Buenos Aires. He had no recent international travel, presented with rash, fever, pain and lymphadenopathy, and recovered after ambulatory care. Clade Ib is spreading globally in 2026, with cases in the United States, Canada, Brazil and Mexico, and community transmission in France, Portugal and Spain; Argentina had five clade II infections earlier in 2026 (four in Buenos Aires City, one in Río Negro). Mpox is an Orthopoxvirus transmitted by direct contact with skin lesions or mucous membranes, close sexual contact, contaminated objects, and, with prolonged exposure, short-range respiratory spread. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, fatigue, followed by skin lesions; illness often resolves in 14–21 days. Authorities urge enhanced surveillance, rapid detection, contact tracing, and isolation until lesions crust; PCR/sequencing confirmed clade Ib; no secondary cases detected yet.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンでより攻撃的な猿痘の最初の症例を検出：予防方法
triage.triage_reason: Mpox clade Ibの新規導入（アルゼンチンで初）、国際的な拡大傾向、既存のclade II感染との並行流行、複数国での社会的関心により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Mpox clade Ibはより感染力が強く潜在的により重篤な変異株。アルゼンチンではclade IIが既に流行中（5例）で、clade Ib導入により二重流行リスク。米国、カナダ、ブラジル、メキシコで症例報告あり、欧州（フランス、ポルトガル、スペイン）では既にコミュニティ伝播進行中。患者は海外渡航歴なく、アルゼンチン国内での曝露源が不明（追加調査必要）。PCR/シークエンシングで確認済み。接触追跡強化と監視体制が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Задержан экс-глава привинции в КНР, при котором появился ковид
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former provincial governor in the PRC detained, during whose tenure COVID-19 appeared.
article.articleSummary: China's Supreme People's Procuratorate has arrested Jiang Chaolian, former secretary of the Communist Party Committee of Hubei Province, on suspicions of bribery. Jiang led the Hubei Party Committee from 2016 to February 2020, during which the COVID-19 outbreak first emerged in December 2019 in Wuhan, the provincial capital. After leaving the province, he served as a deputy to the National People’s Congress, holding the post of deputy head of the Committee on Agriculture and Rural Affairs. Prosecutors say Jiang sought benefits for others in exchange for rewards. The case is part of Xi Jinping’s wide anti-corruption drive since 2012 that has ousted and imprisoned many senior officials. The report frames the arrest within ongoing efforts to discipline officials, with no further charges detailed.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の湖北省元トップが逮捕、同氏の任期中にCOVID-19が出現
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は腐敗疑疑での政治的逮捕を報じるもので、感染症の新規発生、拡大、または公衆衛生上の危機を示すシグナルではない。COVID-19は過去の歴史的事実として言及されているのみである。
triage.notes: 2026年3月のロシア語記事で、湖北省の元共産党書記（2016年2月～2020年2月在任）の汚職容疑での逮捕を報じている。COVID-19は文脈的背景としてのみ言及され、現在のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の新規シグナルではない。政治的なニュース記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 多地发现病例，有班级被隔离！这几点一定要注意！！！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases detected in multiple locations, a class has been quarantined! These points must be noted!!!
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) cases detected in Shanghai, prompting school quarantines. In Baoshan District, multiple classes at a private junior high were isolated after cases; in Jing’an District, a public junior high sixth grade had two cases, with the class moved to an isolation room and staggered schedules. Experts note a shifting age distribution with higher incidence among older children and adults (25–40), though most pediatric cases are mild. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and direct/indirect contact with vesicle fluid; home isolation, school notification, and disinfection are advised until lesions crust over, with ventilation emphasized. A notable case involves a 7‑month‑old girl infected by a mother who had shingles after returning to work. Vaccination: Shanghai began two‑dose varicella vaccination in 2018; those born after Aug 1, 2014 typically receive two doses, while older children/adolescents may opt for a second dose to improve protection.

triage.headline_ja: 複数の地域で患者が発見、クラスが隔離に！これらのポイントに注意が必要!!!
triage.triage_reason: 水痘の学校内集団発生で隔離措置が取られており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクの情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 水痘は予防可能疾患であり、上海では2018年から2用量ワクチン接種が導入されている。学校隔離と感染制御措置が実施されており、現在の状況は管理可能と判断。ただし、成人患者（25-40歳）の増加傾向と帯状疱疹からの転移事例は注視すべき。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、重症度については記事に具体的な情報がないため「不明」と判定。
